title.en: At least one dead and multiple injured in Philippines school shooting
title.zh: 菲律宾学校枪击事件至少一人死亡，多人受伤

summary.en: A shooting at a high school in the southern Philippines has resulted in at least one death and several injuries. The incident occurred at Banga National High School in South Cotabato, Mindanao province, with conflicting casualty figures reported by local media and officials. The identities of the shooter and victims...
summary.zh: 菲律宾南部一所高中发生枪击事件，造成至少一人死亡，数人受伤。事件发生在棉兰老岛省南三宝颜省的邦加国家高中。当地媒体和官员报告的伤亡数字存在冲突。枪手和受害者的身份尚未确认，教育部表示“深切关注”，并将学生、教师和学校工作人员的安全放在首位。

body.en:
A shooting at a high school in southern Philippines has left at least one person dead and several injured.

The incident happened on Friday afternoon at Banga National High School in South Cotabato, in Mindanao province.

Local media and officials have reporting conflicting casualty figures. The identities of the shooter and the victims have not been confirmed.

The Department of Education said in a statement that it was "deeply concerned by the reported shooting incident".

"Our immediate priority is the safety and well-being of our learners, teachers and school personnel," the statement said, adding it was coordinating with authorities to verify the incident and provide necessary support.

"We urge everyone to remain calm and refrain from sharing unverified information as authorities continue their investigation."

South Cotabato Governor Reynaldo Tamayo told reporters earlier that one person died and four people had been hospitalised. He did not give details on the identity of the shooter, nor did he indicate the shooter was among the dead or injured.

Local media have been reporting much higher casualty figures, citing other Philippine authorities.

Classes have been suspended "in all levels in the entire municipality of Banga" due to the shooting, the Banga disaster management authorities said in a statement.

The Philippine Red Cross said it has deployed medical teams to help out in the aftermath of the shooting.

Gun crime is not uncommon in the Philippines, which has one of the highest rates of gun ownership in the region - though school shootings remain rare.

In June, three students were killed and more were injured after their peers opened fire at a high school in central Philippines. Investigators believed the deadly shooting had been motivated by a "grudge" over bullying.
body.zh: 菲律宾南部一所高中发生枪击事件，造成至少一人死亡、多人受伤。 这起事件于周五下午发生在棉兰老省南哥打巴托省的班加国立高中。 当地媒体和官员报道的伤亡数字相互矛盾。枪手和受害者的身份尚未得到证实。 教育部在一份声明中表示，“对报道的枪击事件深感关切”。 声明称：“我们的当务之急是学生、教师和学校工作人员的安全和福祉。”并补充说，它正在与当局协调以核实事件并提供必要的支持。 “我们敦促大家保持冷静，在当局继续调查期间不要分享未经证实的信息。” 南哥打巴托省省长雷纳尔多·塔马约早些时候告诉记者，一人死亡，四人住院。他没有详细说明枪手的身份，也没有表明枪手是否在死者或受伤者之列。 当地媒体援引菲律宾其他当局的话说，伤亡数字要高得多。 班加灾难管理当局在一份声明中表示，由于枪击事件，“班加全市各级”的课程已停课。 菲律宾红十字会表示，已部署医疗队在枪击事件发生后提供帮助。 枪支犯罪在菲律宾并不罕见，该国是该地区枪支拥有率最高的国家之一，尽管校园枪击事件仍然很少见。 六月，菲律宾中部一所高中的同学开枪，造成三名学生死亡，多人受伤。调查人员认为，这起致命枪击事件的动机是对欺凌行为的“怨恨”。

reflection.en: The news of a shooting at Banga National High School is a stark reminder of the vulnerability of young people in educational settings. The Bible warns against causing harm to children, emphasizing their preciousness in God's eyes. May we pray for the victims, their families, and the entire school community in Mindanao, seeking comfort and healing in the...
reflection.zh: 菲律宾邦加国家高中的枪击事件令人痛心，它提醒我们年轻人在学校环境中的脆弱性。《圣经》警告我们不要伤害孩童，强调他们在雅伟眼中的宝贵。让我们为棉兰老岛的受害者、他们的家人以及整个学校社区祈祷，在悲剧之中寻求安慰与医治。

verse.textEn: If anyone causes one of these little ones — those who believe in me — to stumble, it would be better for them to have a large millstone hung around their neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.
verse.textZh: 凡使这信我的一个小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在这人的颈项上，沉在深海里。
verse.themeEn: Woe to those who harm children

title.en: Burnham will meet Irish PM as UK bids to get exemptions from EU’s ‘Made in Europe’ plan – UK politics live
title.zh: 伯纳姆将与爱尔兰总理会晤，英国寻求欧盟‘欧洲制造’计划豁免——英国政治直播

summary.en: The UK Prime Minister will host an overseas visit at No 10 North for the first time, while the Chancellor is in Dublin meeting EU finance ministers. This comes as the UK seeks exemptions from the EU's 'Made in Europe' plan. The report also notes a lighthearted remark about Liverpool being the 33rd county of Ireland...
summary.zh: 英国首相将首次在唐宁街北翼接待外国来访，同时财政大臣正在都柏林与欧盟财长会晤。此举正值英国寻求欧盟‘欧洲制造’计划的豁免之际。报道还提到，在卡迪夫的一次峰会上，有人开玩笑说利物浦是爱尔兰的第33个郡。

body.en: It will be the first time the PM uses No 10 North to host an overseas visit while the chancellor will be in Dublin meeting with EU finance ministers Good morning. On Monday, at her summit in Cardiff with the leaders of the SNP and Plaid Cymru, Mary Lou McDonald, the Sinn Féin president, joked about Liverpool being the 33rd county of Ireland . Andy Burnham is basically a Scouser; he was born in Liverpool and supports a Liverpool football team, despite being brought up in Culcheth, a village mid-way between Liverpool and Manchester, which made him enough of a Manc to be the city’s mayor. He also has Irish ancestry, and so the mood should be very cordial today when he hosts Micheál Martin , the taoiseach (Irish PM) at No 10 North in Manchester this morning. It is the first time that Burnham has used No 10 North to host an overseas visit, which should help a bit his efforts to establish that No 10 North is a proper government power base, and not just a branch office. The historic visit to No 10 North comes as the prime minister shines a spotlight on towns up and down the country, days after he hosted Canadian prime minister Mark Carney in Liverpool and Nato secretary general Mark Rutte in Oxford. Continue reading...
body.zh: 这将是首相首次使用北十号进行海外访问，同时总理将在都柏林与欧盟财长会面。早上好。周一，在卡迪夫与苏格兰民族党和格莱德·西姆鲁领导人举行的峰会上，新芬党主席玛丽·卢·麦克唐纳开玩笑说利物浦是爱尔兰的第 33 个县。安迪·伯纳姆 (Andy Burnham) 基本上是一名利物浦人。他出生在利物浦，并支持一支利物浦足球队，尽管他在利物浦和曼彻斯特之间的一个村庄卡尔切斯长大，这使他足够成为曼城的市长。他也有爱尔兰血统，所以今天早上他在曼彻斯特北10号接待爱尔兰总理迈克尔·马丁时，气氛应该会非常融洽。这是伯纳姆第一次利用北十号来主持海外访问，这应该有助于他努力使北十号成为一个适当的政府权力基地，而不仅仅是一个分支机构。对北十号进行历史性访问之际，总理在利物浦接待了加拿大总理马克·卡尼，在牛津接待了北约秘书长马克·鲁特，几天后他将注意力集中在全国各地的城镇上。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Navigating international relations requires careful diplomacy and a commitment to peaceful engagement. As leaders meet to discuss trade and potential exemptions, the underlying hope is for continued cooperation and understanding, fostering a spirit of accord between nations. Yahweh的子民蒙召在世上寻求和平。当国家领导人会晤以讨论贸易和潜在的豁免时，我们祈求他们能以智慧和恩典来处理这些事务，促进国家间的理解与合作。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Twenty women had breasts removed unnecessarily during NHS cancer care
title.zh: 英国国民保健署癌症护理中二十名女性不必要地接受了乳房切除术

summary.en: Twenty women underwent unnecessary mastectomies while receiving cancer treatment at the County Durham and Darlington foundation trust in north-east England. The trust admitted that hundreds of patients suffered harm, and authorities are investigating potential criminal offenses.
summary.zh: 在英格兰东北部的达勒姆和达灵顿基金会信托医院，有二十名女性在接受癌症治疗期间不必要地接受了乳房切除术。该信托承认有数百名患者受到伤害，当局正在调查潜在的刑事犯罪。

body.en:
Twenty women had their breasts removed unnecessarily while being treated for cancer at an NHS trust in north-east England.

The County Durham and Darlington foundation trust (CDDFT) told the BBC that the women were among hundreds of patients who came to harm during treatment at its breast unit.

The admission came after the BBC reported last year that more than 200 patients were found to have suffered harm at the CDDFT .

The broadcaster reported that the National Crime Agency was working with Durham police to investigate allegations by former patients and determine if any criminal offences had taken place.

Steve Russell, who was appointed chief executive of CDDFT last year, said: “We are deeply sorry to the women and families who have been harmed and let down by failings in our breast services.

“We recognise the profound impact this has had and have been clear that there were opportunities when, as a trust, we should have listened more carefully and acted sooner.

“Significant changes have since been made to the breast service and are bringing improvements for patients.

“Alongside this, the look-back continues to review past care, identify patients who may have experienced harm and make sure they receive appropriate information and support.

“On September 24, our trust board will meet in public to consider the future scope and timeframe of the look-back. No final decision has been made and it would not be right to pre-empt the board’s discussion.

“We will continue to be open about this work and will provide a further update following the meeting.

“Our dedicated support line remains available to anyone with concerns about their breast care on 0191 333 2126 or at cddft.breastservices@nhs.net.”

CDDFT is conducting an internal review of breast cancer cases between January 2023 and February 2025, as well as 640 former patients who contacted a special helpline.

The BBC reported that of 514 cases reviewed by the trust so far, 315 patients have been found to have suffered harm, including 77 who were significantly harmed. One patient is known to have died.

Russell told the BBC that in some cases cancer was missed and then subsequently spread.

​One woman who had an unnecessary mastectomy, referred to as Jo, told BBC Radio 4’s Today programme said: “They should have done further screening and biopsies, and that would have shown that all the other areas were were benign. And actually, there was very small cancer in a large breast. And actually, I didn’t need a mastectomy at all.”

“I just was in total shock, sat at the top of the stairs with the dogs, thinking, have I really heard what I’ve just heard? It was unbelievable, devastating,” she said.

“The fact that this part of your body is now gone, and you know part of what makes you a woman’s gone. It...
body.zh: 20 名女性在英格兰东北部的 NHS 信托机构接受癌症治疗时，被不必要地切除了乳房。 达勒姆和达灵顿县基金会信托基金 (CDDFT) 告诉 BBC，这些妇女是在其乳腺科接受治疗期间受伤的数百名患者之一。 去年，BBC 报道称，CDDFT 中有 200 多名患者被发现受到伤害。 该广播公司报道称，国家犯罪局正在与达勒姆警方合作，调查前患者的指控，并确定是否发生任何刑事犯罪。 去年被任命为 CDDFT 首席执行官的史蒂夫·拉塞尔 (Steve Russell) 表示：“我们对因我们的乳房服务失败而受到伤害和失望的妇女和家庭深表歉意。 “我们认识到这件事所产生的深远影响，并且很清楚，作为一个信托机构，我们应该更仔细地倾听并更早采取行动，这是有机会的。 “此后，乳房服务发生了重大变化，并为患者带来了改善。 “除此之外，回顾还将继续审查过去的护理，识别可能遭受伤害的患者，并确保他们获得适当的信息和支持。 “9月24日，我们的信托委员会将公开开会，考虑未来回顾的范围和时间表。目前尚未做出最终决定，抢占董事会讨论是不正确的。 “我们将继续对这项工作持开放态度，并将在会议后提供进一步的更新。 “任何对乳房护理有疑虑的人都可以拨打我们的专门支持热线：0191 333 2126 或发送电子邮件至 cddft.breastservices@nhs.net。” CDDFT 正在对 2023 年 1 月至 2025 年 2 月期间的乳腺癌病例以及联系特殊帮助热线的 640 名前患者进行内部审查。 BBC报道称，迄今为止该信托机构审查的514起案件中，已发现315名患者受到伤害，其中77人受到严重伤害。据了解，一名患者已经死亡。 拉塞尔告诉英国广播公司，在某些情况下，癌症会被遗漏，然后扩散。 一位被称为 Jo 的女性接受了不必要的乳房切除术，她对 BBC 广播 4 台的《今日》节目表示：“他们应该进行进一步的筛查和活检，这将表明所有其他区域都是良性的。实际上，大乳房中存在非常小的癌症。实际上，我根本不需要乳房切除术。” “我完全震惊了，和狗一起坐在楼梯顶上，心想，我真的听到了我刚才听到的吗？这令人难以置信，是毁灭性的，”她说。 “事实上，你身体的这一部分现在已经消失了，你知道是什么让你成为一个女人。它......

reflection.en: This news reveals a profound breach of trust and care within a healthcare system meant to heal. The unnecessary removal of breasts from twenty women points to a deep failure in accountability and ethical practice. It calls us to reflect on the importance of justice, mercy, and integrity in all institutions, especially those entrusted with human well-being.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻揭示了本应治愈的医疗体系内部信任和关怀的严重破裂。二十名女性不必要地接受乳房切除术，表明在问责制和道德实践方面存在严重缺陷。它促使我们反思在所有机构中，尤其是在那些被委托照管人类福祉的机构中，公正、怜悯和诚信的重要性。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Retail sales bounce back in Great Britain amid brighter signs for economy
title.zh: 英国零售销售回升，经济前景显现光明迹象

summary.en: Latest data shows a 0.5% rise in retail sales across Great Britain in August, exceeding expectations and defying economic gloom. This increase was driven by purchases of sports items, air conditioning units, and fans, coinciding with heatwaves. The figures emerge as the Chancellor prepares for the upcoming budget.
summary.zh: 最新数据显示，英国8月份零售销售额出人意料地增长了0.5%，这与经济悲观预测相悖。此次增长得益于在热浪期间对体育用品、空调和风扇的购买。这些数据是在财政大臣准备发布下个月预算之际发布的。

body.en: Latest data to defy economic gloom shows 0.5% rise boosted by purchases of sports items, aircon units and fans amid heatwaves Business live – latest updates Retail sales across Great Britain unexpectedly rose last month, the latest economic indicator to defy gloomy forecasts as the chancellor, John Healey, prepares to present next month’s budget. The Office for National Statistics (ONS) said the volume of goods sold rose 0.5% month on month in August, defying analyst expectations of a 0.2% fall. Continue reading...
body.zh: 克服经济低迷的最新数据显示，在热浪中体育用品、空调和风扇的购买推动了 0.5% 的增长 商业直播 – 最新更新 英国上个月的零售额意外增长，这是英国财政大臣约翰·希利 (John Healey) 准备提交下个月预算之际的最新经济指标，打破了悲观的预测。英国国家统计局(ONS)表示，8月份商品销售量环比增长0.5%，超出了分析师预期的下降0.2%。继续阅读...

reflection.en: It's encouraging to see economic indicators defying gloom, with retail sales showing a surprising 0.5% rise in August. This rebound, fueled by purchases like fans and air conditioners during heatwaves, offers a moment of relief. Yet, as we experience such upturns, Deuteronomy 8:18 reminds us: 'But you shall remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives...
reflection.zh: 看到经济指标扭转悲观局面，8月份零售销售额出人意料地增长了0.5%，这令人鼓舞。这次反弹得益于在热浪期间购买风扇和空调等商品，带来了片刻的宽慰。然而，当我们经历这样的好转时，申命记8:18提醒我们：“你却要记念雅伟你的神，因为得货财的能力是他给你的，为要照他向你列祖所立的约，像今日一样成就这事。”愿我们在时势好转时，不忘繁荣的源头。

verse.textEn: Remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.
verse.textZh: 你要记念雅伟你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的。

title.en: Ireland's RTÉ to boycott Eurovision over Israel inclusion for second year
title.zh: 爱尔兰RTÉ因以色列参赛连续第二年抵制欧洲歌唱大赛

summary.en: Irish public broadcaster RTÉ announced it will not send an act to or broadcast the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest, for the second consecutive year, due to the ongoing conflict and loss of life in Gaza.
summary.zh: 爱尔兰公共广播公司RTÉ宣布，由于加沙持续的冲突和生命损失，该公司将连续第二年不派代表参加或转播2027年欧洲歌唱大赛。

body.en:
Ireland will not participate in or broadcast next year's Eurovision Song Contest, public broadcaster RTÉ said, citing the "ongoing loss of lives in Gaza".

The country, which also snubbed the 2026 competition over Israel's participation, will join the Netherlands in skipping the world's biggest live televised music event , which has been hit by a string of withdrawals and controversies in recent years.

"RTÉ will not participate in the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest, nor will RTÉ broadcast the competition," the broadcaster said on Thursday.

"RTÉ feels that Ireland's participation cannot be justified given the appalling and ongoing loss of lives in Gaza and the humanitarian crisis there which continues to put the lives of so many civilians at risk," the statement said.

RTÉ quoted Eurovision Song Contest director Martin Green as saying that the European Broadcasting Union (EBU), which organises the event, regretted but respected RTÉ's decision.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"They remain a valued part of our family and will be missed," RTÉ reported Green as saying.

Earlier this month, the EBU said it was excluding any country involved in an armed conflict from hosting the competition.

Israel, which has been at war in Gaza since 2023, came close to winning the competition in both 2025 and 2026, ultimately finishing second on each occasion .

However, the Dutch broadcaster said the exclusion of countries in conflict from hosting was not "sufficient", adding that Eurovision could "no longer be considered neutral" given the divisions over the Gaza conflict.

Since its launch in 1955, Eurovision has become the ultimate pop platform, catapulting Swedish icons ABBA to worldwide fame and boosting the likes of Celine Dion, Cliff Richard and Olivia Newton-John.

Next year's event will take place on 15 May in Burgas, Bulgaria's Black Sea city.

This year's competition drew 131 million viewers, down 35 million from the year before, after five countries boycotted it over Israel's participation .

The Netherlands, Iceland, Spain, Ireland and Slovenia all pulled out of the 2026 contest, with the latter three refusing to broadcast the show at all.

SBS, an associate member of EBU and Australia's official broadcaster of the competition, has confirmed it will broadcast Eurovision in 2027.

SBS participated in the 2026 edition, despite calls for Australia to boycott the competition .

"Our position remains that, as a public broadcaster, making a decision to be involved based on the inclusion or exclusion of any country would undermine SBS's editorial independence and impartiality," an SBS spokesperson said in December...
body.zh: 公共广播公司 RTÉ 表示，爱尔兰将不会参加或转播明年的欧洲歌唱大赛，理由是“加沙正在发生人员伤亡”。 该国还因以色列的参赛而冷落了2026年的比赛，并将与荷兰一起缺席这项世界上最大的现场电视音乐盛会，该盛会近年来受到一系列退出和争议的打击。 该广播公司周四表示：“RTÉ 将不会参加 2027 年欧洲歌唱大赛，也不会转播比赛。” 声明称：“RTÉ认为，鉴于加沙地区令人震惊的持续生命损失以及那里的人道主义危机继续使许多平民的生命处于危险之中，爱尔兰的参与是不合理的。” RTÉ援引欧洲歌唱大赛总监马丁·格林的话说，组织此次活动的欧洲广播联盟（EBU）对此表示遗憾，但尊重RTÉ的决定。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 据《RTÉ》报道，格林表示：“他们仍然是我们家庭的重要组成部分，我们会想念他们。” 本月早些时候，欧洲联盟表示，将排除任何卷入武装冲突的国家主办比赛。 自 2023 年以来加沙一直处于战争状态的以色列在 2025 年和 2026 年都差点赢得比赛，最终两次获得第二名。 然而，这家荷兰广播公司表示，将冲突国家排除在主办之外还“不够”，并补充说，鉴于加沙冲突的分歧，欧洲电视网“不再被视为中立”。 自 1955 年推出以来，欧洲歌唱大赛已成为终极流行音乐平台，使瑞典偶像 ABBA 享誉全球，并培养了席琳·迪翁、克里夫·理查德和奥利维亚·牛顿·约翰等人。 明年的活动将于 5 月 15 日在保加利亚黑海城市布尔加斯举行。 今年的比赛吸引了 1.31 亿观众，比上年减少了 3500 万，此前有五个国家因以色列参赛而抵制比赛。 荷兰、冰岛、西班牙、爱尔兰和斯洛文尼亚都退出了 2026 年的比赛，后三个国家根本拒绝转播该节目。 SBS 是 EBU 的准会员，也是澳大利亚比赛的官方转播商，已确认将在 2027 年转播欧洲电视网。 尽管有人呼吁澳大利亚抵制比赛，SBS 还是参加了 2026 年的比赛。 SBS 发言人去年 12 月表示：“我们的立场仍然是，作为一家公共广播公司，根据纳入或排除任何国家做出参与决定将损害 SBS 的编辑独立性和公正性。”

reflection.en: RTÉ's decision to boycott the Eurovision Song Contest, citing the ongoing loss of life in Gaza, highlights a broadcaster's moral stance. This action reflects a principle of prioritizing conscience and humanitarian concerns over participation in a widely watched cultural event. It echoes the sentiment of obeying a higher moral calling, even when it means...
reflection.zh: RTÉ决定抵制欧洲歌唱大赛，并以加沙持续的生命损失为由，凸显了广播公司的道德立场。此举体现了在参与备受瞩目的文化活动时，将良知和人道主义关切置于优先地位的原则。这呼应了即使意味着退出一个平台，也要服从更高道德召唤的精神。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: The bigger story behind Donald Trump's Kennedy Center clash
title.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普肯尼迪中心之争背后的更大故事

summary.en: The US president's efforts to leave his mark on America's institutions are proving deeply divisive, with a federal judge ordering that the Trump administration cannot alter or demolish the Kennedy Center without at least 30 days' notice, following comments made by Trump about the building needing to be "ripped down".
summary.zh: 美国总统试图在美国的机构上留下自己的印记，这正变得极具争议。一位联邦法官下令，特朗普政府在至少提前30天通知的情况下，不得更改或拆除肯尼迪中心，此前特朗普曾发表过关于该建筑需要被“拆毁”的言论。

body.en:
The saga of the Kennedy Center continues as a United States federal judge has warned that the Trump administration cannot alter or demolish the storied performing arts centre without at least 30 days' notice.

Judge Christopher Copper issued the order after receiving a submission comprising comments made by Donald Trump this week that the historic Washington DC building would have to be "ripped down". He was later photographed looking at what appears to be a rendition of the centre being demolished.

The administration has been in a long-standing clash over the 1960's building , named in tribute to the assassinated president John F Kennedy. In December, a Trump-appointed board of trustees voted to add his name to the building, a move subsequently blocked by the courts.

"I think that the Trump administration should certainly have recognition. Because frankly, if we don't do that, it's going to close. It'll end up being ripped down," Trump told reporters on Thursday.

A threatened shutdown of the centre is now in place, with Matt Floca, the Kennedy Center's Trump-backed executive director, saying the building has been temporarily closed to assess safety risks in areas "exhibiting severe structural deterioration."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Democrat Joyce Beatty has responded by claiming in court filings the closure "is a recipe for defendants extending their shutdown forever and closing the Kennedy Center for the next two years — the very thing this court said they could not do without its permission."

Trump installed himself as chairman of the centre soon after taking office for the second time last year, ousting 18 board members appointed by former president Joe Biden and inserting his own allies to key positions.

The new board dissolved the centre's Social Impact Division and rolled back diversity-focused programming. Dozens of high-profile artists, productions, and long-running residency groups pulled out in protest. Ticket sales dropped to their lowest levels since the pandemic.

The Washington Post recently reported that the centre would only collect US$124 million ($174 million) of the US$220 million ($309 million) it had projected for the period between 1 October 2025 and 30 September 2026, leaving a "roughly $23 million deficit" after substantial spending cuts.

The building was damaged in a storm earlier this month, with a "roughly four-by-five foot" section of plaster falling from the ceiling in the Grand Foyer. It is reported to be in dire need of repairs.

In June, workers removed Trump's name from the outside of the building, following Judge Cooper's orders, which affirmed that only Congress has the power to alter its...
body.zh: 肯尼迪中心的传奇仍在继续，美国联邦法官警告称，特朗普政府不得在至少提前 30 天通知的情况下改变或拆除这座著名的表演艺术中心。 法官克里斯托弗·科珀 (Christopher Copper) 在收到唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 本周发表的评论后发布了该命令，该评论称华盛顿特区的历史建筑必须“拆除”。后来他被拍到正在观看似乎是被拆除的中心的再现。 这座 1960 年代的建筑是为了纪念被暗杀的总统约翰·F·肯尼迪而命名的，政府之间一直存在长期冲突。去年12月，特朗普任命的董事会投票决定将他的名字添加到大楼中，但此举随后被法院阻止。 “我认为特朗普政府当然应该得到认可。因为坦率地说，如果我们不这样做，它就会关闭。它最终会被推倒，”特朗普周四告诉记者。 特朗普支持的肯尼迪中心执行董事马特·弗洛卡(Matt Floca)表示，该建筑已暂时关闭，以评估“结构严重恶化”地区的安全风险。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 民主党人乔伊斯·比蒂对此作出回应，在法庭文件中声称，关闭“是被告永久延长关闭时间并在未来两年关闭肯尼迪中心的良方——法院表示，未经其许可，他们不能这样做。” 特朗普去年第二次就任该中心主席后不久，就罢免了前总统乔·拜登任命的 18 名董事会成员，并让自己的盟友担任关键职位。 新董事会解散了该中心的社会影响部门，并取消了以多元化为重点的项目。数十名知名艺术家、作品和长期驻留团体退出以示抗议。门票销量跌至大流行以来的最低水平。 《华盛顿邮报》最近报道称，该中心预计在 2025 年 10 月 1 日至 2026 年 9 月 30 日期间筹集的资金为 2.2 亿美元（3.09 亿美元），而该中心将仅收取 1.24 亿美元（1.74 亿美元），在大幅削减支出后留下“约 2300 万美元的赤字”。 该建筑在本月早些时候的一场暴风雨中受损，大厅天花板上有一块“大约四乘五英尺”的灰泥掉落。据报道，该处急需维修。 六月，根据库珀法官的命令，工作人员将特朗普的名字从大楼外抹掉，该命令确认只有国会有权改变其...

reflection.en: The Kennedy Center, a national performing arts center, is caught in a political tug-of-war. President Trump's desire to reshape or even demolish it, as reported, raises questions about the stewardship of public institutions. Jeremiah 22:3 calls leaders to "execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers...
reflection.zh: 肯尼迪中心，一个国家表演艺术中心，正陷入政治拉锯战。据报道，特朗普总统希望重塑甚至拆除它，这引发了关于公共机构管理的问题。《耶利米书》22章3节呼吁领导人“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手”。这一原则也延伸到为公众利益负责任地照管和保护文化地标。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Aztec manuscript returns to Mexico after two centuries, on loan
title.zh: 阿兹特克手稿在法国展出两个世纪后归还墨西哥

summary.en: The Azcatitlan Codex, a significant 16th-century Aztec manuscript detailing the history of the Aztec capital from its founding to its fall, has returned to Mexico for the first time since 1840. The artifact, on loan from France's Bibliotheque Nationale, is now on display in Mexico City.
summary.zh: 阿兹特克人手稿《阿兹卡蒂特兰法典》是一份重要的16世纪手稿，记录了阿兹特克首都从建立到陷落的历史，现已在1840年后首次返回墨西哥。该文物目前正在墨西哥城展出，是法国国家图书馆的借展品。

body.en:
For years, Mexico has demanded the return of a treasured manuscript. Now the Aztec relic is back home from France — but on loan.

The Azcatitlan Codex, a rare and prized manuscript that recounts the history of the Aztecs in vibrant pictograms, has returned to Mexico for the first time since 1840. It went on display in Mexico City on Thursday.

The codex is a 16th-century artifact and regarded as one of the most important visual records of Aztec history. It records the founding of the Aztec capital to its fall after the subsequent arrival of Spanish conquistadores.

It arrived in Mexico on loan from France's Bibliotheque Nationale, where it has been since 1898. The temporary loan is occurring as the two nations celebrate 200 years of diplomatic ties. 

As two folios from the document went on display inside a glass case at the National Museum of Anthropology, Mexican Foreign Minister Roberto Velasco said the exhibition was about "reuniting a population with its (collective) memory."

The pictograms "represent our history, the written voice of our ancestors, and the deep root of our identity," he said, speaking at the inauguration.

Members of an indigenous group reacted ecstatically to the display. "They hid our history from us, they stole it!" Emilia Mendoza of the Hnahnu community said at the opening exhibition.

"This is a battle won, a first step toward the restitution of these books that reside in other countries," she said.

Made up of Mesoamerican pictograms with European writing, the codex is divided into three parts.

It traces the Mexica's migration from Aztlan — the mythical birthplace of the Aztec civilization — to the founding of Tenochtitlan. That's the capital of the Aztec empire and is present day Mexico City.

The document also depicts the succession of the city's rulers, the arrival of the Spanish and the subsequent evangelization, according to Mexico's National Institute of Anthropology and History.

All of this has been rendered in the codex in vibrant reds, blues, greens and yellows, depicting warriors in feathered headdresses and showcasing ritual acts in pyramid temples.

More than five centuries have now passed since Tenochtitlan fell to Hernan Cortes, the leader of the invading Spanish forces. As most histories of invasion go, Cortez and his allies looted and razed the city after conquest, ushering in three centuries of Spanish domination.

"These codices are extremely important to us because they continue to give us identity and value as human beings during these very special times we are experiencing," said ​Maria Eugenia Castaneda, representative of the Mexica peoples. "They elevate our morale, our customs, our culture, and our sense of who we are." 

According to Mexican historians, an indigenous...
body.zh: 多年来，墨西哥一直要求归还一份珍贵的手稿。现在，阿兹特克人的遗物已从法国回到祖国，但是以租借的方式。 《阿兹卡蒂特兰抄本》是一份珍贵的稀有手稿，以生动的象形文字讲述了阿兹特克人的历史，自 1840 年以来首次回到墨西哥。该抄本于周四在墨西哥城展出。 该手抄本是一件 16 世纪的文物，被视为阿兹特克历史最重要的视觉记录之一。它记录了阿兹特克首都的建立到随后西班牙征服者到来后的灭亡。 它是从法国国家图书馆借来的，自 1898 年起一直存放在墨西哥。这次临时借阅是在两国庆祝建交 200 周年之际进行的。 当该文件的两页在国家人类学博物馆的玻璃柜内展出时，墨西哥外交部长罗伯托·贝拉斯科表示，这次展览是为了“让人们与其（集体）记忆重新结合起来”。 他在就职典礼上发表讲话时说，这些象形文字“代表了我们的历史、我们祖先的书面声音以及我们身份的根深蒂固”。 土著群体的成员对这次展示欣喜若狂。 “他们向我们隐瞒了我们的历史，他们偷走了它！” Hnahnu 社区的艾米莉亚·门多萨 (Emilia Mendoza) 在开幕式上说道。 “这是一场胜利的战斗，是归还这些存放在其他国家的书籍的第一步，”她说。 该手抄本由中美洲象形文字和欧洲文字组成，分为三个部分。 它追溯了墨西加人从阿兹特兰（阿兹特克文明的神话发源地）的迁徙，直至特诺奇蒂特兰的建立。那是阿兹特克帝国的首都，也是现在的墨西哥城。 据墨西哥国家人类学和历史研究所称，该文件还描述了该城市统治者的继任、西班牙人的到来以及随后的福音传播。 所有这些都在手抄本中以鲜艳的红色、蓝色、绿色和黄色呈现，描绘了戴着羽毛头饰的战士，并展示了金字塔寺庙中的仪式行为。 自从特诺奇蒂特兰被入侵的西班牙军队领导人埃尔南·科尔特斯攻陷以来，已经过去了五个多世纪。正如大多数入侵历史一样，科尔特斯和他的盟友在征服后洗劫并夷平了这座城市，开启了西班牙长达三个世纪的统治。 墨西加人民代表玛丽亚·尤金尼亚·卡斯塔尼达 (Maria Eugenia Castaneda) 表示：“这些抄本对我们极其重要，因为在我们正在经历的这些非常特殊的时期，它们继续赋予我们作为人类的身份和价值。” “它们提升了我们的士气、我们的习俗、我们的文化以及我们的自我意识。” 根据墨西哥历史学家的说法，土著...

reflection.en: After centuries away, the Azcatitlan Codex has returned to Mexico, a testament to the enduring value of cultural heritage. This ancient manuscript, detailing the rise and fall of a great civilization, reminds us that our history and treasures are ultimately gifts from Yahweh, to be cherished and stewarded with gratitude.
reflection.zh: 在远离故土数个世纪后，《阿兹卡蒂特兰法典》已返回墨西哥，这证明了文化遗产的持久价值。这本古老的手稿记录了一个伟大文明的兴衰，提醒我们，我们的历史和宝藏最终都来自雅伟的恩赐，应当怀着感恩之心去珍视和管理。

verse.textEn: Remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.
verse.textZh: 你要记念雅伟你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的。

title.en: Russia's election winner is all but decided. But this vote still matters to Putin
title.zh: 普京的选举结果已成定局，但这次投票仍很重要

summary.en: Polls have opened in Russia's parliamentary elections. Despite a predictable outcome, the vote is significant for Vladimir Putin as it is the first since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, a conflict that has resulted in hundreds of thousands of deaths.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯议会选举已开始投票。尽管结果可预见，但这次选举对弗拉基米尔·普京来说意义重大，因为这是自2022年2月俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰以来首次举行的选举，这场冲突已造成数十万人死亡。

body.en:
The United Russia party — fiercely loyal to the country's president, Vladimir Putin — will again be the big winner.

But that doesn't mean the vote to determine who sits in the Russian parliament, known as the Duma, isn't important to the president.

It is, because it's the first since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. The conflict has since killed hundreds of thousands of people.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Putin has ruled Russia since 1999 and his United Russia party has dominated Russian politics since the early 2000s.

Criticism of the war on Ukraine is banned in Russia, and only parties that support Putin and the Kremlin's dragging military campaign have been registered to run. Russia has also organised voting in occupied Ukraine.

Nikolai Petrov is a Russian political analyst and served as an adviser to the Kremlin in the early 1990s.

"Not so much are these elections about composition of the state Duma, it’s more or less predefined," he said.

"It’s about keeping the image that society is consolidated around the Kremlin."

Voting is taking place in Crimea, annexed by Russia in 2014, as well as Russian-controlled parts of Ukraine's Donbas, Zaporizhzhia and Kherson regions in another attempt to try and legitimise the occupation.

In Russia itself, Ukraine's strikes on oil and gas facilities, as well as online retailers' warehouses , have brought the conflict home.

The economy is under increasing strain, and discontent is quietly rising. But there are few options for voters seeking change.

Yabloko, the vocally pro-ceasefire party that had gained popularity through social media, was banned from running by the Supreme Court.

Some individual Yabloko candidates are contesting seats at great personal risk — several have been detained by police. But they're determined to have their voices heard.

"It is very important for us now to tell people that they have an opportunity to vote for peace right now, to express their political position and say that we choose peace, that we choose a life free from fear, that we want our interests to be taken into account, and that we want Russia to prosper, develop and be at peace with everyone," she said.

Polls suggest growing support for peace talks, but the Kremlin is expected to use the election results to claim the vast majority of voters still back the president and, therefore, his war.

Much has been made of veterans of the conflict running as candidates, like Vladislav Golovin, who the Kremlin has been keen to promote.

"I am working not just for myself, but for the guys I couldn't protect or save," he said.

body.zh: 极度忠诚于俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的统一俄罗斯党将再次成为大赢家。 但这并不意味着决定俄罗斯议会（即杜马）席位的投票对总统来说并不重要。 之所以如此，是因为这是自 2022 年 2 月俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰以来的第一次冲突。自那以后，这场冲突已造成数十万人死亡。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 普京自 1999 年以来一直统治俄罗斯，他的统一俄罗斯党自 2000 年代初以来一直主导俄罗斯政坛。 俄罗斯禁止批评乌克兰战争，只有支持普京和克里姆林宫拖延军事行动的政党才能登记参选。俄罗斯还在被占领的乌克兰组织了投票。 尼古拉·彼得罗夫 (Nikolai Petrov) 是一位俄罗斯政治分析家，曾于 20 世纪 90 年代初担任克里姆林宫顾问。 “这些选举与国家杜马的组成无关，它或多或少是预先确定的，”他说。 “这是为了保持社会在克里姆林宫周围得到巩固的形象。” 2014年被俄罗斯吞并的克里米亚以及乌克兰顿巴斯、扎波罗热和赫尔松地区俄罗斯控制的部分地区正在举行投票，这是又一次试图使占领合法化的尝试。 在俄罗斯本土，乌克兰对石油和天然气设施以及在线零售商仓库的袭击已将冲突带回国内。 经济压力日益加大，不满情绪也在悄然上升。但寻求变革的选民几乎没有选择。 通过社交媒体而声名鹊起的支持停火政党“亚布洛科”(Yabloko) 被最高法院禁止参选。 一些亚布洛科候选人冒着巨大的个人风险竞选席位——其中几人已被警方拘留。但他们决心让自己的声音被听到。 她说：“现在对我们来说非常重要的是告诉人们，他们现在有机会投票支持和平，表达他们的政治立场，并说我们选择和平，我们选择没有恐惧的生活，我们希望我们的利益得到考虑，我们希望俄罗斯繁荣、发展并与所有人和平相处。” 民意调查显示，对和平谈判的支持不断增加，但预计克里姆林宫将利用选举结果来声称绝大多数选民仍然支持总统，从而支持他的战争。 许多参加过冲突的退伍军人作为候选人参选，比如克里姆林宫一直热衷提拔的弗拉迪斯拉夫·戈洛文(Vladislav Golovin)。 “我不仅为自己工作，而且为那些我无法保护或拯救的人工作，”他说。 然而后果...

reflection.en: These elections occur in the shadow of a brutal war that has claimed countless lives. The cycle of violence, where aggression often begets further aggression, is a profound human tragedy. Romans 12:21 calls us to resist this destructive pattern, urging us to overcome evil not by mirroring it, but by choosing good, even when it is difficult.
reflection.zh: 此次选举在残酷战争的阴影下进行，这场战争已夺走无数生命。暴力循环，即侵略常常引发进一步的侵略，是一种深刻的人类悲剧。罗马书12:21呼吁我们抵制这种破坏性的模式，敦促我们不要以恶报恶，而是要以善胜恶，即使这很困难。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Why US plan to sell F-35 warplanes to Saudi Arabia is controversial
title.zh: 美国计划向沙特出售F-35战机为何引发争议

summary.en: Saudi Arabia has been seeking to purchase F-35 fighter jets from the US for years. The Trump administration approved the sale of nearly 50 of these advanced stealth aircraft, a move that has raised concerns among some members of Congress. The US had previously hesitated due to supplying similar advanced aircraft to...
summary.zh: 沙特阿拉伯多年来一直寻求购买美国的F-35战斗机。特朗普政府已批准向沙特出售近50架此类先进的隐形飞机，此举引发了部分国会议员的担忧。此前，美国曾因向其盟友以色列供应类似先进飞机而犹豫不决，因为根据美国法律，以色列有权获得比其地区邻国更先进的美国武器。国会有30天的时间来审查或阻止这笔约240亿美元的军售。

body.en:
President Donald Trump's administration says it has approved the sale of nearly 50 F-35 fighter jets to Saudi Arabia in a policy shift for the US that has raised concerns from some members of Congress.

Saudi Arabia has sought for years to buy the world's most advanced warplane, equipped with stealth technology that allows it to evade enemy detection.

Washington had resisted, partly because it supplies F-35s to its ally Israel, which is guaranteed under US law to receive top-of-the-range American weapons compared with those its regional neighbours can access.

Congress has 30 days to scrutinise or attempt to block the $24bn (£17.8bn) sale to Riyadh, which is the largest customer for US weapons.

Representative Raja Krishnamoorthi of Illinois, a Democrat, opposed the sale on Thursday.

He warned "it could put the crown jewels of American military technology within reach of the Chinese Communist Party".

Other Democratic lawmakers and some American defence officials have raised similar concerns about giving F-35s to Saudi Arabia.

They said Riyadh might share the sensitive technology with China under a security partnership between the two countries.

The state department said in announcing the deal on Thursday that it would support US "foreign policy and national security objectives".

It said the deal would improve "the security of a major non-Nato ally that is a force for political stability and economic progress in the Gulf region".

"The proposed ⁠sale of this equipment and support will not alter the military ⁠balance in the region," the state department added.

Trump has a close relationship with Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, who visited the White House last November.

The two also met in May last year in Riyadh, where a $142bn arms sale was sealed – described by the White House as the "largest defence sales agreement in history".

The latest proposed sale announced to Saudi Arabia would include 48 F-35s, which are built by the arms company Lockheed Martin.

This would place the country on a level with Israel, which currently has a fleet of 50 jets.

However, Israel's ministry of foreign affairs announced in May , external that it would procure another F-35 squadron.

This deal would double the size of Israel's F-35 fleet to 100, according to the Jerusalem Post , external .

Congress has previously questioned arms deals with Riyadh after the murder of Saudi journalist Jamal Khashoggi in 2018.

Former US President Joe Biden's administration considered supplying F-35s to Saudi Arabia if Riyadh would normalise its ⁠relations with Israel, but that diplomatic effort faltered.

The proposed sale comes as the Saudis are engaged in fighting with the Houthis, an Iran-backed armed group that controls much of western Yemen.

The Houthis have...
body.zh: 美国总统特朗普政府表示，已批准向沙特阿拉伯出售近 50 架 F-35 战斗机，这是美国的政策转变，这一转变引起了一些国会议员的担忧。 沙特阿拉伯多年来一直寻求购买世界上最先进的战机，配备隐形技术，使其能够逃避敌人的侦察。 华盛顿一直拒绝这样做，部分原因是它向盟友以色列提供F-35，根据美国法律，与该地区邻国相比，以色列可以得到最先进的美国武器。 国会有 30 天的时间来审查或试图阻止向利雅得出售价值 240 亿美元（178 亿英镑）的交易，利雅得是美国武器的最大客户。 伊利诺伊州民主党众议员 Raja Krishnamoorthi 周四反对此次出售。 他警告说，“这可能会让中国共产党触手可及的美国军事技术皇冠上的明珠”。 其他民主党议员和一些美国国防官员也对向沙特阿拉伯提供 F-35 提出了类似的担忧。 他们表示，利雅得可能会根据两国安全伙伴关系与中国分享敏感技术。 美国国务院在周四宣布该协议时表示，它将支持美国的“外交政策和国家安全目标”。 声明称，该协议将改善“一个主要非北约盟国的安全，该盟国是海湾地区政治稳定和经济进步的力量”。 美国国务院补充说：“拟议出售这些设备和支持不会改变该地区的军事平衡。” 特朗普与去年11月访问白宫的沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼关系密切。 两人去年 5 月还在利雅得会面，达成了价值 1,420 亿美元的军售协议 — — 白宫称其为“历史上最大的国防销售协议”。 最新宣布的向沙特阿拉伯出售的提案将包括 48 架 F-35，这些飞机由军火公司洛克希德·马丁公司制造。 这将使该国与以色列处于同一水平，后者目前拥有 50 架喷气式飞机。 不过，以色列外交部5月对外宣布将采购另一个F-35中队。 据《耶路撒冷邮报》报道，这笔交易将使以色列 F-35 机队规模增加一倍，达到 100 架。 2018 年沙特记者贾迈勒·卡舒吉 (Jamal Khashoggi) 被谋杀后，国会此前曾对与利雅得的军火交易提出质疑。 美国前总统乔·拜登政府考虑过，如果利雅得与以色列关系正常化，就向沙特阿拉伯提供 F-35，但这一外交努力却步履蹒跚。 此次出售计划正值沙特正与胡塞武装交战之际。胡塞武装是伊朗支持的武装组织，控制着也门西部的大部分地区。 胡塞武装已经...

reflection.en: The news of a potential $24 billion sale of advanced F-35 fighter jets to Saudi Arabia highlights the complex global arms trade. Isaiah's vision of nations beating their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks offers a stark contrast to this reality. It calls us to consider the human cost and the pursuit of peace over the proliferation of...
reflection.zh: 关于美国可能向沙特出售价值240亿美元的先进F-35战斗机的消息，凸显了复杂的全球军火贸易。以赛亚关于列国要把刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀的异象，与这一现实形成了鲜明对比。它促使我们思考武器扩散的人力成本以及对和平的追求。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Canadians dream of Europe as Carney floats longshot plan for living and working in EU
title.zh: 为什么加拿大人渴望与欧洲建立更紧密的关系

summary.en: Canadians are expressing enthusiasm for closer ties with the European Union, particularly the prospect of living, working, and studying within the EU. This sentiment was sparked by Prime Minister Mark Carney's recent speech proposing Canada become an "associate member" and urging deeper cooperation.
summary.zh: 加拿大人对与欧洲联盟建立更紧密关系的前景表示兴奋，特别是生活、工作和学习的机会。这一情绪源于总理马克·卡尼（Mark Carney）最近在演讲中提出的建议，希望加拿大成为其“准成员国”，并呼吁深化合作。

body.en:
Miriam Levin-Gold likes Prime Minister Mark Carney's idea of Canadians being able to live and work in the European Union under proposed closer ties with the trade bloc.

"I think that's great for young people to explore different parts of the world and work in different places and have different experiences," the commuter told the BBC in Toronto.

Canadians woke up to news of Carney's speech to the European Parliament in Strasbourg on Thursday morning, welcoming the EU's ambition for Canada to become its first "associate member" as he urged closer co-operation on defence and energy.

"We should deepen our people-to-people ties, allowing our youth to live, work and study where they want on either side of the Atlantic," the PM said.

He also suggested Canada could join Erasmus+, the EU's multi-billion scholarship programme.

Carney told MEPs that Canada and Europe were "stronger together" in the face of "geopolitical rupture".

But before Canadians start packing their bags - "associate member" status does not currently exist within the EU and could take years to implement, given that all 27 EU member states would have to approve such an arrangement.

Nevertheless, people the BBC spoke to were excited about the potential prospect of working and studying in the EU as news of Carney's speech spread.

Alex Nash, from Montreal, said closer ties would clear away the obstacles of work visas and permits.

"It would certainly be really nice for that to be easier, more convenient and to be able to visit more easily," she said.

One person on a Facebook group, A Canadian Outlook, said they would love the opportunity for their grandchildren to study at European universities for better rates. Another woman said it would make it much easier for the home she already owns in France.

"Snow birds are going to love it," another person said, referring to Canadians who head to warmer locations for winter.

The sentiments hint at dissatisfaction in Canada over bilateral tensions with the US.

Growing up in Canada, David Jardine thought of the US as not just a neighbour, but an epicentre of culture and cool.

"I remember wanting to go and visit New York all the time," he told the BBC after finishing his overnight shift, not far from one of Toronto's most iconic buildings, the CN tower.

But he's become a lot more sceptical in the light of US President Donald Trump's trade war with Canada and rhetoric about annexation.

"I would say I think not only does it make more sense to associate closely with Europe, it's a place that I would rather be associating with given the way things are these days," he said.

Maggie Stainton, who manages local pub C'est What in Toronto's St Lawrence Market district, became emotional when she spoke about Canada's frayed ties with the US.

body.zh: 米里亚姆·莱文-戈尔德（Miriam Levin-Gold）喜欢马克·卡尼总理的想法，即加拿大人能够在与欧盟建立更密切关系的情况下在欧盟生活和工作。 这位通勤者在多伦多告诉英国广播公司：“我认为这对于年轻人探索世界不同的地方、在不同的地方工作并获得不同的经历来说是件好事。” 周四早上，加拿大人一觉醒来就听到了卡尼在斯特拉斯堡欧洲议会发表讲话的消息，他对欧盟希望加拿大成为其第一个“准成员”的雄心表示欢迎，同时他敦促在国防和能源方面进行更密切的合作。 总理说：“我们应该深化两国人民之间的联系，让我们的年轻人能够在大西洋两岸他们想要的地方生活、工作和学习。” 卡尼告诉欧洲议会议员，面对“地缘政治破裂”，加拿大和欧洲“在一起更强大”。 但在加拿大人开始收拾行李之前，欧盟目前并不存在“准成员”地位，而且可能需要数年时间才能实施，因为这种安排必须得到所有 27 个欧盟成员国的批准。 尽管如此，随着卡尼演讲的消息传开，接受英国广播公司采访的人们对在欧盟工作和学习的潜在前景感到兴奋。 来自蒙特利尔的亚历克斯·纳什表示，更紧密的联系将消除工作签证和许可证的障碍。 她说：“如果能更轻松、更方便、更轻松地参观，那就太好了。” Facebook 群组“加拿大展望”中的一位人士表示，他们希望自己的孙子有机会以更优惠的价格在欧洲大学学习。另一位女士表示，这将使她在法国已有的房屋变得更加容易。 另一位人士说：“雪鸟会喜欢这里的。”他指的是前往温暖地区过冬的加拿大人。 这种情绪暗示加拿大对与美国的双边紧张关系感到不满。 大卫·贾丁（David Jardine）在加拿大长大，他认为美国不仅是一个邻居，而且是文化和时尚的中心。 “我记得一直想去纽约看看，”他在结束夜班后告诉英国广播公司，那里距离多伦多最具标志性的建筑之一——加拿大国家电视塔不远。 但鉴于美国总统唐纳德·特朗普与加拿大的贸易战以及有关吞并的言论，他变得更加怀疑。 他说：“我想说，我认为与欧洲密切联系不仅更有意义，而且鉴于目前的情况，我更愿意与欧洲建立联系。” 玛吉·斯坦顿 (Maggie Stainton) 是多伦多圣劳伦斯市场区当地酒吧 C'est What 的老板，当她谈到加拿大与美国的紧张关系时，她变得情绪激动。 “美国的局势太不稳定了，”她说。 “我觉得有一定的稳定性......

reflection.en: The desire to explore, work, and study abroad speaks to a deep human longing for growth and new experiences. Colossians 3:23 reminds us that whatever we do, whether in our home country or in a new land, should be done with dedication, as if working for a higher purpose. This principle can guide individuals as they seek opportunities for personal and...
reflection.zh: 渴望在国外探索、工作和学习，反映了人类对成长和新体验的深切渴望。歌罗西书3章23节提醒我们，无论做什么，无论是在自己的国家还是在新地方，都应尽心竭力，好像是为主而做。这一原则可以指导个人在跨越国界寻求个人和职业发展机会时。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Zara Larsson criticises White House for using her song in deportation video
title.zh: 扎拉·拉尔森批评白宫在其驱逐视频中使用她的歌曲

summary.en: Swedish pop star Zara Larsson has criticized the White House for using her song 'Midnight Sun' in a social media reel that appeared to depict immigration enforcement raids. Larsson called the video 'dehumanizing,' and the White House has since removed the song from the post.
summary.zh: 瑞典流行歌星扎拉·拉尔森批评白宫在其社交媒体短片中使用她的歌曲《午夜的太阳》，该短片似乎描绘了移民执法突袭。拉尔森称该视频“非人化”，白宫此后已从帖子中删除了该歌曲。

body.en:
Swedish pop star Zara Larsson has condemned the White House for using one of her most recognisable songs in a social media reel.

The clip used Larsson's Midnight Sun in a video appearing to show immigration enforcement raids. The song has since been removed from the post, but the video is still visible on the White House's TikTok feed.

The video is captioned "never ending deportations", riffing on Larsson's lyrics "never-ending midnight sun".

In a three-minute reaction video posted on social media, Larsson described the clip as "dehumanising", joining a growing list of singers, including Sabrina Carpenter and Ariana Grande, who have told the Trump administration to not use their music.

The reel splices together multiple videos of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents, as well as other US law enforcement personnel, handcuffing men and putting them into vehicles.

Larsson reposted part of the original clip, which then cuts to a selfie video of her using her fingers to hold an 'L' shape against her forehead.

In the reaction video that has already clocked up more than 4.2 million views on TikTok, she tells her followers the White House video is "so dehumanising".

"The vast majority of these people who are undocumented are regular people with jobs and they're just trying to have a better future".

"It's so crazy how everything is so memefied and so 'ha-ha-ha'," she says, accusing the White House of using her song to sow "division", despite the lyrics reflecting a connection between people and nature, according to Larsson.

Earlier this year, Larsson condemned a video of President Donald Trump dancing at various events overlayed with her hit Lush Life.

White House social media accounts have been forced to remove various songs from their feed following interventions from artists.

Taylor Swift's seasonal track August disappeared from a reel shared by the Trump administration in August, while one of Olivia Rodrigo's songs vanished from a video after the singer condemned its use for what she called "hateful propaganda".

Sabrina Carpenter and Ariana Grande have also warned the Trump administration in separate incidents to not use their music in social media content after the White House posted videos featuring their songs.
body.zh: 瑞典流行歌星扎拉·拉尔森谴责白宫在社交媒体上使用她最知名的歌曲之一。 该剪辑在一段视频中使用了拉尔森的《午夜太阳》，似乎显示了移民执法的突袭。这首歌已从帖子中删除，但白宫的 TikTok 上仍然可以看到该视频。 该视频的标题是“永无止境的驱逐”，重复了拉尔森的歌词“永无止境的午夜阳光”。 在社交媒体上发布的一段三分钟的反应视频中，拉尔森将这段视频描述为“非人性化”，她加入了越来越多的歌手行列，其中包括萨布丽娜·卡彭特和爱莉安娜·格兰德，他们告诉特朗普政府不要使用他们的音乐。 该卷轴将移民和海关执法局（ICE）特工以及其他美国执法人员的多段视频拼接在一起，将男子戴上手铐并放入车辆中。 拉尔森转发了原始剪辑的一部分，然后剪辑成了她用手指在额头上按“L”形的自拍视频。 在 TikTok 上观看次数已超过 420 万次的反应视频中，她告诉粉丝，白宫视频“非常不人道”。 “这些无证人员中的绝大多数都是有工作的普通人，他们只是想拥有更美好的未来”。 “这太疯狂了，一切都如此模因化，如此‘哈哈哈’，”她说，并指责白宫利用她的歌曲散布“分裂”，尽管歌词反映了人与自然之间的联系，据拉尔森说。 今年早些时候，拉尔森谴责了唐纳德·特朗普总统在各种活动中跳舞的视频，并配上了她的热门歌曲《Lush Life》。 在艺术家的干预下，白宫社交媒体帐户被迫从其源中删除多首歌曲。 泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 的季节性歌曲《八月》(August) 从特朗普政府 8 月分享的一首歌中消失了，而奥利维亚·罗德里戈 (Olivia Rodrigo) 的一首歌曲也从视频中消失，此前这位歌手谴责该歌曲被用于她所说的“仇恨宣传”。 在白宫发布包含她们歌曲的视频后，萨布丽娜·卡彭特和爱莉安娜·格兰德也在不同事件中警告特朗普政府不要在社交媒体内容中使用她们的音乐。

reflection.en: The White House's use of Zara Larsson's song in a video about 'never-ending deportations' prompted her criticism that the clip was 'dehumanising.' This highlights how music can shape perceptions, and how its use in contexts of enforcement can feel deeply alienating. The ancient call to love the foreigner as yourself, found in Deuteronomy, reminds us to...
reflection.zh: 白宫在关于“永无止境的驱逐”的视频中使用扎拉·拉尔森的歌曲，引发了她对该片段“非人化”的批评。这凸显了音乐如何塑造观念，以及在执法背景下使用音乐会带来多么疏离的感觉。申命记中呼吁爱客旅如爱自己那样古老的诫命，提醒我们在处理这些敏感问题时要怀有同情心和对人类尊严的尊重。

verse.textEn: And you are to love those who are foreigners, for you yourselves were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要怜爱寄居的，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: This Olympic river has 500 crocodiles in it - but that's not the main concern
title.zh: 这条奥运河流有 500 条鳄鱼——但这并非主要担忧

summary.en: The Fitzroy River in Queensland, Australia, has been chosen as the venue for the 2032 Olympic rowing and canoe sprint events. Despite concerns about the river's inhabitants, including 500 crocodiles, the course has passed a technical assessment and been deemed safe for athletes.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚昆士兰州的菲茨罗伊河已被选为 2032 年奥运会赛艇和皮划艇冲刺项目的比赛场地。尽管人们对河中栖息着约 500 条鳄鱼感到担忧，但该赛道已通过技术评估，并被认定对运动员是安全和公平的。

body.en:
The annual rowing regatta for schools in the Australian state of Queensland usually passes off without too much attention.

This weekend more than 600 of the state's most promising teenage rowers are battling it out on the crocodile-inhabited Fitzroy River, in the city of Rockhampton.

"We've never had any media wanting to attend before," Anthea O'Loughlin, head of Rowing Queensland, tells the BBC.

But this year is different. In six years' time, the 2032 Brisbane Olympics and Paralympics are set to stage rowing and canoe sprint events in this very stretch of water, which has just passed a technical assessment and been endorsed as safe and fair for athletes.

While sightings of saltwater crocodiles on the river – which number around 500 and can grow to four metres (13ft) long – are not uncommon, state government files going back more than 40 years record no attacks by the reptiles on humans.

And though influential figures at last month's World Rowing congress in Amsterdam made occasional references to "safety", the presence of the reptiles was not their chief concern.

"Fairness" is what's been raised with British Rowing's chief executive Tom Solesbury – a reference to the tidal river's natural bends and currents, which many in the rowing community say make it unsuitable for elite competition.

Drew Ginn, who has won three Olympic gold medals for Australia in rowing, told the BBC he had concerns over potential flooding and "fairness and integrity" at the venue.

"Personally, I'm not fearful of the Australian animals but I've never had a crocodile near me," he said.

"I'm sure I'd row faster, I'm sure all the athletes would row faster. That's on the list of concerns, I don't think it's the highest priority in concerns but it was certainly cited very early on."

The German rowing body's president Moritz Petri said athletes had also questioned the sustainability of holding the event some 600km (373 miles) from Brisbane.

But the "so-called impediments" got short shrift from the most senior politician in Queensland, state premier David Crisafulli, who reached for less diplomatic language.

"Let's be honest, let's scratch beneath the surface and call it for what it is," he said days after the Amsterdam meeting.

"It is a group of interstate and overseas elites who are trying to bully their way because they don't want to go to regional Queensland and that's not right."

Rowing chiefs contacted by the BBC before Thursday's decision declined to comment directly on Crisafulli's "elites" remarks.

But both Petri and Simon Wickham, chief executive of Rowing New Zealand, said their concerns had nothing to do with regional or urban preference but with competitors getting fair racing.

Petri added it was about what's best for their athletes who will train four...
body.zh: 澳大利亚昆士兰州学校一年一度的赛艇比赛通常不会引起太多关注。 每年，该州 600 多名最有前途的青少年赛艇运动员都会在鳄鱼栖息的罗克汉普顿市菲茨罗伊河上展开角逐。 昆士兰赛艇协会负责人安西娅·奥洛林 (Anthea O'Loughlin) 告诉英国广播公司 (BBC)，“从来没有任何媒体愿意参加这里。” 但今年有所不同。六年后，2032 年布里斯班奥运会和残奥会将在这片刚刚通过技术评估并被认为对运动员安全、公平的水域举办赛艇和皮划艇短跑比赛。 虽然河上出现的咸水鳄鱼数量约 500 条，长度可达 4 米（13 英尺），这种情况并不少见，但 40 多年前的州政府文件没有记录这些爬行动物袭击人类的记录。 尽管上个月在阿姆斯特丹举行的世界赛艇大会上有影响力的人物偶尔提到“安全”，但爬行动物的存在并不是他们主要关心的问题。 英国赛艇协会首席执行官汤姆·索尔斯伯里提出的“公平”指的是潮汐河的自然弯曲和水流，许多赛艇界人士表示，这使其不适合精英比赛。 为澳大利亚赢得三枚奥运会赛艇金牌的德鲁·吉恩 (Drew Ginn) 告诉 BBC 电台，他对可能发生的洪水以及场馆的“公平和诚信”感到担忧。 “就我个人而言，我并不害怕澳大利亚的动物，但我附近从未有过鳄鱼，”他说。 “我确信我会划得更快，我确信所有运动员都会划得更快。这在担忧清单上，我不认为这是最优先考虑的问题，但它肯定很早就被引用了。” 德国赛艇协会主席莫里茨·佩特里表示，运动员们还质疑在距离布里斯班约 600 公里（373 英里）处举办赛事的可持续性。 但昆士兰州最高级别政治家、州州长戴维·克里萨富利(David Crisafulli)对这些“所谓的障碍”不屑一顾，他使用了不那么外交的语言。 “说实话，让我们深入了解它的本质，”他在阿姆斯特丹会议几天后说道。 “这是一群州际和海外精英试图欺凌他们的方式，因为他们不想去昆士兰地区，这是不对的。” 在周四的决定之前，英国广播公司联系的赛艇负责人拒绝直接对克里萨富利的“精英”言论发表评论。 但新西兰赛艇协会首席执行官佩特里和西蒙·威克姆均表示，他们的担忧与地区或城市偏好无关，而是与参赛者获得公平比赛有关。 佩特里补充说，这是关于什么对他们的运动员来说是最好的，他们将训练四年......

reflection.en: The Fitzroy River, home to 500 crocodiles, is set to host the 2032 Olympic rowing and canoe sprint events. This news brings to mind the dedication and discipline required for athletic competition, reminding us that even in challenging environments, human endeavor can strive for excellence. May athletes and organizers approach this unique venue with both...
reflection.zh: 拥有 500 条鳄鱼的菲茨罗伊河将成为 2032 年奥运会赛艇和皮划艇冲刺项目的举办地。这一消息令人联想到竞技体育所需的奉献和纪律，提醒我们即使在充满挑战的环境中，人类的努力也能追求卓越。愿运动员和组织者在以尊重其野生居民的态度来对待这个独特的场地时，也能秉持公平竞赛的精神。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verse.textZh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。

title.en: 'I am learning': HYROX athlete apologises and withdraws after viral defecation incident
title.zh: “我正在学习”：HYROX运动员在排便事件走红后道歉并退赛

summary.en: Australian athlete Joanna Wietrzyk has apologized and withdrawn from the HYROX race in Beijing after footage of her defecating during the event went viral internationally. She stated, 'I want to offer my sincere apology to the people of China, my fellow competitors, the spectators and the HYROX organizers for what...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚运动员乔安娜·维特日克（Joanna Wietrzyk）在比赛中排便的视频在国际上走红后，已道歉并从北京的HYROX比赛中退赛。她表示：“我想就比赛期间发生的事情，向中国人民、我的参赛选手、观众以及HYROX组织者致以诚挚的歉意。”

body.en:
The Australian athlete at the centre of the HYROX defecation controversy has apologised and retroactively withdrawn from the race after footage of the incident went viral internationally.

Social media footage showed Australian athlete Joanna Wietrzyk, who holds the women's HYROX solo pro world record, competing at exercise stations with faeces on her legs during a race in Beijing over the weekend.

In a statement posted to Instagram on Thursday night, Wietrzyk apologised for her decision to continue competing.

"I want to offer my sincere apology to the people of China, my fellow competitors, the spectators and the HYROX organizers for what happened during the race in Beijing," she wrote.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I felt completely fit and healthy at the start of the race, with no reason to expect any illness. Looking back, I regret the decision to not have stepped off the track.

"I recognize that I should have made a different choice. I take responsibility for my decision to continue and am deeply sorry for the discomfort and disruption it caused."

Wietrzyk also announced that she would forfeit the points she earned as the competition winner.

"I am learning from this experience and will carry those lessons with me, including remembering that there is more to life than racing and knowing when it is right to step away," she said.

"On reflection, I have decided to retroactively withdraw from the race and forfeit the points I earned."

Ending her statement, Wietrzyk said: "Thank you to those standing by me, both as an athlete and as a person, during this time, and to everyone who has reached out with kindness and support.

"It means more to me than I can properly express right now. I will be taking some time to recover, reflect and look after myself and my family away from the noise."

HYROX is a fitness and endurance race that combines 8km of running with exercises such as rowing, sled pushes and wall balls, carried out in indoor exhibition halls.

Wietrzyk initially shared a selfie on her Instagram story after the race, which showed her lying down with an intravenous line in her arm. It was captioned: "Go hard or go home they say ... a win is a win".

Multiple media outlets also reported that Wietrzyk's major sponsor, Puma, was distancing itself from the athlete after their collaborative line appeared to be quietly removed from the sportswear giant's website a day ago.

The page has since been restored online, with a Puma spokesperson telling CBC News that some landing pages were "unintentionally taken offline".

The incident has prompted backlash and criticism of HYROX's health and safety standards, with many wondering why Wietrzyk...
body.zh: 在该事件的视频在国际上疯传后，处于 HYROX 排便争议中心的澳大利亚运动员已道歉并追溯退出比赛。 社交媒体视频显示，周末在北京举行的一场比赛中，保持着女子 HYROX 单人职业世界纪录的澳大利亚运动员乔安娜·维茨克 (Joanna Wietrzyk) 在训练站进行比赛，腿上沾满粪便。 周四晚上，维茨克在 Instagram 上发布了一份声明，为自己继续参赛的决定道歉。 她写道：“我想就北京比赛期间发生的事情向中国人民、我的竞争对手、观众和 HYROX 组织者表示诚挚的歉意。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “比赛开始时我感觉完全健康，没有理由预期会生病。回想起来，我很遗憾没有离开赛道的决定。 “我认识到我应该做出不同的选择。我对我继续的决定负责，并对由此造成的不适和干扰深表歉意。” Wietrzyk 还宣布她将放弃作为比赛获胜者获得的积分。 她说：“我正在从这次经历中学习，并将随身携带这些教训，包括记住生活不仅仅是比赛，而且知道什么时候离开是正确的。” “经过深思熟虑，我决定追溯退出比赛，并放弃我获得的积分。” 维茨克在结束发言时表示：“感谢在这段时间里站在我身边的人，无论是作为一名运动员还是作为一个人，以及所有伸出善意和支持的人。 “这对我来说意义重大，我现在无法正确表达。我将花一些时间来恢复、反思并照顾自己和家人，远离噪音。” HYROX 是一项健身耐力赛，将 8 公里跑步与划船、推雪橇和墙球等练习结合起来，在室内展厅进行。 比赛结束后，Wietrzyk 最初在她的 Instagram 故事上分享了一张自拍照，照片中她躺着，手臂上插着静脉注射线。标题是：“他们说，要么努力，要么回家……胜利就是胜利”。 多家媒体还报道称，维茨克的主要赞助商彪马正在与这位运动员保持距离，因为一天前他们的合作系列似乎已从这家运动服装巨头的网站上悄悄删除。 该页面现已恢复上线，彪马发言人告诉加拿大广播公司新闻，一些登陆页面“无意中离线”。 该事件引发了对 HYROX 健康和安全标准的强烈反对和批评，许多人想知道为什么 Wietrzyk...

reflection.en: The rapid spread of footage showing Joanna Wietrzyk's unfortunate incident in Beijing serves as a stark reminder of how quickly actions can become public and subject to immediate judgment in the digital age. Her apology and withdrawal demonstrate a willingness to take responsibility, even after the fact, for a choice made under pressure.
reflection.zh: 乔安娜·维特日克在北京比赛中发生的不幸事件的视频迅速传播，鲜明地提醒我们，在数字时代，行为可以多么迅速地公开并受到即时评判。她的道歉和退赛表明，即使事后，她也愿意为在压力下做出的选择承担责任。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Russian birth tourism to Brazil increases
title.zh: 俄罗斯生育旅游涌向巴西

summary.en: An increasing number of Russians are traveling to Brazil to give birth, a trend that has grown since Russia's invasion of Ukraine and stricter regulations in Argentina. Children born in Brazil automatically receive Brazilian nationality, offering a pathway to citizenship for Russian families.
summary.zh: 自俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰以及阿根廷收紧规定以来，越来越多的俄罗斯人选择前往巴西生育，他们的孩子将获得巴西国籍。

body.en:
Since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine and stricter regulations in Argentina, more and more Russians are choosing to travel to Brazil to give birth to children, who will obtain Brazilian nationality.

Yulia and Dmitri (whose names have been changed for reasons of safety) flew from Russia to Brazil this summer so that their child could be born there. Yulia was 32 weeks pregnant at the time of travel.

"Of course, we didn't say that I was pregnant at border control," Yulia told DW.

Her daughter was born at a private clinic in Santos, a city in southern Brazil. Anybody born in the country has an automatic right to Brazilian nationality. The family is currently preparing all the paperwork.

"We've achieved our minimum goal," said Dmitri. "With a Brazilian passport, our daughter will be able to travel without a visa to almost any country in the world. She won't have to apply for an expensive and time-consuming Schengen visa. We want her to be able to decide for herself where she studies, works or lives."

He said that a colleague of his had traveled to Brazil in early August with his pregnant wife for the same reasons.

Yulia and Dmitri said that they had spent the equivalent of about €10,000 (about $11,500) during the first six weeks of their stay in Brazil, which included the costs for several days of treatment for their daughter in intensive care. Dmitri quit his job at a bank for the trip and hopes to find work again after the family returns to their home in the Russian capital Moscow.

However, they are only planning to return once all the documents for their daughter are ready and that could take months. Other Russian families have decided to stay in Brazil permanently.

According to organizations and lawyers that provide support to Russians in Brazil, there has been an increase in immigration from Russia, particularly since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022 , after which visa requirements for Russian nationals entering certain countries were tightened.

Birth tourism to Brazil has also increased since Argentina , which used to be one of the main destinations for people wanting their children to be born in a country that automatically grants citizenship to newborns, tightened its regulations. People who want their children to obtain Argentinian citizenship now have to have resided in Argentina for at least two years. Since 2025, the access of people who do not have a permanent residence permit to free healthcare has also been restricted.

According to the Russian news outlet RBC, more than 7,000 Russians applied for a residence permit in Argentina in 2023. By mid-2025, the number had decreased to about 1,800.

Meanwhile, almost 500 Brazilian passports were issued to Russians in 2024 and more than 600 the following year. More...
body.zh: 自俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰以及阿根廷监管收紧以来，越来越多的俄罗斯人选择前往巴西生子，并获得巴西国籍。 尤利娅和德米特里（出于安全原因，化名）今年夏天从俄罗斯飞往巴西，以便他们的孩子在那里出生。旅行时尤利娅已怀孕 32 周。 “当然，我们并没有在边境管制时说我怀孕了，”尤利娅告诉德国之声。 她的女儿出生在巴西南部城市桑托斯的一家私人诊所。任何在该国出生的人都自动享有巴西国籍的权利。目前，家人正在准备所有文件。 “我们已经实现了最低目标，”德米特里说。 “有了巴西护照，我们的女儿将能够免签证前往世界上几乎任何国家。她不必申请昂贵且耗时的申根签证。我们希望她能够自己决定在哪里学习、工作或生活。” 他说，他的一位同事出于同样的原因，于八月初带着怀孕的妻子前往巴西。 尤利娅和德米特里说，他们在巴西逗留的前六周内花费了约10,000欧元（约11,500美元），其中包括女儿在重症监护室几天的治疗费用。德米特里为了这次旅行辞去了在银行的工作，并希望在全家返回俄罗斯首都莫斯科的家后再次找到工作。 然而，他们只计划在女儿的所有文件准备好后返回，这可能需要几个月的时间。其他俄罗斯家庭已决定永久留在巴西。 据为巴西俄罗斯人提供支持的组织和律师称，来自俄罗斯的移民数量有所增加，特别是自2022年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰以来，俄罗斯公民进入某些国家的签证要求收紧。 阿根廷曾是希望孩子在自动授予新生儿公民身份的国家出生的人们的主要目的地之一，但自从阿根廷收紧了法规以来，前往巴西的生育旅游也有所增加。现在，希望孩子获得阿根廷公民身份的人必须在阿根廷居住至少两年。自2025年起，没有永久居留许可的人获得免费医疗服务也受到限制。 据俄罗斯新闻媒体RBC报道，2023年有超过7000名俄罗斯人在阿根廷申请居留许可。到2025年中期，这一数字已减少至约1800人。 与此同时，2024 年向俄罗斯人发放了近 500 本巴西护照，次年又发放了 600 多本。更多的...

reflection.en: The desire for security and a better future for one's children is a powerful human drive. This news highlights how families navigate complex global circumstances, seeking opportunities for their offspring. The Psalmist reminds us that children are a gift from Yahweh, a heritage to be cherished and protected, regardless of the borders they cross.
reflection.zh: 为子女寻求安全和更美好未来的愿望是一种强大的人类驱动力。这则新闻凸显了家庭如何在复杂的全球环境中穿梭，为后代寻求机会。诗人提醒我们，子女是雅伟所赐的产业，是值得珍惜和保护的，无论他们跨越何种国界。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: A war-fatigued and anxious Russia picks a new parliament
title.zh: 饱受战争之苦、焦虑不安的俄罗斯迎来新议会

summary.en: Fuel shortages, drone strikes, and rumors of mobilization are increasing anxiety and war fatigue among Russians. As support for peace talks grows, the Kremlin is closely monitoring the situation ahead of parliamentary elections. Nearly half of those surveyed report a prevailing sense of alarm, and 60% believe the war...
summary.zh: 燃料短缺、无人机袭击和动员传言正在加剧俄罗斯民众的焦虑和战争疲劳。随着和平谈判的支持率不断上升，克里姆林宫在议会选举前密切关注着局势。近一半的受访者表示，普遍存在一种警惕感，60%的人认为乌克兰战争对他们的日常生活产生了负面影响。

body.en:
Fuel shortages, drone strikes and mobilization rumors are fueling anxiety and war fatigue in Russia. As support for peace talks grows among Russians, the Kremlin is watching closely ahead of parliamentary elections.

Russians are increasingly anxious . Nearly half of those surveyed by state pollster FOM say a sense of alarm is the prevailing mood among the people around them.

According to data by independent pollster ExtremeScan , 60% of Russians believe that the war against Ukraine has had negative consequences for their day-to-day lives. 

"Anxiety and war fatigue are driven by increasing uncertainty," Margarita Zavadskaya, a sociologist and senior research fellow at the Finnish Institute of International Affairs in Helsinki, told DW.

She says this year has seen a shift in public opinion. Rising prices, internet crackdowns, fuel shortages caused by Ukrainian strikes on oil refineries and rumors of another mobilization drive are making it harder for Russians to plan for the future. Some are even leaving the country, afraid they could be drafted after the elections.

Sociologist and the founder of ExtremeScan Elena Koneva said people were starting to ask the question: "How much does this war cost me and my family? And am I ready to pay this price? "

From September 18 to 20, Russians are voting for a new parliament (the State Duma) for the first time since 2022. It's the first parliamentary election to take place in Russia during the Ukraine war. And although there are unlikely to be any surprises in the official results, the Kremlin will be closely monitoring turnout.

"The Kremlin is confident it can fabricate whatever figures it needs. The question is how high of a price it will have to pay," said Zavadskaya.

Although elections in authoritarian systems like that of Russian President Vladimir Putin  have little to do with democratic change, they still serve an important purpose. They are a reality check on whether the population remains loyal. And for Putin, that is especially important right now.

"They are crucial for him because they demonstrate that the majority supports the main party, the party of war, and that he has legitimacy for further escalation and the continuation of this war," Russian opposition politician in exile Ilya Yashin told DW.

In the fifth year of the war in Ukraine, there is little sign the Kremlin is willing to end the conflict. United Russia, a party de facto led by Putin, is campaigning on a platform that lists victory in the war among its priorities. Its candidate list is headed by people presented as veterans of the war against Ukraine.

"The silent majority just wants the war to end," opposition politician Yulia Galyamina, who still lives in...
body.zh: 燃料短缺、无人机袭击和动员谣言正在加剧俄罗斯的焦虑和战争疲劳。随着俄罗斯人对和平谈判的支持不断增加，克里姆林宫正在议会选举前密切关注。 俄罗斯人越来越着急。国家民意调查机构 FOM 的调查显示，近一半的受访者表示，他们周围的人普遍存在一种恐慌感。 根据独立民意调查机构ExtremeScan的数据，60%的俄罗斯人认为针对乌克兰的战争给他们的日常生活带来了负面影响。 赫尔辛基芬兰国际事务研究所社会学家兼高级研究员玛格丽塔·扎瓦德斯卡娅 (Margarita Zavadskaya) 告诉德国之声：“日益增加的不确定性引发了焦虑和战争疲劳。” 她说今年公众舆论发生了转变。价格上涨、互联网打击、乌克兰炼油厂罢工造成的燃料短缺以及另一场动员活动的传言，都让俄罗斯人更难为未来做好计划。有些人甚至离开该国，担心选举后可能被征召入伍。 社会学家兼 ExtremeScan 创始人 Elena Koneva 表示，人们开始问这样一个问题：“这场战争让我和我的家人付出了多少代价？我准备好付出这个代价了吗？” 9 月 18 日至 20 日，俄罗斯民众将投票选出新议会（国家杜马），这是自 2022 年以来的首次。这是乌克兰战争期间俄罗斯举行的首次议会选举。 尽管官方结果不太可能出现任何意外，但克里姆林宫将密切关注投票率。 扎瓦德斯卡娅说：“克里姆林宫有信心能够捏造任何需要的数字。问题是它必须付出多大的代价。” 尽管像俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京这样的专制制度下的选举与民主变革关系不大，但它们仍然具有重要的目的。它们是对人们是否仍然忠诚的现实检验。 对于普京来说，这现在尤其重要。 俄罗斯流亡反对派政治家伊利亚·亚辛（Ilya Yashin）告诉德国之声：“这些对他来说至关重要，因为它们表明大多数人支持主要政党，即战争政党，并且他有进一步升级和继续这场战争的合法性。” 乌克兰战争已进入第五个年头，几乎没有迹象表明克里姆林宫愿意结束冲突。事实上由普京领导的统一俄罗斯党正在以赢得战争为首要任务的纲领进行竞选活动。其候选人名单中以对乌克兰战争的退伍军人为首。 “沉默的大多数只是希望战争结束，”反对派政治家尤利娅·加利亚米纳（Yulia Galyamina）仍然住在……

reflection.en: The pervasive anxiety and war fatigue described in Russia, with 60% of citizens feeling the negative impact of the conflict, speaks to a deep human longing for peace. Psalm 46:9 offers a vision of hope, stating that Yahweh will put an end to wars. This divine promise can be a source of comfort amidst the weariness and uncertainty felt by so many.
reflection.zh: 报道中描述的俄罗斯普遍存在的焦虑和战争疲劳，以及60%的公民感受到冲突的负面影响，这反映了人类对和平的深切渴望。《诗篇》46:9篇提供了一个充满希望的愿景，指出雅伟将止息战争。在如此多人感受到的疲惫和不确定中，这一神圣的应许可以成为一种安慰。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: Smuggling suspected as more rare animals seen in India
title.zh: 印度发现更多珍稀动物，疑似走私活动加剧

summary.en: Orangutans, rare reptiles, and other exotic animals are increasingly being found in India, suggesting the country is becoming a significant hub for trafficked wildlife. Recently, five infant orangutans, native to Indonesian islands, were discovered by rangers in India's Odisha state, prompting an inquiry from...
summary.zh: 红毛猩猩、稀有爬行动物和其他外来动物在印度日益增多，这表明该国正成为野生动物走私的重要目的地。最近，印度东部奥里萨邦的护林员在巴拉索尔地区发现五只幼年红毛猩猩，它们原产于印度尼西亚的岛屿，此发现已引起印度尼西亚林业部的关注。

body.en:
Orangutans, rare reptiles and other exotic animals are popping up in India, suggesting the country is becoming a major destination for trafficked wildlife.

Five infant orangutans, a species found only on the  Indonesian   island of Sumatra and on Borneo, were found in a forest by rangers patrolling in the Balasore district of India's eastern Odisha state last week.

Indonesia's Forestry Ministry has asked India to establish the origin of the abandoned orangutans, known for their shaggy red fur, and return them if they are found to have come from their usual habitat abroad.

The rescue of the rare apes has raised fresh questions about how exotic animals enter India and how the country is used in the illegal wildlife trade.

"The discovery on the eastern coast of India is a bit mind-boggling. It's like that time a few years ago when live kangaroos were found wandering along the highways of West Bengal," Kanitha Krishnasamy, Southeast Asia director at wildlife trade monitoring network TRAFFIC, told DW.

"What are orangutans doing in India? Were they smuggled from their native Malaysia or Indonesia or did they come from a facility?" she asked.

The Odisha government has asked the Wildlife Crime Control Bureau to investigate how the critically endangered animals reached the state. 

"These animals are not found in India and are mostly seen in the rainforests of Malaysia, Indonesia, Borneo and Sumatra in Southeast Asia," said Odisha's Forest and Environment Minister Ganesh Ram Singh Khuntia.

"We suspect that they might have been released in the Balasore district forest… by an international wildlife smuggling racket."

The orangutans are the latest in a series of exotic wildlife being seized in India.

In November 2024, authorities in the Indian city of Bengaluru seized 40 rare animals arriving from the Malaysian capital, Kuala Lumpur, including Aldabra giant tortoises, gibbons, American alligators and iguanas.

In June 2025, Mumbai Customs seized 284 exotic animals arriving in four consignments from the Thai capital, Bangkok, including snakes and tortoises.

In July 2025, customs officials in the Indian city of Pune intercepted 20 exotic animals from passengers arriving from Bangkok. They included 14 green tree pythons, four double-eyed fig parrots and two Sumatran striped rabbits. 

According to figures from TRAFFIC, 7,272 individual animals, alive and dead, were seized from passenger baggage in smuggling attempts between Thailand and India between January 2022 and May 2025, with more than 80% of interceptions taking place in India.

The animals included reptiles, birds and mammals — many apparently destined for the exotic pet trade.

"We have found hundreds of species and thousands of individuals being trafficked into India through...
body.zh: 红毛猩猩、稀有爬行动物和其他外来动物在印度不断出现，表明该国正在成为贩运野生动物的主要目的地。 上周，护林员在印度东部奥里萨邦巴拉索尔地区巡逻时，在森林中发现了五只仅在印度尼西亚苏门答腊岛和婆罗洲发现的猩猩幼崽。 印度尼西亚林业部已要求印度确定这些被遗弃的猩猩的来源，如果发现它们来自国外的惯常栖息地，则将其归还。这些猩猩以其蓬松的红色皮毛而闻名。 对稀有猿类的救援引发了新的问题：外来动物如何进入印度以及该国如何被用于非法野生动物贸易。 “印度东海岸的这一发现有点令人难以置信。就像几年前在西孟加拉邦的高速公路上发现活袋鼠一样，”野生动物贸易监测网络TRAFFIC东南亚主任Kanitha Krishnasamy告诉德国之声。 “猩猩在印度做什么？它们是从家乡马来西亚或印度尼西亚走私来的，还是来自某个设施？”她问道。 奥里萨邦政府已要求野生动物犯罪控制局调查这些极度濒危动物是如何到达该州的。 奥里萨邦森林和环境部长加内什·拉姆·辛格·昆蒂亚 (Ganesh Ram Singh Khuntia) 表示：“这些动物在印度没有发现，主要出现在马来西亚、印度尼西亚、婆罗洲和东南亚苏门答腊岛的雨林中。” “我们怀疑它们可能是被国际野生动物走私团伙释放到巴拉索尔地区森林中的。” 这些猩猩是印度查获的一系列外来野生动物中最新的一种。 2024年11月，印度班加罗尔当局查获了从马来西亚首都吉隆坡运来的40只珍稀动物，包括亚达伯拉象龟、长臂猿、美洲短吻鳄和鬣蜥。 2025 年 6 月，孟买海关查获了从泰国首都曼谷运来的四批货物中的 284 只珍奇动物，其中包括蛇和乌龟。 2025 年 7 月，印度浦那市的海关官员从曼谷抵达的旅客中截获了 20 只珍奇动物。其中包括 14 条绿树蟒、四只双眼无花果鹦鹉和两只苏门答腊条纹兔。 根据 TRAFFIC 的数据，2022 年 1 月至 2025 年 5 月期间，在泰国和印度之间的走私活动中，从乘客行李中查获了 7,272 只活的和死的动物，其中超过 80% 的拦截发生在印度。 这些动物包括爬行动物、鸟类和哺乳动物——许多显然是注定要进行外来宠物贸易的。 “我们发现数百个物种和数千个个体通过......被贩运到印度。

reflection.en: The discovery of abandoned orangutans and other exotic animals in India points to a hidden trade that exploits vulnerable creatures. These animals, far from their natural homes, are voiceless victims of trafficking. We are called to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves, advocating for the protection of the innocent and the vulnerable, whether...
reflection.zh: 在印度发现被遗弃的红毛猩猩和其他外来动物，揭示了一个剥削弱势生物的隐秘交易。这些动物远离家园，是走私案中无声的受害者。我们蒙召要为那些不能为自己发声的生命说话，倡导保护无辜和弱势者，无论他们是人还是动物。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: ‘Forcing a reckoning’: How Asia is preparing for a ‘supersized’ El Niño
title.zh: 亚洲如何为“巨型”厄尔尼诺现象做准备

summary.en: Governments across Asia are urgently preparing for the most severe El Niño event on record, anticipating widespread droughts, wildfires, typhoons, and floods. This extreme weather, exacerbated by human-driven climate change, is expected to bring multiple crises, including heat, heavy rain, and food shortages, to...
summary.zh: 亚洲各国政府正紧急为有记录以来最严重的厄尔尼诺现象做准备，预计将出现大范围的干旱、野火、台风和洪水。这种由人为气候变化加剧的极端天气，预计将从现在到2027年给数亿人带来包括高温、暴雨和粮食短缺在内的多重危机。

body.en: From Sri Lanka to South Korea, governments are preparing for droughts, wildfires, typhoons and floods – with climate plans facing their biggest challenge to date Asian governments are rushing preparations for the most severe El Niño weather event on record, with hundreds of millions of people bracing for multiple crises at once as extreme heat, heavy rain and food shortages hit the region. Fuelled by exceptionally warm ocean conditions across the tropical Pacific – and developing alongside the human-driven climate crisis – El Niño is virtually guaranteed to grow to a very strong intensity towards the end of this year and into 2027. Continue reading...
body.zh: 从斯里兰卡到韩国，各国政府正在为干旱、野火、台风和洪水做准备——气候计划面临迄今为止最大的挑战。亚洲各国政府正在加紧准备，应对有记录以来最严重的厄尔尼诺天气事件，随着极端高温、暴雨和粮食短缺袭击该地区，数亿人同时面临多重危机。在热带太平洋异常温暖的海洋条件的推动下，并与人类造成的气候危机一起发展，厄尔尼诺现象几乎肯定会在今年年底和 2027 年增长到非常强烈的强度。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As Asia braces for the impacts of a 'supersized' El Niño, the scale of potential devastation—droughts, wildfires, floods—underscores humanity's vulnerability to natural forces. In such times, the ancient words of Psalm 46:1 offer a profound reminder: 'God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.' This truth offers solace and a call to...
reflection.zh: 随着亚洲为“巨型”厄尔尼诺现象的影响做准备，潜在破坏的规模——干旱、野火、洪水——凸显了人类在自然力量面前的脆弱性。在这样的时刻，诗篇46:1古老的言语提供了一个深刻的提醒：“雅伟是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是患难中随时的帮助。”这个真理在风暴聚集之时，为人们提供了慰藉，并呼唤人们寻求坚定不移的希望。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Wife of US scholar jailed in China asks Trump to raise arrest at Xi meeting
title.zh: 被囚中国学者之妻请求特朗普在与习近平会晤时提及逮捕事件

summary.en: Sylvia Zin is among the family members of people imprisoned in China who are seeking Trump's help when he hosts the country's leader next week.
summary.zh: 西尔维娅·津是中国被监禁者的家属之一，她希望在下周美国总统特朗普接待中国领导人时获得他的帮助。

body.en:
The wife of a US scholar imprisoned in China on charges of spying and endangering national security has asked President Donald Trump to secure his release when he meets Chinese President Xi Jinping at the White House next week.

U Min Zin, the director at a think tank focused on Myanmar, was arrested on 3 June after travelling to the Chinese city of Kunming for an academic conference.

"I'm deeply hopeful that President Trump will raise my husband's case with President Xi Jinping at the summit next week," his wife, Sylvia Zin, testified to Congress on Wednesday.

Xi is due to arrive for a state visit to Washington DC on Wednesday. It comes after Xi hosted Trump for a visit to Beijing in May.

Ahead of the meeting, families of prisoners being held in China have travelled to the US capital to advocate for their release.

Sylvia Zin appeared before the House Foreign Affairs Committee East Asia and Pacific Subcommittee on Wednesday for a hearing titled Lives, Not Leverage: The Long Arm of China and North Korea's Repression.

In her remarks, Zin said she believed Trump would also be able to secure the release of Chen Youlin, a US seismologist who tracks nuclear tests that has been held in prison in China for two years.

"Knowing the president's historic record on bringing wrongfully detained Americans home has reassured me that he will also be able to secure the swift release of Min Zin and other wrongfully detained citizens," she said.

Congresswoman Young Kim, the chairwoman of the subcommittee, opened the hearing by warning Americans: "If you travel to China, Beijing may take you hostage as leverage in diplomatic negotiation."

Speaking about Zin's arrest, she added: "Beijing wanted to send a message to those whose research inconvenienced it, and detained Mr Zin ahead of the upcoming Trump-Xi summit."

Min Zin, a student activist during Myanmar's 1988 pro-democracy movement, directs the Myanmar Institute for Strategic and Policy Studies (ISP-Myanmar), a think tank that studies China's role in Myanmar, including Chinese interests, relations, and regional influence.

The son of Hong Kong media mogul Jimmy Lai also appeared on Capitol Hill to call on Trump to secure his father's release. The US president previously raised the case with Xi, telling reporters that his Chinese counterpart "told me that would be a tough one".

Asked for comment on Thursday, a senior White House official, speaking anonymously, told the BBC: "Resolving the wrongful detentions of US citizens is always a top priority for the President."

Last month, the US State Department said that two Americans - U Min Zin and Chen Youlin - were being "wrongfully detained" in China.

This designation in the US allows the cases to be transferred to the office of the Special Envoy for Hostage...
body.zh: 一名因从事间谍活动和危害国家安全罪而在中国被监禁的美国学者的妻子要求唐纳德·特朗普总统下周在白宫会见中国国家主席习近平时确保释放他。 专注于缅甸的智库主任吴敏津 (U Min Zin) 于 6 月 3 日在前往中国昆明市参加学术会议后被捕。 “我非常希望特朗普总统能在下周的峰会上向习近平主席提出我丈夫的案件，”他的妻子西尔维娅·津周三在国会作证。 习近平将于周三抵达华盛顿特区进行国事访问。此前，习近平于五月接待了特朗普访问北京。 在会议召开之前，被关押在中国的囚犯家属已前往美国首都呼吁释放他们。 周三，西尔维娅·津 (Sylvia Zin) 出席众议院外交事务委员会东亚和太平洋小组委员会，参加题为“生命而非杠杆：中国的长臂与朝鲜镇压”的听证会。 辛在讲话中表示，她相信特朗普也能够确保美国地震学家陈友林获释，他跟踪核试验，已在中国监狱关押了两年。 她说：“了解总统将被错误拘留的美国人带回家的历史记录让我放心，他也将能够确保敏津和其他被错误拘留的公民迅速获释。” 该小组委员会主席、国会女议员 Young Kim 在听证会开始时警告美国人：“如果你前往中国，北京可能会将你扣为人质，作为外交谈判的筹码。” 谈到津先生的被捕，她补充道：“北京希望向那些对其研究造成不便的人传达一个信息，并在即将举行的特习峰会之前拘留了津先生。” 敏津 (Min Zin) 是 1988 年缅甸民主运动期间的一名学生活动家，领导着缅甸战略与政策研究所 (ISP-Myanmar)，该研究所是一个研究中国在缅甸的角色，包括中国利益、关系和地区影响力的智库。 香港媒体大亨黎智英的儿子也出现在国会山呼吁特朗普确保父亲获释。这位美国总统此前曾向习近平提出过此事，他告诉记者，中国总统“告诉我这将是一个艰难的问题”。 周四在被要求置评时，一位匿名的白宫高级官员告诉 BBC：“解决美国公民的错误拘留问题始终是总统的首要任务。” 上个月，美国国务院表示，两名美国人——吴敏津和陈又林——在中国被“错误拘留”。 美国的这一指定允许将案件转移到人质问题特使办公室......

reflection.en: Sylvia Zin is bravely speaking out, asking President Trump to raise the case of her imprisoned husband, U Min Zin, with President Xi Jinping. Her testimony to Congress is a powerful act of advocacy for someone silenced by imprisonment. This echoes the call to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves, ensuring their plight is not forgotten.
reflection.zh: 西尔维娅·津勇敢地发声，请求美国总统特朗普在与中国国家主席习近平会晤时提及她被监禁的丈夫乌敏津的案件。她向国会作证，是为一位被监禁而无法发声的人进行有力辩护。这呼应了为那些不能为自己发声的人说话的呼召，确保他们的困境不会被遗忘。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

body.en: Trump and Republicans want companies to regulate themselves. It’s a dereliction of duty that will make AI less safe It is hard to get Sam Altman, Elon Musk and Dario Amodei to agree on much. But over the weekend, all three AI company CEOs called for AI development to slow down in the face of growing, alarming risks. Their employees are sounding the siren too, with one researcher publicly quitting and accusing OpenAI and Anthropic of “gambling with our lives”. The combination of dire warnings from insiders and growing real-world evidence of rogue AIs should, in a sane world, lead to government action. Instead, Donald Trump and the Republican leadership have their heads in the sand. Continue reading...
