title.en: An unexpected move by the US has sparked anger from China and Russia
title.zh: 美国出人意料的举动引发中俄愤怒

summary.en: Russia and China have expressed alarm at the revelation, warning against the idea of space becoming a "battlefield". The United States has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, a move that has sparked anger from China and Russia.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯和中国对这一消息表示震惊，警告太空可能成为“战场”。美国首次证实已在太空部署武器，此举引发了中国和俄罗斯的愤怒。

body.en:
The United States has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, a remarkable revelation after warnings about countries such as Russia possibly weaponising a global frontier long agreed in treaties to be used for only peaceful purposes.

US Air Force secretary Troy Meink said the US has fielded "on-orbit space control weapons capable of defending the Joint Force against hostile adversary action".

Meink did not detail what the weapons were, how they work or if they were targeting other objects in space or on Earth.

The US had warned two years ago that Russia was developing a new space-based, anti-satellite weapon, though the White House said the danger wasn't imminent at the time.

But reports of the anti-satellite weapon reflected longstanding worries about space threats from Russia and China, given that much US infrastructure is dependent on satellite communications. The US has also previously demonstrated its own abilities to shoot down satellites from Earth.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In his remarks to the Air and Space Forces Association's Air, Space & Cyber Conference on Tuesday AEST, Meink also said the Air Force was adding more autonomous systems to its capabilities and predicted the service would look "radically different" by 2032.

For example, he foresaw one-way attack drones replacing artillery as the "primary killer".

Analysts said that the revelation by the US confirmed an open secret, but the timing of the announcement risked exacerbating tensions with China and the risk of a weapons race in space.

In 2019, during his first term, US President Donal Trump created the Space Force as a separate military branch. In his second term, he has announced the Golden Dome missile defence system, which includes plans to put US weapons in space.

Trump said last year that he expected the system would be "fully operational before the end of my term", which ends in January 2029.

He said the system would have the capability of intercepting missiles "even if they are launched from space".

Trump also directed the Pentagon to pursue the space-based interceptors in an executive order during the first week of his presidency.

The Congressional Budget Office estimated that just the space-based components of the Golden Dome could cost as much as US$542 billion ($760 billion) over the next 20 years.

For the US, both Russia and China — its two main geopolitical rivals — pose potential threats to US interests in space.

China "develops and operates space and counterspace capabilities as part of a military modernisation strategy," according to the US Space Force.

title.en: US allies in Asia alarmed as think tank calls for pullback
title.zh: 亚洲盟友对智库呼吁撤军感到震惊

summary.en: Analysts warn that a US withdrawal from the western Pacific, as recently suggested by a think tank, would weaken deterrence and strengthen China's position. A report by Jennifer Kavanagh of the Defense Priorities Foundation advocates for the US to "narrow its defense commitments in the region" by ending mutual defense...
summary.zh: 分析人士警告称，正如一家智库最近建议的那样，美国从西太平洋撤军将削弱威慑力并加强中国的地位。珍妮弗·卡瓦纳（Jennifer Kavanagh）在偏右的国防优先基金会（Defense Priorities...

body.en:
Analysts warn that a US withdrawal from the western Pacific, as recently suggested by a think tank, would weaken deterrence and strengthen China's position.

A study by a US foreign policy think tank advocates a major military pullback from the western Pacific, prompting concern among long-standing allies of the United States across the Indo-Pacific, analysts say.

The report  was authored by Jennifer Kavanagh, a senior fellow and director of military analysis at the right-of-center Defense Priorities Foundation. Kavanagh calls for the US to "narrow its defense commitments in the region" by ending mutual defense alliances with South Korea , Japan , Australia and the Philippines .

The priority for Washington, she states, is to defend the US homeland and safeguard access to key economic markets and trade routes. That would be best served by pulling back from the "first island chain," which runs from Okinawa in southern Japan, through Taiwan and on to the Philippines.

Kavanagh writes that US forces should be pared back and moved to the "second island chain," which runs from eastern Japan to the Northern Marianas Islands in the central Pacific, Guam, Palau and on to Papua New Guinea.

The report states that moving the troops back would make their positions easier to defend and "reduce the risk of a catastrophic war with China."

Such a withdrawal would arguably be most keenly felt in Taiwan , which Beijing views as a renegade province that must one day be assimilated into greater China .

In her report, Kavanagh notes that the US has no formal commitment to come to the assistance of Taiwan in the event of an attack by China. She warns that any armed clash "would come at an exorbitant cost for the United States, far in excess of any benefits."

"With a cost-benefit calculation this lopsided, a change in the US commitment to Taiwan seems wise," she said. "The United States should shift from strategic ambiguity to a clear non-intervention policy in the event of any military confrontation over Taiwan."

The countries named in the report have made no formal comments on the think tank's proposals, but its conclusions "will be viewed with shock," William Yang, a Taiwan-based security analyst for the International Crisis Group, told DW.

The concern will be even deeper given that the Defense Priorities Foundation is known for its isolationist foreign and defense policy positions and is reputed to have ties with a number of senior and like-minded decision-makers in the White House, Yang said.

Yang noted that US President Donald Trump has repeatedly threatened to withdraw troops from allied nations in Europe and Asia if his demands for larger payments or concessions in some other area of the bilateral relationship were not met, Yang...
body.zh: 分析人士警告说，正如一家智库最近建议的那样，美国从西太平洋撤军将削弱威慑力并加强中国的地位。 分析人士称，美国外交政策智囊团的一项研究主张从西太平洋地区大规模撤军，这引起了美国在印太地区的长期盟友的担忧。 该报告的作者詹妮弗·卡瓦纳 (Jennifer Kavanagh) 是中右翼国防优先基金会的高级研究员兼军事分析主任。卡瓦纳呼吁美国终止与韩国、日本、澳大利亚和菲律宾的共同防御联盟，“缩小其在该地区的防务承诺”。 她表示，华盛顿的首要任务是保卫美国本土并保障进入主要经济市场和贸易路线的机会。最好的办法是从“第一岛链”撤军，该岛链从日本南部的冲绳岛，穿过台湾，一直延伸到菲律宾。 卡瓦纳写道，美军应该削减规模，并转移到“第二岛链”，该岛链从日本东部到太平洋中部的北马里亚纳群岛、关岛、帕劳，再到巴布亚新几内亚。 报告指出，撤军将使他们的阵地更容易保卫，并“减少与中国发生灾难性战争的风险”。 可以说，这种撤军对台湾的感受最为强烈，北京将台湾视为一个叛逆的省份，有一天必须被纳入大中华区。 卡瓦纳在报告中指出，美国没有正式承诺在台湾遭受中国袭击时向台湾提供援助。她警告说，任何武装冲突“都会给美国带来高昂的代价，远远超过任何好处”。 她说：“鉴于成本效益计算如此不平衡，美国改变对台湾的承诺似乎是明智的。” “如果台湾问题发生任何军事对抗，美国应该从战略模糊转向明确的不干预政策。” 国际危机组织驻台湾安全分析师杨威廉告诉德国之声，报告中点名的国家尚未对该智库的提议发表正式评论，但其结论“将会令人震惊”。 杨说，鉴于国防优先基金会以其孤立主义外交和国防政策立场而闻名，并且据称与白宫许多高级和志同道合的决策者有联系，这种担忧将会更加严重。 杨指出，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普多次威胁称，如果他在双边关系其他领域提出的更多付款或让步的要求得不到满足，他将从欧洲和亚洲盟国撤军。

reflection.en: A report from the Defense Priorities Foundation suggests a significant shift in US defense strategy, advocating for a pullback from the western Pacific and the termination of key alliances. This proposal, intended to re-evaluate commitments, has understandably alarmed long-standing allies who rely on these security arrangements. The situation underscores...
reflection.zh: 国防优先基金会的一份报告建议美国国防战略发生重大转变，主张从西太平洋撤军并终止关键联盟。这项旨在重新评估承诺的提议，可以理解地引起了那些依赖这些安全安排的长期盟友的警惕。这一局势凸显了在考虑影响全球稳定和信任的重大政策变革时，审慎权衡和明智咨询的至关重要性。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: ‘This is seriously bold’: How China turned Taiwan tensions into a top-rating TV spy drama
title.zh: “这真是大胆”：中国如何将台湾紧张局势变成一部收视率飙升的电视间谍剧

summary.en: A new Chinese spy drama, 'Long Watch' (Jiaofeng), co-produced by the Ministry of State Security, has become a hit across the Taiwan Strait. The show, which fictionalizes real-life crises, follows a double agent working for China whose cover is blown. While dismissed as propaganda in Taiwan, the series' success...
summary.zh: 一部由国家安全部联合制作的中国新间谍剧《交锋》（Jiaofeng）已成为海峡两岸的热门剧集。该剧将现实生活中的危机虚构化，讲述了一名在中国大陆秘密工作的双面间谍被揭穿的故事。尽管在台湾被斥为宣传片，但该剧的成功凸显了娱乐媒体在处理敏感政治话题方面的作用。

body.en: Dismissed in Taiwan as simply propaganda, the Long Watch, or Jiaofeng, has proved a sensation across the strait with its references to real-life crises After shaking off the people trailing her through a crowded market and emerging from a bathroom in disguise, the double agent appears to have escaped. But a sip of water on a plane eventually gets her. She is poisoned after Taiwan’s military intelligence service discovers that she has been working secretly for China. The plot comes from a new Chinese spy drama co-produced by the Ministry of State Security. Since its premiere on 6 September, it has become a TV hit, with a fictionalised take on a subject rarely treated so directly: the modern history of tensions with Taiwan. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在台湾，《长守》或《叫风》被认为只是宣传品，但它却因提及现实生活中的危机而轰动了海峡两岸。在摆脱了跟踪她的人穿过拥挤的市场，乔装打扮地从浴室里出来后，这位双重间谍似乎已经逃脱了。但飞机上的一小口水最终让她崩溃了。台湾军事情报部门发现她一直在为中国大陆秘密工作后，她被毒死。剧情来自于国家安全部联合制作的一部新的中国谍战剧。自 9 月 6 日首播以来，它已成为电视热门节目，以虚构的方式讲述了一个很少如此直接处理的主题：与台湾紧张关系的现代历史。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This drama, 'Long Watch,' produced with the involvement of China's Ministry of State Security, uses fictionalized events to explore cross-strait tensions. It raises questions about how narratives are shaped and disseminated through popular media, reminding us of the importance of discerning truth from fiction, as Ephesians 4:25 urges us to speak truthfully...
reflection.zh: 这部由中国国家安全部参与制作的《交锋》剧集，通过虚构的情节来探讨海峡两岸的紧张局势。它引发了关于叙事如何通过大众媒体塑造和传播的疑问，提醒我们要分辨真伪，正如以弗所书4章25节所劝勉的，要说诚实话。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Why North Korea's Kim Jong Un doesn't need a US deal
title.zh: 朝鲜的金正恩为何不需要与美国达成协议

summary.en: Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，平壤在得到鼓舞后正在加速其核计划，并巩固与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。

body.en:
Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.

In August, US President Donald Trump revived a charm offensive aimed at Pyongyang by drastically scaling back joint US military exercises with South Korea and heaping praise on North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. The US president said the North Korean dictator "has always treated me with great respect."

North Korea's response to Trump's overtures has been markedly less enthusiastic, ranging from firing a barrage of missiles to publicly denying Trump's claims that Kim has responded "very positively" to a request for talks.

This week, as the US and South Korea, along with Japan, kicked off a five-day military drill, there was no mention of any pullback from Washington, nor any sign of diplomatic progress with Pyongyang.

Instead, Kim on Monday commissioned a naval destroyer, while again emphasizing North Korea must establish a "powerful and reliable nuclear war deterrent" and strengthen "maritime defense." Kim also said North Korea would soon unveil a "significant" naval advancement.

Unlike the summit diplomacy of Trump's first term, Kim's dismissive stance comes at a time when North Korea has alternatives to a grand bargain with the United States.

"For Kim, the stakes are simply lower than they were in 2019. There is no longer the same sense of urgency in Pyongyang to get back to the negotiating table with Washington," Joon Ha Park, a correspondent at Korea Risk Group in Seoul, told DW.

"North Korea now has a treaty-based alliance with Moscow and is drawing closer to Beijing, while its military capabilities have expanded significantly. That's why a single reduction in ROK-US military exercises is not enough for Pyongyang to be swayed," he added, referring to military ties between South Korea and the US.

Park agrees that Kim is arguably in his strongest position since taking power in 2011. Just six years ago, amid crippling sanctions and the coronavirus pandemic, an emotional Kim stood at the lectern marking the 75th anniversary of the Korean Workers' Party and expressed regret for having failed the North Korean people.

Fast forward to today, and North Korea's economy appears to be on a stronger footing . Estimates released last year by South Korea's central bank showed the economy expanded by 3.7% in 2024, its fastest rate of growth in eight years.

Kim has brought North Korea closer to Russia and China than the traditionally isolated country has been in decades. This week, both Moscow and Beijing sent messages marking North Korea's 78th founding anniversary and praising the strategic importance of their deepening partnerships with...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，胆大妄为的平壤加速了核计划，并巩固了与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。 上个月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普大幅缩减美国与韩国的联合军演，并对朝鲜领导人金正恩大加赞扬，从而重新发起针对平壤的魅力攻势。美国总统表示，朝鲜独裁者“一直非常尊重我”。 朝鲜对特朗普提议的反应明显不那么热情，从发射一连串导弹到公开否认特朗普关于金正恩对会谈请求做出“非常积极”回应的说法。 本周，美国、韩国以及日本开始了为期五天的军事演习，但没有提到华盛顿有任何撤军，也没有任何与平壤取得外交进展的迹象。 相反，金正恩周一委托了一艘海军驱逐舰，同时再次强调朝鲜必须建立“强大而可靠的核战争威慑力量”并加强“海上防御”。金正恩还表示，朝鲜很快将公布一项“重大”海军进展。 与特朗普第一任期的峰会外交不同，金正恩的不屑一顾的立场是在朝鲜除了与美国达成大交易之外还有其他选择之际采取的。 “对金正恩来说，赌注比2019年要低。平壤不再有回到与华盛顿谈判桌的紧迫感，”首尔韩国风险集团记者Joon Ha Park告诉德国之声。 “朝鲜现在与莫斯科建立了基于条约的联盟，并且正在向北京靠拢，而其军事能力也显着增强。这就是为什么韩美军事演习的一次减少不足以让平壤动摇，”他在谈到韩国和美国之间的军事关系时补充道。 朴槿惠也同意，金正恩可以说是自 2011 年上台以来处于最有利的位置。 就在六年前，在严厉的制裁和冠状病毒大流行的背景下，金正恩情绪激动地站在纪念朝鲜劳动党成立75周年的讲台上，对辜负了朝鲜人民的期望表示遗憾。 快进到今天，朝鲜经济似乎已经站稳了脚跟。韩国央行去年发布的预测显示，2024年经济将增长3.7%，为八年来最快增速。 金正恩使朝鲜与俄罗斯和中国的关系比这个传统上孤立的国家几十年来更加接近。本周，莫斯科和北京都发出了纪念朝鲜成立 78 周年的信息，并赞扬了两国深化与朝鲜的伙伴关系的战略重要性……

reflection.en: The news highlights how Kim Jong Un's regime continues to advance its nuclear ambitions, seemingly unfazed by diplomatic overtures. Proverbs 28:15 warns that 'When the wicked rule, people groan.' This verse speaks to the inherent instability and suffering that can arise when power is wielded without accountability, as seen in the continued acceleration of...
reflection.zh: 新闻指出，金正恩政权似乎并未受到外交示好的影响，仍在推进其核野心。箴言 28:15 警告说：“恶人在位，人就叹息。”这节经文呼应了当权力在缺乏问责的情况下被滥用时，可能产生的固有不稳定和苦难，正如在国际关注下朝鲜核计划的持续加速所见。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Call in China to end English's core status sparks debate
title.zh: 中国呼吁结束英语核心地位引发辩论

summary.en: A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers, and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.
summary.zh: 在中国学校降低英语地位的呼吁正在引发关于其对学生、职业以及人工智能时代中国全球竞争力的价值的讨论。

body.en:
A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.

From business and academia to social media and entertainment — English is considered the dominant global language. One in five people on Earth actively uses this lingua franca. In China , a mathematics professor specializing in vector algebra is now challenging this dominance in no uncertain terms. Tang Jiafeng believes that English should be abolished as a core subject in elementary schools, secondary schools and universities.

Tang is convinced that no other country in the world has placed as much importance on English as China has.

"Our children desperately begin learning English even before they have properly mastered their native language. Yet we are a civilization that dates back thousands of years. English is just a tool. It's enough to be able to use it. The tradition of revering and emulating Western cultures must come to an end," Tang says in social media.

English is considered difficult in China, since the Chinese language does not use an alphabetic script. It is a required subject starting in third grade. It is graded on par with Chinese and mathematics on the entrance exam for secondary schools, the central exam after 9th grade, and the high school graduation exam. A maximum of 150 points can be earned on the latter.

"How many resources and how much time do our children, parents and schools invest in a subject that is completely irrelevant to the majority of people in their future professional lives?" the mathematician asks, explaining his position.

He became well-known because many of his students achieved full scores on state math exams; in the class of 2011, six students from a single class did so.

"Why cram for English when artificial intelligence can translate everything in seconds?" comments a user from Beijing.

Another suggestion from the southern province of Guangdong is to at least adjust the scoring — for example, to 120 points instead of 150 on the high school graduation exam.

Many parents invest in private tutoring that focuses specifically on exam questions. In addition, all bachelor's students must pass the English exam before being admitted to master's programs. Tang suspects that this could cause many young talents in the natural sciences to fail, even though they have great potential to become top researchers.

There is no question that English is also important for STEM subjects. Research on future-oriented topics is typically published in English. There are fears circulating online that cutting back on English instruction could lead to a decline in China's competitiveness. A prominent advocate for English as a required subject is Hu Xijin,...
body.zh: 降低中国学校英语等级的呼声引发了关于人工智能时代英语对学生、职业和中国全球竞争力价值的讨论。 从商业和学术界到社交媒体和娱乐——英语被认为是全球主导语言。地球上五分之一的人积极使用这种通用语言。在中国，一位专门研究向量代数的数学教授现在正在毫不含糊地挑战这一主导地位。唐家峰认为，应该取消英语作为小学、中学和大学的核心科目。 唐坚信，世界上没有哪个国家像中国一样重视英语。 唐在社交媒体上表示：“我们的孩子在还没有真正掌握母语之前就拼命地开始学习英语。但我们是一个有着数千年历史的文明。英语只是一种工具，能够使用它就足够了。尊重和效仿西方文化的传统必须结束。” 英语在中国被认为很难，因为中文不使用字母文字。这是从三年级开始的必修科目。中学入学考试、九年级后的集中考试和高中毕业考试的成绩与语文和数学同等。后者最多可获得 150 点积分。 “我们的孩子、家长和学校在一个与大多数人未来职业生涯完全无关的主题上投入了多少资源和时间？”数学家问道，并解释了他的立场。 他之所以出名，是因为他的许多学生在州数学考试中取得了满分。 2011届的一个班有六名学生这样做了。 “当人工智能可以在几秒钟内翻译所有内容时，为什么还要死记硬背英语呢？”北京网友评论。 来自南方省份广东省的另一项建议是至少调整分数——例如，高中毕业考试的分数从150分调整为120分。 许多家长投资专门针对考试问题的私人辅导。此外，所有学士学生必须通过英语考试才能进入硕士课程。唐怀疑这可能会导致许多自然科学领域的年轻人才失败，尽管他们有成为顶尖研究人员的巨大潜力。 毫无疑问，英语对于 STEM 科目也很重要。面向未来的主题的研究通常以英文发表。网上流传着这样的担忧：削减英语教学可能会导致中国竞争力下降。将英语作为必修科目的一位著名倡导者是胡锡进……

reflection.en: The debate in China about the role of English in education touches on how societies navigate the explosion of knowledge and global communication. As Professor Tang Jiafeng questions English's dominance, it mirrors the broader challenge of discerning which knowledge serves us best in an era of unprecedented information growth, as described in Daniel 12:4:...
reflection.zh: 在中国关于英语教育作用的辩论，触及了社会如何应对知识的爆炸式增长和全球交流。正如唐嘉风教授质疑英语的主导地位，这也反映了一个更广泛的挑战：在一个信息空前增长的时代，辨别哪些知识最能服务于我们。正如但以理书12:4所描述的：“必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。”

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

The pursuit of power or personal gain can easily lead individuals away from ethical conduct. title.en: Nearly two million Quest Apartment Hotels customers affected by data breach
title.zh: 近两百万Quest Apartment Hotels客户受数据泄露事件影响

summary.en: Nearly two million Quest Apartment Hotels customers have had their personal information compromised in a data breach, with experts questioning the length of time companies retain such data.
summary.zh: 近两百万Quest Apartment Hotels客户的个人信息在一场数据泄露事件中遭到泄露，专家们质疑公司保留此类数据的时长。

body.en:
Personal information of nearly two million Quest Apartment Hotels customers has been compromised in a data breach, including credit card, passport and Medicare numbers.

Last month, the accommodation provider identified a cyberattack on a database system via a vulnerability in a third-party technology provider.

David Mansfield, the managing director of The Ascott Limited, which owns Quest Apartment Hotels, provided an update this week, saying a forensic data analysis revealed information relating to approximately 1,991,613 customers was affected.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Mansfield said the company was contacting those affected directly to inform them of which category they were in, the steps they could take, and available support.

"I recognise the concern this incident has caused. On behalf of Quest, I sincerely apologise to those who have been affected," he said.

Quest said it first identified an outage on its website on 17 August, with investigation revealing "a malicious attack" had exploited a vulnerability in a third-party service provider's software.

The company is advising customers to remain alert for suspicious emails, text messages and telephone calls, particularly communications requesting personal, financial or account information.

Quest said it was cooperating with the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner, the Australian Signals Directorate, the Australian Cyber Security Centre and Victoria Police.

Last year's Annual Cyber Threat Report warned cyberattacks were a growing problem in Australia, with financial losses, ransomware attack frequency, and the number of reported data breaches all increasing.

After a major data breach involving millions of Optus customers in 2022 , the federal government overhauled privacy laws, requiring companies to destroy or actively de-identify personal information as soon as it was no longer needed.

Paul Watters, chief executive of Cyberstronomy, which provides cyber risk expertise, said all businesses needed to have a clear understanding of the personal data they hold and why.

"Quest says all of the affected information came from records dating from before June 2025. That immediately raises a governance question: for each category of information, why was it still being retained?"

"Audit your data holdings. Know what you have, where it is, why you are retaining it, how long you need it, and when it should be deleted or de-identified. Data you no longer hold cannot be stolen in a breach," he said.

Belinda Barnet, a Swinburne University data privacy expert, told SBS News the latest incident raised concerns about the type of data some companies were still...

reflection.en: The compromise of sensitive data like credit card and passport numbers for nearly two million customers underscores the risks inherent in storing vast amounts of personal information. This incident serves as a stark reminder of the potential for misuse and the deep-seated human desire for wealth and control that can drive illicit activities.

title.en: ICE enforcement in Australia? Burke quizzed over US-style detention concerns
title.zh: 澳大利亚的移民执法？伯克被问及对美国式拘留的担忧

summary.en: Australia's Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke has rejected claims that the country is adopting a US-style immigration enforcement model following backlash over new migration reforms. The reforms include tougher measures for visa overstayers, with plans to add detention beds and compliance officers.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚内政部长托尼·伯克否认了该国正在效仿美国式移民执法模式的说法，此前政府的移民改革引发了强烈反对。改革包括对签证逾期居留者采取更严厉的措施，并计划增加拘留床位和合规官员。

body.en:
Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke has rejected suggestions that Australia is moving towards a United States-style immigration enforcement model following backlash over the government's migration reforms .

Burke announced the new policy settings on Thursday, with the most consequential changes targeting "visa-hoppers", overstayers, students and backpackers in a bid to bring down net overseas migration figures.

People who overstay their visas, a cohort of roughly 77,000 people, would face tougher enforcement measures under the government's plans, including the prospect of detention. To discourage overstaying, the government will add 250 beds and 100 compliance officers, restoring capacity Burke said existed before 2015.

Under the pre-2015 approach, Burke said overstayers were detained and generally organised their own flights home within a matter of weeks. "This is not the sort of operation that some people have seen on TV happening in other countries," he said in his address.

The announcement nonetheless drew comparisons to US President Donald Trump's hardline immigration crackdown, carried out by the Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agency since he took office last year.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The agency has taken an aggressive approach to enforcement, detention and deportation, triggering mass protests, legal challenges and fierce debate over the treatment of migrants.

He reiterated that the policy is simply a return to Australia's approach before 2015, when visa overstayers, such as students, were routinely contacted, encouraged to leave, and, if necessary, detained briefly before arranging their own departure.

He said the practice ended when detention centres became dominated by criminals, forcing resources to be redirected. Burke described the proposed expansion to 250 detention beds as a modest restoration of a system that had operated for years.

"Australia stopped doing it for the very simple reason that our detention centres filled up with criminals," he told SBS News.

"That's what happened, and there's no way — in a block that's got a whole lot of people who've done some horrific things and have come straight from prison — that I'm going to put an international student who's overstayed in the same place. I'm just not going to do that."

He said it meant that for the past 11 years, Australia had "stopped doing what is the normal thing to do", referring to the use of detention as a deterrent for people who remain in the country after their visas expire.

"It's a very modest program. It used to be 250 beds, it'll be 250 beds again. It's nothing other than something that used to happen all the time, and...

title.en: The competing visions for Australia's migration system
title.zh: 澳大利亚移民体系的竞争愿景

summary.en: Australia's federal government has introduced long-awaited migration reforms, including changes to migration caps and visa regulations. Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke presented the policy as a result of year-long planning, distinct from recent political pressures, though analysts suggest it responds to the rise of...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚联邦政府已推出期待已久的移民改革，包括调整移民上限和签证规定。内政部长托尼·伯克将该政策呈现为一年规划的结果，与近期的政治压力无关，尽管分析人士认为这是对优先控制移民的政党崛起的反应。

body.en:
After weeks of headlines dominated by One Nation, the federal government has unveiled its long-awaited migration reforms.

Notably, Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke did not name Pauline Hanson's party during his 35-minute National Press Club speech on Thursday, and he was quick to point out the policy had been in the works since last year.

"It's simply demonstrably wrong to suspect that somehow this is a recent bit of work done to deal with a political climate; it's not," he said.

Yet some analysts say it's difficult not to see the government as responding to the rise of One Nation, which has overtaken Labor on the primary vote and is the favoured party on immigration, according to some polls.

Nine newspapers reported Prime Minister Anthony Albanese was concerned about the optics of using a forum like the Press Club to draw more attention to an issue being dominated by One Nation — a claim Burke rejected on Thursday.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

One Nation announced its migration policy earlier this week, promising to end "mass migration" by cutting temporary visas by 750,000 over three years and delivering net negative migration to ease pressure on housing, healthcare and infrastructure.

That follows the Coalition's plan announced in April, while the Greens' policy platform is the same one it took to the 2025 federal election.

With the political battle lines drawn on one of the most major issues facing Australia, where do these parties stand on migration?

The government wants to reduce Australia's net overseas migration (NOM) figure from its current level of 292,100.

It has forecast figures of 245,000 for 2026-27 and 225,000 each year thereafter.

Burke acknowledged in his address there were housing pressures, but rejected claims Australia was experiencing mass migration.

"We need immigration to soften enough that housing has a chance to catch up," he said.

Among the most consequential changes are those affecting students, backpackers, visa overstayers and "visa hoppers".

International students will no longer be able to bring their family members to Australia, though there are some exceptions, including for PhD students.

To extend their visas, a student will now have to transfer to a higher course, such as from a bachelor's degree to a master's.

A ballot system and cap will be introduced for second and third-year working holiday-makers. There will be 45,000 second-year places and 5,000 third-year — down from the current 57,000 and 31,000 respectively.

Visa overstayers, estimated at 77,000, will be detained, reviving a policy in place before 2015. The government is now chasing more facilities, compliance officers...
body.zh: 在一国党占据头条新闻数周后，联邦政府公布了期待已久的移民改革。 值得注意的是，内政部长托尼·伯克（Tony Burke）在周四 35 分钟的全国新闻俱乐部演讲中没有点出宝琳·汉森（Pauline Hanson）所在政党的名字，他很快指出这项政策自去年以来就一直在酝酿之中。 “怀疑这是最近为应对政治气候所做的一些工作，这显然是错误的；事实并非如此，”他说。 然而一些分析人士表示，很难不认为政府是对一国党崛起的回应，根据一些民意调查，一国党在初选中超过了工党，并且是移民问题上最受欢迎的政党。 九家报纸报道称，总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞（Anthony Albanese）对利用新闻俱乐部等论坛吸引更多人关注一国党主导的问题的做法感到担忧——伯克周四否认了这一说法。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 一国党本周早些时候宣布了其移民政策，承诺通过在三年内削减 75 万个临时签证并实现净负移民来结束“大规模移民”，以缓解住房、医疗保健和基础设施方面的压力。 这是继联盟党 4 月份宣布的计划之后，绿党的政策纲领与 2025 年联邦选举时的政策纲领相同。 由于政治战线围绕澳大利亚面临的最重大问题之一，这些政党在移民问题上的立场如何？ 政府希望将澳大利亚的净海外移民 (NOM) 人数从目前的 292,100 人减少。 预计 2026-27 年的数字为 245,000 人，此后每年为 225,000 人。 伯克在讲话中承认存在住房压力，但否认澳大利亚正在经历大规模移民的说法。 “我们需要移民足够软化，以便住房市场有机会迎头赶上，”他说。 最重要的变化包括影响学生、背包客、签证逾期居留者和“签证跳跃者”的变化。 国际学生将无法再将家人带到澳大利亚，但也有一些例外，包括博士生。 为了延长签证，学生现在必须转学到更高的课程，例如从学士学位转到硕士学位。 将为第二年和第三年的工作度假者引入抽签制度和上限。二年级和三年级将有 45,000 个名额和 5,000 个名额，分别低于目前的 57,000 个和 31,000 个。 估计有 77,000 名签证逾期居留者将被拘留，恢复 2015 年之前实施的政策。政府目前正在寻求更多设施，合规官员……

reflection.en: As Australia grapples with its migration policies, the ancient call to welcome the foreigner resonates. Deuteronomy 10:19 reminds us that Yahweh loves the foreigner, providing for them and urging us to do the same. May leaders and citizens alike consider the humanity of those seeking a new home, extending compassion and justice in policy and practice.

title.en: The forces turning Australia's inflation fears into a reality
title.zh: 将澳大利亚的通胀担忧变为现实的因素

summary.en: While growth in the Australian economy is slowing, the RBA governor said, the bank's concerns about inflation are materialising. This could lead to further interest rate hikes.
summary.zh: 尽管澳大利亚经济增长放缓，但澳大利亚储备银行行长表示，该银行对通胀的担忧正在成为现实。这可能导致进一步加息。

body.en:
The Reserve Bank of Australia's (RBA) fears about inflation have materialised, its governor Michele Bullock says, which could force it to raise interest rates again .

Her comments during a parliamentary hearing on Friday morning reaffirmed expectations that the central bank would hike rates for a fourth time this year at its upcoming board meeting in late September.

Inflation was too high, but the key question for the RBA at that meeting would be whether the bank's three rate rises to date were enough to bring inflation back to target in a reasonable time, Bullock said.

At its last meeting in August , the RBA forecast that inflation would return to the middle of its target range of 2-3 per cent by the end of 2027.

Even that was not assured, with inflation more likely to overshoot the bank's forecasts than undershoot it.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

If that proved to be the case, more rate hikes might be warranted, the RBA board said at the time.

"Developments since then suggest that, although growth in the Australian economy is slowing, some of these upside risks to inflation appear to be materialising," Bullock said on Friday.

The Middle East conflict , the AI boom, and extreme weather events have added to pressure on energy, food, and tech prices, she said.

"There is little sign of resolution in the Middle East conflict. Oil and related prices have increased sharply again and will add directly to inflation."

The benchmark Brent crude price remained above US$104 ($146) a barrel, despite a modest sell-off in oil overnight on news that Saudi Arabia plans to bring its East-West pipeline back online in a reduced capacity following attacks by Iran-backed Houthi forces.

But as businesses increasingly saw no end in sight to the war and price increases, they were growing more inclined to pass on costs to consumers, which risked making inflation more persistent, Bullock said.

After inflation came in hotter than expected in July , money markets have raised the chance for a September rate rise above 80 per cent, with two hikes fully priced in by March.

Higher-for-longer interest rates and fuel prices would hit economic growth, but that has been swamped by the AI boom, which has pushed up demand in a way the RBA did not foresee.

"Just back from the US and in addition to ... the upside risk of inflation from the Middle East, what is also very striking is how strong the AI and tech boom is and has been," RBA deputy governor Andrew Hauser said.

"That's not just true in the US; it's true in the Asia Pacific region as well, who are of course our closest trading partners, and our forecasts for global growth have been repeatedly surprised on the...
body.zh: 澳大利亚储备银行 (RBA) 行长米歇尔·布洛克 (Michele Bullock) 表示，其对通胀的担忧已经成为现实，这可能迫使其再次加息。 她在周五上午的议会听证会上发表的言论重申了人们的预期，即央行将在 9 月底召开的董事会会议上进行今年第四次加息。 布洛克表示，通胀过高，但澳联储在这次会议上的关键问题是，该行迄今为止的三次加息是否足以在合理的时间内使通胀回到目标水平。 在 8 月份的最后一次会议上，澳大利亚央行预测，到 2027 年底，通胀将回到 2-3% 目标区间的中间位置。 即便如此，也不能保证这一点，因为通胀更有可能超出央行的预测，而不是低于央行的预测。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 澳洲联储董事会当时表示，如果事实果真如此，可能需要进一步加息。 布洛克周五表示：“此后的事态发展表明，尽管澳大利亚经济增长正在放缓，但通胀上行风险似乎正在显现。” 她表示，中东冲突、人工智能繁荣和极端天气事件加大了能源、食品和科技价格的压力。 “中东冲突几乎没有解决的迹象。石油和相关价格再次大幅上涨，将直接加剧通胀。” 尽管有消息称沙特阿拉伯计划在受到伊朗支持的胡塞武装袭击后减少其东西向管道的运力，导致隔夜石油小幅抛售，但基准布伦特原油价格仍高于每桶 104 美元（146 美元）。 但布洛克表示，随着企业越来越多地看到战争和价格上涨没有结束的迹象，他们越来越倾向于将成本转嫁给消费者，这有可能使通货膨胀更加持久。 7 月份通胀高于预期后，货币市场将 9 月份加息的可能性提高到 80% 以上，到 3 月份的两次加息已完全反映在市场中。 长期较高的利率和燃料价格将打击经济增长，但这已被人工智能的繁荣所淹没，人工智能以澳大利亚央行没有预见到的方式推高了需求。 澳洲联储副行长安德鲁·豪瑟表示：“刚从美国回来，除了……中东通胀的上行风险之外，人工智能和科技繁荣的强劲程度也非常引人注目。” “这不仅在美国如此，在亚太地区也是如此，他们当然是我们最亲密的贸易伙伴，我们对全球增长的预测一再令人惊讶......

title.en: 'I am learning': HYROX athlete apologises and withdraws after viral defecation incident
title.zh: “我正在学习”：HYROX运动员在排便事件走红后道歉并退赛

summary.en: Australian athlete Joanna Wietrzyk has apologized and withdrawn from the HYROX race in Beijing after footage of her defecating during the event went viral internationally. She stated, 'I want to offer my sincere apology to the people of China, my fellow competitors, the spectators and the HYROX organizers for what...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚运动员乔安娜·维特日克（Joanna Wietrzyk）在比赛中排便的视频在国际上走红后，已道歉并从北京的HYROX比赛中退赛。她表示：“我想就比赛期间发生的事情，向中国人民、我的参赛选手、观众以及HYROX组织者致以诚挚的歉意。”

body.en:
The Australian athlete at the centre of the HYROX defecation controversy has apologised and retroactively withdrawn from the race after footage of the incident went viral internationally.

Social media footage showed Australian athlete Joanna Wietrzyk, who holds the women's HYROX solo pro world record, competing at exercise stations with faeces on her legs during a race in Beijing over the weekend.

In a statement posted to Instagram on Thursday night, Wietrzyk apologised for her decision to continue competing.

"I want to offer my sincere apology to the people of China, my fellow competitors, the spectators and the HYROX organizers for what happened during the race in Beijing," she wrote.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I felt completely fit and healthy at the start of the race, with no reason to expect any illness. Looking back, I regret the decision to not have stepped off the track.

"I recognize that I should have made a different choice. I take responsibility for my decision to continue and am deeply sorry for the discomfort and disruption it caused."

Wietrzyk also announced that she would forfeit the points she earned as the competition winner.

"I am learning from this experience and will carry those lessons with me, including remembering that there is more to life than racing and knowing when it is right to step away," she said.

"On reflection, I have decided to retroactively withdraw from the race and forfeit the points I earned."

Ending her statement, Wietrzyk said: "Thank you to those standing by me, both as an athlete and as a person, during this time, and to everyone who has reached out with kindness and support.

"It means more to me than I can properly express right now. I will be taking some time to recover, reflect and look after myself and my family away from the noise."

HYROX is a fitness and endurance race that combines 8km of running with exercises such as rowing, sled pushes and wall balls, carried out in indoor exhibition halls.

Wietrzyk initially shared a selfie on her Instagram story after the race, which showed her lying down with an intravenous line in her arm. It was captioned: "Go hard or go home they say ... a win is a win".

Multiple media outlets also reported that Wietrzyk's major sponsor, Puma, was distancing itself from the athlete after their collaborative line appeared to be quietly removed from the sportswear giant's website a day ago.

The page has since been restored online, with a Puma spokesperson telling CBC News that some landing pages were "unintentionally taken offline".

The incident has prompted backlash and criticism of HYROX's health and safety standards, with many wondering why Wietrzyk...
body.zh: 在该事件的视频在国际上疯传后，处于 HYROX 排便争议中心的澳大利亚运动员已道歉并追溯退出比赛。 社交媒体视频显示，周末在北京举行的一场比赛中，保持着女子 HYROX 单人职业世界纪录的澳大利亚运动员乔安娜·维茨克 (Joanna Wietrzyk) 在训练站进行比赛，腿上沾满粪便。 周四晚上，维茨克在 Instagram 上发布了一份声明，为自己继续参赛的决定道歉。 她写道：“我想就北京比赛期间发生的事情向中国人民、我的竞争对手、观众和 HYROX 组织者表示诚挚的歉意。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “比赛开始时我感觉完全健康，没有理由预期会生病。回想起来，我很遗憾没有离开赛道的决定。 “我认识到我应该做出不同的选择。我对我继续的决定负责，并对由此造成的不适和干扰深表歉意。” Wietrzyk 还宣布她将放弃作为比赛获胜者获得的积分。 她说：“我正在从这次经历中学习，并将随身携带这些教训，包括记住生活不仅仅是比赛，而且知道什么时候离开是正确的。” “经过深思熟虑，我决定追溯退出比赛，并放弃我获得的积分。” 维茨克在结束发言时表示：“感谢在这段时间里站在我身边的人，无论是作为一名运动员还是作为一个人，以及所有伸出善意和支持的人。 “这对我来说意义重大，我现在无法正确表达。我将花一些时间来恢复、反思并照顾自己和家人，远离噪音。” HYROX 是一项健身耐力赛，将 8 公里跑步与划船、推雪橇和墙球等练习结合起来，在室内展厅进行。 比赛结束后，Wietrzyk 最初在她的 Instagram 故事上分享了一张自拍照，照片中她躺着，手臂上插着静脉注射线。标题是：“他们说，要么努力，要么回家……胜利就是胜利”。 多家媒体还报道称，维茨克的主要赞助商彪马正在与这位运动员保持距离，因为一天前他们的合作系列似乎已从这家运动服装巨头的网站上悄悄删除。 该页面现已恢复上线，彪马发言人告诉加拿大广播公司新闻，一些登陆页面“无意中离线”。 该事件引发了对 HYROX 健康和安全标准的强烈反对和批评，许多人想知道为什么 Wietrzyk...

reflection.en: The rapid spread of footage showing Joanna Wietrzyk's unfortunate incident in Beijing serves as a stark reminder of how quickly actions can become public and subject to immediate judgment in the digital age. Her apology and withdrawal demonstrate a willingness to take responsibility, even after the fact, for a choice made under pressure.
reflection.zh: 乔安娜·维特日克在北京比赛中发生的不幸事件的视频迅速传播，鲜明地提醒我们，在数字时代，行为可以多么迅速地公开并受到即时评判。她的道歉和退赛表明，即使事后，她也愿意为在压力下做出的选择承担责任。

title.en: The EU wants a new kind of member — and Australia could be in the mix
title.zh: 欧盟想要一种新型成员——澳大利亚可能在其中

summary.en: The European Union is considering new models for relationships with other countries, and European Parliament President Roberta Metsola has suggested that Australia and New Zealand could explore becoming "associate members," similar to Canada's arrangement.
summary.zh: 欧盟正在考虑与其他国家建立新型关系模式，欧洲议会主席罗伯塔·梅索拉提议澳大利亚和新西兰可以探索成为“联系成员”，类似于加拿大的安排。

body.en:
Australia and New Zealand could follow in Canada's footsteps to become "associate members" of the European Union, a top EU official has suggested.

European Parliament President Roberta Metsola, in an interview with Europe Today, specifically brought up Australia and New Zealand as examples of countries that could deepen their relationships with the alliance.

Metsola said the EU had different models for its relationships with other countries, from full membership to participation in the European Economic Area, and was also looking to deepen ties with partners such as Canada — a model she expected other countries to pursue.

"I don't doubt that that will also include other countries that will come," she said.

"We've already seen it, both in terms of legislation that we pass, where we see partners from across the world — Australia, New Zealand being some examples — of saying, look, we want to deepen our relationship."

"We're doing it in terms of trade. We're doing it in terms of conversation on what we do with social media, with children, with critical raw materials, alliances that can be forged."

Canadian Prime ‌Minister Mark Carney has welcomed the proposal of becoming an "associate member" of the EU, saying Europe and Canada are stronger together ‌and should deepen ties to protect their citizens' prosperity.

"Europe and Canada are each strong. Europe and Canada are even stronger together," Carney told the European parliament in Strasbourg, France, on Thursday.

"I am not proposing a third bloc in order to become a great-power rival — only with better manners."

"We do not seek power to dominate others. On the contrary, we are pursuing ‌resilience so that ‌no one can ⁠control our open markets, impair our sovereignty, threaten our territorial integrity, or undermine our freedoms, our democracies, our rule of law."

Hours earlier, US President Donald Trump threatened to take action against the EU if it moved forward with European Commission President Ursula von der ‌Leyen's proposal of associate membership for Canada.

Both the EU and Canada have been facing stiff rivalry and pressure from the Trump administration on trade , among other matters, and from an increasingly assertive China.

"If they do that, if I think it's at all a hostile act, ⁠I will put very serious tariffs or stop trading with Europe on many ‌things," Trump told reporters en route to an event in North Carolina.

"If it's a good intention, that's fine. If it's a bad intention, we'll ‌put very heavy tariffs on Europe," he added.

summary.en: Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke stated that no sector of the economy can be insulated from the effects of the migration overhaul. The Department of Home Affairs is deliberately slowing down 'backpacker' visas to reduce arrivals and is encouraging farmers to hire Pacific workers for crop harvesting. The National...
summary.zh: 内政部长托尼·伯克表示，没有任何经济部门可以不受移民改革影响。内政部正在故意放慢“背包客”签证的处理速度以减少入境人数，并鼓励农民雇佣太平洋岛国工人来采摘农作物。全国农民联合会正在开展运动，以消除签证障碍，因为该行业担心由于劳动力短缺，农作物将无法及时采摘，并警告超市价格将上涨。

body.en:
The Home Affairs Department has engineered a slowdown in backpacker visas to reduce arrivals and is now urging farmers to consider hiring Pacific workers to pick their crops.

The National Farmers' Federation has led a campaign to axe visa bottlenecks amid growing industry anxiety that fruits and other crops will wither on trees without the labour force needed to harvest them.

The agricultural sector is warning the shortages will increase supermarket prices.

As the federal government moves to reduce arrivals to Australia , its visa overhaul includes introducing a ballot system for backpackers hoping to spend more than one year in Australia on a working holiday visa.

It will also cut the available long-term visas. Backpackers from the United Kingdom will be exempt from the requirements because of the UK's free trade deal with Australia.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In an interview with SBS News, Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke has encouraged any horticulture businesses struggling to secure harvest workers to consider the Pacific Australia Labour Mobility (PALM) scheme and Pacific workers.

"Our preferred agriculture visa has always been the PALM scheme, the Pacific workers visa. When I was employment minister, we did a lot to improve the rules to avoid worker exploitation on the Pacific, on the PALM visa ," he said.

"At the time that we were improving those rules, we had some of the farm organisations say to us, 'If you do this, our members will just go and use backpackers.'"

"Now, if the reason that people are more reliant on backpackers and refusing to use Pacific workers is because they're upset that we've ended exploitation in those areas, I think that is a very different question for a number of operators.

"That doesn't depict the whole of the farm sector, not for a minute, and a whole lot of them still use the Pacific Labour Scheme, but the Pacific Labour Scheme right now has extra capacity. Those extra workers are available."

Burke said he can't quarantine any sector of the economy from the impacts of the migration shake-up.

The government wants to reduce the number of working holidaymakers, crack down on visa overstayers and tighten allowances for international students as part of its push to reduce migration numbers.

Farmers and the Nationals have been among the critics of changes set to affect backpackers, who the former rely on to pick fruit in the regions.

Only 45,000 working holiday-makers will be able to stay in Australia for a second year under the system, and only 5,000 for a third year — down from 57,000 and 31,000 respectively.

The National Farmers' Federation is advocating for changes to visa policies, seeking solutions to this pressing issue. reflection.zh: 农业部门面临着严重的劳动力短缺，农作物面临腐烂的风险。全国农民联合会正在倡导修改签证政策，为这一紧迫问题寻求解决方案。这种情况凸显了在应对影响生计和粮食安全的复杂经济挑战时，寻求明智的建议和专家意见的重要性。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: 'A struggle every day': There's a hidden side to Australia's student visa debate
title.zh: “每天都在挣扎”：澳大利亚学生签证辩论的隐秘一面

summary.en: Australia is tightening its migration system, with new rules targeting visa-hopping and some international students. The story follows Khalid, who arrived as an international student in 2017 and faced significant challenges transitioning to the workforce after completing his degrees.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚正在收紧其移民系统，新规定针对签证跳跃和一些国际学生。故事讲述了哈立德（Khalid）的经历，他于2017年作为国际学生抵达澳大利亚，在完成学位后，在向技术工人过渡的过程中面临着重大挑战。

body.en:
He arrived as an international student in 2017, completed a three-year bachelor's degree in business and then a two-year master's degree before entering the workforce.

Khalid first moved onto a temporary graduate visa, known as a subclass 485, and recently secured a subclass 482 work visa after finding employment in sales.

He told SBS News that making the transition from international student to skilled worker was far from straightforward.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

One of the biggest difficulties was convincing an employer to invest in someone whose ability to remain in Australia had an expiry date attached to it.

"We basically have to work twice as hard, or we just have to prove our skill set to our employers," he said.

At one point, Khalid's temporary graduate visa was approaching expiry while his employer-sponsored visa application was still being processed.

"Every day when you wake up, or every day you're going into the office to work, you're not sure whether the application will be approved or not ... It's basically a struggle every day."

Now, the federal government has announced another suite of changes aimed at tightening Australia's migration system and further reducing net overseas migration (NOM).

The changes include measures targeting so-called "visa hopping", restrictions on secondary applicants on most student visas and stronger measures to ensure people without valid visas leave Australia.

The government will also introduce a 'no further stay' condition on all visitor visas and crack down on migration agents it says knowingly support applications without merit.

Announcing the reforms on Thursday, Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke said the government was targeting people who would "never" meet the requirements for permanent residency but continued moving through the migration system to extend their stay.

"They effectively jump from visa to visa, use the appeals process to be able to stay here as long as possible until it eventually becomes absurd to not just let them stay," he said.

Khalid said he believes there should be a clearer distinction between people switching courses simply to stay in the country, and migrants legitimately progressing through study and skilled employment.

"We have contributed to the economy. We have paid our taxes. We have done everything right by the book," he said.

"If they could genuinely prove that the change of career is more of a personal choice and not just for a visa hopping case, then I think they should be given a fair chance."

Former immigration department deputy secretary Abul Rizvi also supports reducing visa hopping but cautioned against applying restrictions too...
body.zh: 他于 2017 年以国际学生的身份来到这里，完成了三年的商业学士学位，然后在进入职场之前完成了两年的硕士学位。 Khalid 首先获得了临时毕业生签证（称为 485 子类），最近在找到销售工作后又获得了 482 子类工作签证。 他告诉 SBS 新闻，从国际学生到技术工人的转变绝非易事。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 最大的困难之一是说服雇主投资于有能力留在澳大利亚且附有到期日的人。 “我们基本上必须加倍努力工作，或者我们只需向雇主证明我们的技能，”他说。 有一次，哈立德的临时毕业生签证即将到期，而他的雇主担保的签证申请仍在处理中。 “每天当你起床的时候，或者每天你去办公室上班的时候，你都不确定申请是否会被批准……基本上每天都是一场斗争。” 现在，联邦政府宣布了另一套改革措施，旨在收紧澳大利亚的移民制度并进一步减少净海外移民（NOM）。 这些变化包括针对所谓“签证跳跃”的措施、对大多数学生签证的第二申请人的限制以及确保没有有效签证的人离开澳大利亚的更强有力的措施。 政府还将对所有访客签证引入“不得进一步停留”的条件，并打击移民代理，称其明知无理地支持申请。 内政部长托尼·伯克周四宣布改革时表示，政府的目标是那些“永远”无法满足永久居留要求但继续通过移民系统延长居留期限的人。 他说：“他们实际上从一个签证跳到另一个签证，利用上诉程序尽可能长时间地留在这里，直到最终不让他们留下来变得荒谬。” 哈立德表示，他认为，仅仅为了留在国内而转学的人和通过学习和技术就业合法取得进步的移民之间应该有更明确的区别。 “我们为经济做出了贡献。我们已经缴纳了税款。我们按照规定做了所有事情，”他说。 “如果他们能够真正证明转行更多的是个人选择，而不仅仅是为了跳签证，那么我认为他们应该得到公平的机会。” 前移民部副部长阿布尔·里兹维（Abul Rizvi）也支持减少签证跳跃，但警告不要也施加限制......

reflection.en: Khalid's journey from student to worker in Australia illustrates the complex realities faced by many international students. The biblical call to welcome the foreigner, treating them as native-born, challenges us to consider the human impact of migration policies and to offer support and understanding to those seeking a new home.
reflection.zh: 哈立德在澳大利亚从学生转变为工人的经历，生动地展现了许多国际学生所面临的复杂现实。圣经呼吁要像接待本地人一样接待外国人，这促使我们反思移民政策对人的影响，并向那些寻求新家园的人提供支持和理解。

verse.textEn: And you are to love those who are foreigners, for you yourselves were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要怜爱寄居的，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: Veterans relieved as Labor backs down on plan to limit health payments
title.zh: 退伍军人对工党放弃限制医疗付款计划感到宽慰

summary.en: The government has abandoned plans to cap veterans' allied health payments at $5,000 annually, following significant criticism from veterans, politicians, and advocates. This decision reverses a measure intended to save money but which drew widespread condemnation.
summary.zh: 在退伍军人、政界人士和倡导者提出大量批评后，政府已放弃了将退伍军人附属医疗付款上限设为每年5000澳元的计划。这一决定推翻了一项旨在节省资金但遭到广泛谴责的措施。

body.en:
Labor has dumped controversial plans for a $5,000 cap on veterans' allied health payments as part of its "solemn obligation" to ex-serving personnel.

Following sustained criticism and campaigning from advocates, Veterans' Affairs Minister Matt Keogh announced on Thursday the government had backed down on the measure.

In a bid to improve the budget's bottom line, the government introduced a $5,000 annual limit on allied health services for veterans which was originally set to come into effect from July 2027.

This would have resulted in cutting more than $779 million over the next four years from the portfolio.

The proposal attracted widespread condemnation, with the coalition, Greens and crossbench all calling for Labor to dump the cap.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Keogh said the government took its "solemn obligation" to veterans very seriously.

"We brought forward a package of measures to improve access to allied health, improving the fees paid to allied health practitioners, so that they would provide better service to our veteran community," he told parliament.

"And as part of that, we also committed and did engage with the ex-service organisations, with veterans, with families ... and we committed to listen, and we did, and we heard, and we have responded."

Keogh has faced calls in recent weeks to resign after he initially declined to meet with advocates over the cap.

The government was criticised after the parents of Cameron Baird, who was killed in 2013 during a deployment to Afghanistan, were told their travel allowance would be cut.

Fair Care for Veterans spokesman John Armfield, a former Navy clearance diver, thanked Mr Keogh for dumping the cap.

"The minister says he wants to keep talking to veterans and providers. We welcome that, and we'll be there.

"We'll also make sure whatever comes next doesn't bring the cap back under another name."

Veteran and Tasmanian senator Jacqui Lambie, alongside Greens senator David Shoebridge, successfully passed a bill in the upper house to stop any future cap being imposed on health payments.

Lambie, who gave an emotional address about the healthcare barriers facing female veterans, hailed the win.

She urged veterans not to take out their anger on Keogh or the department, noting the work completed on implementing key reforms from the Royal Commission into Defence and Veteran Suicide.

"I have seen more movement in the last two years since that Royal Commission than what I have in the whole 10 years I've bloody been up here," Lambie told reporters.

"They are working hard, and there will be slips along the way, and that is my job to represent you guys up here."

Shoebridge said there...
body.zh: 工党放弃了一项颇具争议的计划，即退伍军人联合医疗费用上限为 5,000 美元，作为其对退伍军人“庄严义务”的一部分。 在倡导者的持续批评和竞选之后，退伍军人事务部长马特·基奥周四宣布政府已放弃这项措施。 为了提高预算底线，政府对退伍军人联合医疗服务实行每年 5,000 美元的限额，该限额最初定于 2027 年 7 月生效。 这将导致未来四年从投资组合中削减超过 7.79 亿美元。 该提议引起了广泛的谴责，联盟党、绿党和中立议员都呼吁工党取消这一上限。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 基奥表示，政府非常重视对退伍军人的“庄严义务”。 他对议会说：“我们提出了一系列措施，以改善联合医疗服务的可及性，提高支付给联合医疗从业人员的费用，以便他们为我们的退伍军人社区提供更好的服务。” “作为其中的一部分，我们还承诺并确实与退伍军人组织、退伍军人、家庭进行接触……我们承诺倾听，我们做到了，我们听到了，我们也做出了回应。” 基奥最初拒绝与上限问题的支持者会面，最近几周他面临着辞职的呼声。 卡梅伦·贝尔德 (Cameron Baird) 于 2013 年在部署到阿富汗期间被杀，他的父母被告知他们的旅行津贴将被削减，此后政府受到了批评。 退伍军人公平关怀组织发言人约翰·阿姆菲尔德（John Armfield）是一名前海军潜水员，他感谢基奥先生抛弃了帽子。 “部长说他希望继续与退伍军人和提供者交谈。我们对此表示欢迎，我们会在那里。 “我们还将确保接下来发生的任何事情都不会导致上限以其他名称重新出现。” 退伍军人、塔斯马尼亚参议员雅基·兰比 (Jacqui Lambie) 与绿党参议员大卫·舒布里奇 (David Shoebridge) 一起在上议院成功通过了一项法案，以阻止未来对医疗费用施加上限。 兰比就女性退伍军人面临的医疗保健障碍发表了激动人心的演讲，并对这一胜利表示欢迎。 她敦促退伍军人不要向基奥或国防部发泄愤怒，并指出皇家委员会在国防和退伍军人自杀方面实施关键改革的工作已经完成。 兰比告诉记者：“自皇家委员会成立以来，我在过去两年中看到的动向比我在这里待了整整十年还要多。” “他们正在努力工作，一路上难免会出现失误，而我的工作就是代表你们。” 舒布里奇在那里说...

reflection.en: Veterans Affairs Minister Matt Keogh announced the government would not proceed with capping allied health payments for veterans. This decision came after weeks of campaigning by advocates, demonstrating the power of speaking up for those who might otherwise be unheard. It reflects a commitment to care for those who have served.
reflection.zh: 退伍军人事务部长马特·基奥宣布，政府将不再对退伍军人的附属医疗付款设限。这一决定是在倡导者们进行了数周的宣传活动之后做出的，这表明了为那些可能被忽视的群体发声的力量。这体现了对服役人员的关怀承诺。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: 'HK should spare no effort on RMB globalisation'
title.zh: 香港应不遗余力推动人民币国际化

summary.en: Peter Wong, Chairman of HSBC Asia-Pacific, stated that Hong Kong should "spare no effort" in promoting the internationalization of the renminbi. He highlighted Hong Kong's unique position as China's sole international financial center and suggested that growing the renminbi fund pool would enable banks to offer more...
summary.zh: 汇丰亚太区主席王冬胜表示，香港应“不遗余力”推动人民币国际化。他强调香港作为中国唯一国际金融中心的独特地位，并指出增加人民币资金池将使银行能够提供更多产品，例如直接购买港股，从而巩固香港的金融地位。

body.en: Chairman of HSBC Asia‑Pacific, Peter Wong, says Hong Kong should "spare no effort" in promoting the internationalisation of the renminbi. Speaking on RTHK's "On Broadcast Drive", he said Hong Kong's key advantage is being China's only international financial centre and promoting the renminbi's internationalisation would strengthen that position. He said Hong Kong needs to grow its pool of renminbi funds because the more money there is, the more products banks can offer. "If you have a big pool of funds, you can create new products," he said. "For example, if renminbi can be used to directly buy Hong Kong stocks, then other countries with surplus renminbi can come straight to Hong Kong to invest. That would make Hong Kong more and more vibrant. In this world, money attracts money." He also cited China's partners in South America, Africa and Asean that already use renminbi for trade settlement. He said if their surplus renminbi could be brought to Hong Kong, the city's renminbi pool would grow, making Hong Kong the biggest and strongest offshore renminbi centre. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 汇丰亚太区主席黄彼得表示，香港应“不遗余力”推动人民币国际化。他在香港电台的《On Broadcast Drive》节目中表示，香港的主要优势是作为中国唯一的国际金融中心，推动人民币国际化将巩固这一地位。他表示，香港需要扩大人民币基金池，因为资金越多，银行可以提供的产品就越多。 “如果你有大量资金，你就可以创造新产品，”他说。 “比如，如果可以用人民币直接购买香港股票，那么其他有人民币盈余的国家就可以直接来香港投资。这会让香港变得越来越有活力。在这个世界上，钱会吸引钱。”他还列举了中国在南美、非洲和东盟的合作伙伴已经使用人民币进行贸易结算。他表示，如果他们的盈余人民币能够转移到香港，香港的人民币池将会扩大，使香港成为最大、最强的离岸人民币中心。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: The pursuit of financial growth and strategic positioning often involves careful planning and execution. As leaders like Peter Wong advocate for specific economic strategies, the principle of committing one's endeavors to divine guidance offers a foundation for responsible decision-making. May wisdom direct such efforts toward sustainable prosperity and...
reflection.zh: 追求金融增长和战略定位通常需要周密的规划和执行。当像王冬胜这样的领导者倡导特定的经济策略时，将自己的努力托付于神的指引，为负责任的决策提供了基础。愿智慧引导这些努力，走向可持续的繁荣和福祉。

title.en: Friends, rights groups worry for Chinese #MeToo activist’s life after jail
title.zh: 朋友、人权组织担心中国#MeToo活动人士生命安危，因其入狱

summary.en: Rio, who once joined jailed Chinese #MeToo activist Sophia Huang Xueqin for weekly discussions on social issues, now worries about her life after prison. Huang, a journalist, has been detained since 2021 and was sentenced to five years for allegedly inciting dissatisfaction with state power by organizing meetings.
summary.zh: 里约曾与被监禁的中国#MeToo活动人士黄雪琴一起参加每周的社会议题讨论小组，现在担心她在出狱后的生活。黄雪琴是一名记者，自2021年以来一直被监禁，她因组织会议等罪名被判处五年徒刑，据称她煽动了对中国国家权力的不满。

body.en: Rio once joined his friend, jailed Chinese #MeToo activist Sophia Huang Xueqin, for weekly group discussions on social issues and shared struggles, and now worries about how she will navigate life after prison. Huang took a series of photos of herself with the hashtag #Metoo and posted them on social media. Photo: Sophia Huang. Huang, a journalist, has been behind bars since 2021 , when she and labour activist Wang Jianbing were detained for co-organising those meetings, among other charges. A Chinese court sentenced Huang to five years in prison, saying in 2024 that the pair had “incited participants’ dissatisfaction with Chinese state power under the pretext of discussing social issues”. Though Huang is due to be released on Friday, Rio and rights groups say they are concerned that she will remain under the thumb of Chinese authorities. Speaking to AFP from the United States, Rio — who wanted to provide only his English name — recalled joining the meetings six years ago, which he described as a safe space for wide-ranging chats. Photo: Sophia Huang. Huang had endured solitary confinement, lost over five kilograms and went four months without menstruating while in detention, her supporters said, citing sources such as former inmates who had met the activist. Amnesty International warned this week in an open letter signed by more than 50 rights organisations that Huang would continue to face “restrictions” even after leaving prison. Huang will be deprived of her political rights for four years after her release — a “supplemental sentence” that is “routinely imposed on human rights defenders and journalists to restrict their ability to speak, publish and organise long after their prison terms end”, it said. For Huang, the restrictions on her freedom of speech and her movements within China will be a heavy burden, Rio told AFP. “Sophia is a journalist, and as a journalist, if you don’t have freedom of expression… you’ve stripped away their primary tool,” he said. “We can foresee that her right to express herself freely online in the future will likely be heavily monitored.” #MeToo symbol Huang was an outspoken supporter of women’s rights, writing on social media about experiencing workplace sexual harassment at a Chinese news agency in the wake of the global #MeToo movement. Women’s rights is a sensitive topic in China, where authorities have suppressed almost every form of feminist activism over the last decade. Since President Xi Jinping took power in 2012, Beijing has also tightened its grip on civil society and free speech, stamping out all forms of dissent. The court sentencing Huang said she had repeatedly published...
body.zh: 里奥曾经和他的朋友、被监禁的中国#MeToo活动家索菲亚·黄雪琴一起，每周进行一次关于社会问题和共同斗争的小组讨论，现在他担心她出狱后将如何度过生活。黄用#Metoo 标签拍摄了一系列自己的照片，并将其发布到社交媒体上。照片：索菲亚黄。黄是一名记者，自 2021 年以来一直入狱，当时她和劳工活动人士王建兵因共同组织这些会议等罪名而被拘留。 2024年，中国一家法院判处黄某五年有期徒刑，称两人“以讨论社会问题为借口，煽动参与者对中国国家权力的不满”。尽管黄定于周五获释，但力拓和人权组织表示，他们担心她仍将受到中国当局的控制。里奥在美国接受法新社采访时回忆起六年前参加的会议，他称这是一个进行广泛交谈的安全空间。他只想提供自己的英文名字。照片：索菲亚黄。黄的支持者援引曾见过这位活动人士的消息人士称，黄在拘留期间遭受了单独监禁，体重减轻了五公斤以上，并且四个月没有来月经。国际特赦组织本周在一封由 50 多个人权组织签署的公开信中警告称，即使黄出狱后也将继续面临“限制”。声明称，黄在获释后将被剥夺四年的政治权利，这是一种“补充刑罚”，“是对人权捍卫者和记者的例行施加，以限制他们在刑期结束后很长一段时间内言论、出版和组织的能力”。里奥告诉法新社，对黄来说，在中国境内对她的言论自由和行动自由的限制将是一个沉重的负担。 “索菲亚是一名记者，作为一名记者，如果你没有言论自由……你就剥夺了他们的主要工具，”他说。 “我们可以预见，她未来在网上自由表达自己的权利可能会受到严格监控。” #MeToo 的象征黄是一位直言不讳的女权支持者，她在社交媒体上撰文讲述了全球 #MeToo 运动后在一家中国新闻机构经历的工作场所性骚扰事件。妇女权利在中国是一个敏感话题，过去十年当局镇压了几乎所有形式的女权运动。自2012年习近平主席上台以来，北京还加强了对公民社会和言论自由的控制，压制一切形式的异议。法院宣判黄说，她曾多次发表...

reflection.en: Sophia Huang Xueqin, a journalist and #MeToo activist, faces a challenging future after serving a five-year prison sentence in China. Her friend's concern underscores the isolation and vulnerability of those who speak out against injustice. The call to 'speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves' is a vital reminder of our responsibility to advocate...
reflection.zh: 记者兼#MeToo活动人士黄雪琴在中国服刑五年后，面临着严峻的未来。她的朋友的担忧，凸显了那些为不公发声者的孤立和脆弱。‘为不能说话者说话’的呼吁，是提醒我们有责任为受压迫者和无声者发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Australian Hyrox athlete who soiled herself apologises for continuing Beijing race
title.zh: 弄脏自己的香港Hyrox运动员为继续北京比赛道歉

summary.en: An Australian athlete, Joanna Wietrzyk, who competed in a Beijing Hyrox race last weekend despite soiling herself, has apologized and forfeited her winnings. Her actions sparked backlash online due to potential health risks to other competitors.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚选手Joanna Wietrzyk上周末在北京参加Hyrox比赛时，尽管在比赛中失禁，但她仍继续比赛，并为此道歉，放弃了比赛奖金。她的行为因可能对其他参赛者构成健康风险而引发了网上的强烈反对。

body.en: An Australian athlete who sparked an outcry when she kept competing despite soiling herself midway through an event in Beijing apologised Friday and forfeited her points from winning. Photo: Joanna Wietrzyk, via Instagram. Joanna Wietrzyk finished the Hyrox indoor fitness race last weekend with excrement on her legs and shoes, continuing to use the mats and equipment. It sparked backlash about potential health hazards posed to other competitors and went viral on social media. “I want to offer my sincere apology to the people of China, my fellow competitors, the spectators and the Hyrox organisers for what happened during the race in Beijing,” Wietrzyk said on Instagram. “I felt completely fit and healthy at the start of the race, with no reason to expect any illness. “Looking back, I regret the decision to not have stepped off the track. I recognise that I should have made a different choice.” Embed from Getty Images window.gie=window.gie||function(c){(gie.q=gie.q||[]).push(c)};gie(function(){gie.widgets.load({id:'aM00rSAoRd5SpK7RXDEjWQ',sig:'QUjz_mZ30fSW9kUyZtqGUVuQF96YomE3y1HOm6l6_HQ=',w:'594px',h:'396px',items:'2294362674',caption: true ,tld:'com',is360: false })}); The 23-year-old world record holder said she had retroactively withdrawn from the race and would hand back the points earned from competing. “I am learning from this experience and will carry those lessons with me, including remembering that there is more to life than racing and knowing when it is right to step away,” she added. “I will be taking some time to recover, reflect and look after myself and my family away from the noise.” Revised rules Hyrox, a popular fitness competition launched in Germany and held worldwide, features a mixture of treadmill running and strength exercises, such as lunges and rowing. Co-founder Moritz Furste apologised on Monday to “all who were directly or indirectly involved” as intense criticism swelled over its health and safety standards. “Hyrox made a mistake by not reacting immediately during the race,” added Furste. “In the end it is my job to foresee these potential incidents — and I did not.” It has since updated its rules. They now state that if a “racer’s blood, vomit, urine, or faeces poses a welfare or contamination risk to the racer or to other racers, a race director may withdraw the racer from the race on medical grounds”.
body.zh: 一名澳大利亚运动员在北京的一场比赛中途弄脏了自己，但仍继续比赛，引发了强烈抗议，她周五道歉并取消了获胜所得的积分。照片：Joanna Wietrzyk，来自 Instagram。乔安娜·维特兹克 (Joanna Wietrzyk) 上周末完成了 Hyrox 室内健身比赛，腿上和鞋子上都有排泄物，但仍继续使用垫子和设备。这引发了人们对其他参赛者潜在健康危害的强烈反对，并在社交媒体上疯传。 Wietrzyk 在 Instagram 上表示：“我想就北京比赛期间发生的事情向中国人民、我的竞争对手、观众和 Hyrox 组织者表示诚挚的歉意。” “比赛开始时我感觉完全健康，没有理由担心会生病。“回想起来，我很遗憾没有离开赛道的决定。我认识到我应该做出不同的选择。”嵌入来自 Getty Images window.gie=window.gie||function(c){(gie.q=gie.q||[]).push(c)};gie(function(){gie.widgets.load({id:'aM00rSAoRd5 SpK7RXDEjWQ'，sig：'QUjz_mZ30fSW9kUyZtqGUVuQF96YomE3y1HOm6l6_HQ='，w：'594px'，h：'396px'，项目：'2294362674'，标题： true ,tld:'com',is360: false })});这位23岁的世界纪录保持者表示，她已追溯退出比赛，并将返还比赛获得的积分。她补充道：“我正在从这次经历中学习，并将随身携带这些教训，包括记住生活中除了比赛之外还有更多的事情，以及知道何时该离开。” “我将花一些时间来恢复、反思并照顾自己和家人，远离噪音。”修订后的规则 Hyrox 是一项在德国发起并在全球范围内举办的流行健身比赛，其特点是混合跑步机跑步和力量练习，例如弓步和划船。由于对其健康和安全标准的强烈批评，联合创始人莫里茨·弗斯特周一向“所有直接或间接参与的人”道歉。 “Hyrox 犯了一个错误，在比赛中没有立即做出反应，”弗斯特补充道。 “最终，预见这些潜在事件是我的工作——但我没有。”此后它更新了规则。他们现在声明，如果“赛车手的血液、呕吐物、尿液或粪便对赛车手或其他赛车手构成福利或污染风险，赛事总监可以以医疗理由让该赛车手退出比赛”。

reflection.en: In the aftermath of a viral incident, Joanna Wietrzyk has offered a sincere apology and relinquished her victory points. This act of taking responsibility, though difficult, can help to de-escalate public anger and begin the process of reconciliation.
reflection.zh: 在一次引起广泛关注的事件之后，Joanna Wietrzyk 表达了诚挚的歉意并放弃了她的胜利积分。这种承担责任的行为，尽管困难，但有助于缓和公众的愤怒，并开启和解的进程。

verse.textEn: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
verse.textZh: 回答柔和，使怒消退；言语暴戾，触动怒气。

title.en: Hong Kong talent schemes could add 1.2% to GDP annually, John Lee says
title.zh: 香港人才计划每年可为GDP贡献1.2%，李家超表示

He also noted that over half of these individuals, after completing three years, express a willingness to remain in Hong Kong. The government has successfully...
summary.zh: 香港行政长官李家超表示，通过各项吸纳人才计划吸引到香港的人才，每年可为该市的国内生产总值（GDP）贡献约1.2%。他还指出，在完成三年期限后，超过半数的人才愿意留在香港。政府通过这些措施已吸引了超过30万人，其中约20%来自中国内地以外的地区。

body.en: Talent attracted to Hong Kong under various admission schemes could add about 1.2 per cent to the city’s gross domestic product (GDP) each year, the city leader has said, adding that more than half of those reaching the three-year mark are willing to stay. Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu said on Friday the government had attracted more than 300,000 people through its talent measures, with about 20 per cent from places outside mainland China. “These talent will create an extra GDP of probably...

reflection.en: The news highlights how strategic efforts to attract skilled individuals can yield significant economic benefits, contributing to a city's prosperity. This reminds us that Yahweh is the ultimate source of our ability to create and gain wealth, a power we are called to steward wisely for the common good.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻强调了吸引技术人才的战略性举措可以带来显著的经济效益，为城市的繁荣做出贡献。这提醒我们，雅伟是我们创造和获取财富能力的最终源泉，我们被呼召明智地管理这种能力，以促进共同福祉。

verse.textEn: Remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.
verse.textZh: 你要记念雅伟你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的。

title.en: Hong Kong IT analyst charged with murdering wife at their flat
title.zh: 香港一名IT分析师被控在家中谋杀妻子

summary.en: A 51-year-old IT analyst in Hong Kong has been charged with murder after his wife was found dead in their apartment two days prior. The defendant appeared calm in court.
summary.zh: 一名51岁的香港IT分析师因其妻子两天前被发现死于家中公寓而被控谋杀罪。被告在法庭上显得镇定。

Wong Chi-kwong, 51, was brought to Eastern Court for the first time on Friday to face a count of murder. Police arrested him on Wednesday after his wife, 53-year-old Wong Yuk-ting, was found dead in a flat in block 2 of Heng Fa Chuen estate in Chai Wan. The defendant appeared composed in the dock when the murder charge against him was read out. He...
body.zh: 一名香港IT分析师被指控两天前在私人住宅区的公寓里杀害妻子，目前已被还押。 51岁的黄志光于周五首次被带至东区法院，面临谋杀罪名。周三，他的妻子、53岁的黄玉婷被发现死在柴湾杏花村第二座的一间单位内，警方于周三逮捕了他。当宣读对被告的谋杀指控时，被告在被告席上显得很平静。他...

Isaiah 1:17 calls us to 'learn to do good; seek justice, rebuke the oppressed, defend the fatherless, plead for the widow.' This verse urges us to actively care for those suffering in silence, recognizing the profound need for...
reflection.zh: 一名丈夫被控谋杀妻子的新闻，令人警醒地提醒我们，暴力可能隐藏在紧闭的门后。以赛亚书1:17呼吁我们“你们要学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的，给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇争讼。”这节经文敦促我们要积极关怀那些默默承受痛苦的人，认识到家庭内部对公正和保护的深切需求。

title.en: 'School merger scheme to launch as soon as next year'
title.zh: 学校合并计划最快下学年启动

summary.en: Hong Kong's Education Secretary, Christine Choi, announced on Friday that a scheme to encourage and support the merger of publicly-funded primary and secondary schools will be launched as early as the 2027/28 academic year. The 'Confluence and Elevation – School Excellence Project' aims to pool resources from school...
summary.zh: 香港教育局局长蔡若莲周五宣布，一项鼓励和支持公营中小学合并的计划最快将于2027/28学年启动。该“汇聚与提升——学校卓越计划”旨在应对学生人口下降的问题，鼓励学校主办团体整合资源，以提升教育质量。

body.en: Education secretary Christine Choi on Friday said that a scheme which encourages and supports publicly-funded primary and secondary schools to merge would pave the way for better education amid a drop in the city's student population. Speaking on an RTHK radio show to explain the city’s first five-year plan and Policy Address, she said that the “Confluence and Elevation – School Excellence Project” would be launched in the 2027/28 academic year at the earliest, and her bureau was currently discussing the details with relevant stakeholders. "The main objective is to encourage school sponsoring bodies to pool their resources, rather than treating this as an option when there is a crisis in student enrolment or when they are allocated zero classes," she said. "Therefore, we will be more flexible and accommodating in our policies, and offer as much support and convenience as possible." Choi said there would be a cap on the scheme, and that the government had to be very selective. For instance, when it comes to operating schools with unique characteristics, the minister said the scale of the school cannot be too small, stressing that it is equally important to have high-quality courses and teaching standards. She said that while aided schools could merge with Direct Subsidy Scheme schools, the two cannot merge with government schools. This is because teachers at government schools are civil servants, Choi said, and a merger between aided and Direct Subsidy Scheme schools would result in relatively minor issues. The minister noted that following a merger, the two schools might get to retain both campuses during the transition period as one might not be able to accommodate all pupils. As for a surplus in teaching staff, the minister said her bureau would set aside resources to assist those in need. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 教育部长 Christine Choi 周五表示，一项鼓励和支持公立中小学合并的计划将为在该市学生人数下降的情况下提供更好的教育铺平道路。她在香港电台节目中解释香港第一个五年规划及施政报告时表示，“融合提升——卓越学校计划”最快将于2027/28学年推出，局方现正与相关持份者商讨细节。她说：“主要目标是鼓励办学机构集中资源，而不是将其视为学生入学危机或零班级分配时的一种选择。” “因此，我们的政策将更加灵活、包容，并提供尽可能多的支持和便利。”崔表示，该计划将会有一个上限，政府必须非常有选择性。比如，在办办特色学校方面，部长表示，学校规模不能太小，强调高质量的课程和教学水平同样重要。她表示，资助学校可以与直资学校合并，但两者不能与官立学校合并。崔说，这是因为官立学校的教师是公务员，资助学校和直接资助学校合并会带来相对较小的问题。部长指出，合并后，两所学校可能会在过渡期间保留两个校区，因为一个校区可能无法容纳所有学生。至于教职人员过剩的问题，部长表示，她的局将拨出资源来帮助有需要的人。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: The announcement of the 'Confluence and Elevation – School Excellence Project' marks a significant step in Hong Kong's education policy. This initiative, aimed at pooling resources to improve educational quality amidst demographic shifts, reflects a commitment to strategic planning and development. May the efforts of the Education Bureau and all...
reflection.zh: 香港教育局宣布启动“汇聚与提升——学校卓越计划”，标志着教育政策的一项重要举措。这项旨在整合资源以应对人口结构变化并提升教育质量的计划，体现了对战略规划和发展的承诺。愿教育局及所有相关方的努力都能蒙受智慧的引导，为学生和教育工作者带来蓬勃发展的成果。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.

title.en: Planned AI ‘City Brain’ system not meant for surveillance – top Hong Kong official
title.zh: 香港官员称，计划中的人工智能“城市大脑”系统并非用于监控

summary.en: Hong Kong's Chief Secretary for Administration, Eric Chan, stated that a planned HK$200 million AI "City Brain" system, intended for urban management and emergency response, is not designed for surveillance, addressing public privacy concerns.
summary.zh: 香港政务司司长陈国基表示，一项耗资2亿港元的人工智能（AI）“城市大脑”系统，旨在改善城市管理和应急响应，并非用于监控，以回应公众对隐私的担忧。

body.en: A planned HK$200 million artificial intelligence (AI) “City Brain” system designed to improve urban management and emergency response is not meant for surveillance, a top Hong Kong official has said. Chief Secretary for Administration Eric Chan. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Chief Secretary for Administration Eric Chan addressed privacy concerns about the AI system at a Thursday press conference – one day after Chief Executive John Lee delivered the city’s first Five-Year Plan and the final Policy Address of his term. The city brain “isn’t meant for surveillance,” said Chan, who is heading the task force overseeing the project, to be formed in the fourth quarter of 2026. “It’s just about monitoring traffic and urban conditions , not monitoring individuals, crime, or catching thieves,” Chan said. He added: “In the past, if a water pipe burst was detected, you’d wait for it to burst or get repaired. Now, it’s different. Through the city brain, this data is handed, for instance, to the Transport Department so they can deploy immediately.” The government aims to complete the first stage of the system’s development in the first quarter of 2028. It is expected to take six to nine years before the city brain system reaches full operational capacity. Buses outside department store Sogo in Causeway Bay. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The City Brain software system was pioneered by Chinese tech giant Alibaba in Hangzhou in 2017. Since then, the urban AI has spread to cities throughout the Chinese mainland. It was also later launched in Malaysia’s capital, Kuala Lumpur. The platform promises to centralise real-time data from a variety of sources – CCTV cameras, tracking systems, smart sensors, government databases, social media and mobile apps – and then use this information to optimise traffic lights, waste management, and other aspects of urban governance. System integration The digital infrastructure of the Security Bureau’s Emergency Monitoring and Support Centre is scheduled for integration in the first phase. Workers clear up Wong Tai Sin MTR station on September 8, 2023, after Hong Kong was hit by record-breaking rainfall. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The project will also prioritise integrating the Civil Engineering and Development Department’s AI Landslip Warning System, the Drainage Services Department’s AI Flood Monitoring System, the Transport Department’s Real-time Traffic Signal Adjustment System, and the Highways Department’s Flood Early Warning System. The police force will also set up a new “Inter-departmental Major Incident Platform” to centralise real-time data from all units when handling major public incidents.
body.zh: 香港一位高级官员表示，计划耗资 2 亿港元的人工智能“城市大脑”系统旨在改善城市管理和应急响应，并非用于监视。政务司司长陈家祥。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。政务司司长陈家伟在周四的新闻发布会上谈到了有关人工智能系统的隐私问题，一天前，行政长官李家超发表了香港第一个五年计划和任期内的最后一份施政报告。负责监督该项目的特别工作组将于 2026 年第四季度成立的陈说，城市大脑“不是用来监视的”。“它只是监视交通和城市状况，而不是监视个人、犯罪或抓小偷，”陈说。他补充道：“过去，如果检测到水管破裂，你会等待它破裂或修复。现在不同了。通过城市大脑，这些数据会被交给交通部门等机构，以便他们立即部署。”政府的目标是在2028年第一季度完成该系统第一阶段的开发。预计城市大脑系统需要六到九年的时间才能达到全面运行能力。铜锣湾崇光百货外的巴士。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。城市大脑软件系统由中国科技巨头阿里巴巴于2017年在杭州首创。此后，城市人工智能已遍及中国大陆的各个城市。后来它也在马来西亚首都吉隆坡推出。该平台承诺集中来自各种来源的实时数据——闭路电视摄像机、跟踪系统、智能传感器、政府数据库、社交媒体和移动应用程序——然后利用这些信息来优化交通信号灯、废物管理和城市治理的其他方面。系统整合 保安局应急监察支援中心的数字基础设施计划第一阶段进行整合。 2023 年 9 月 8 日，香港遭受破纪录的降雨后，工人们清理黄大仙地铁站。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。该项目亦会优先整合土木工程拓展署的人工智能山泥倾泻预警系统、渠务署的人工智能水浸监测系统、运输署的实时交通信号调整系统，以及路政署的水浸预警系统。警队还将建立新的“跨部门重大事件平台”，在处理重大公共事件时集中各单位的实时数据。

reflection.en: As Hong Kong plans its AI "City Brain" system, officials assure it's for efficiency, not surveillance. This technology, while powerful, prompts reflection on human dignity. Genesis 1:27 reminds us that every person is made in the image of God, a truth that should guide our development and use of artificial intelligence.
reflection.zh: 随着香港计划推出其人工智能“城市大脑”系统，官员们保证其目的是提高效率而非用于监控。这项技术虽然强大，但促使人们反思人类的尊严。创世记1:27提醒我们，每个人都是照着雅伟的形象所造，这一真理应指导我们开发和使用人工智能。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Tung public service hailed as condolence books open
title.zh: 悼念书籍开放，赞扬董建华的公共服务

summary.en: Condolence books were opened across Hong Kong on Friday for people to pay respects to the city's first chief executive, Tung Chee-hwa, who died on September 8 at age 89. At a condolence point in Causeway Bay, residents paid tribute to Tung, with one man recalling his "kind character" and "very hard time in office,"...
summary.zh: 周五，香港各地开放了吊唁簿，供市民悼念香港首任行政长官董建华，他于9月8日去世，享年89岁。在铜锣湾的一个吊唁点，市民们向董建华致敬，其中一人回忆起他“善良的品格”和“在任期间非常艰难的时期”，另一人则称赞他“全心全意为香港服务”。

body.en: Condolence books were opened up across the city on Friday for people to pay their respects to Hong Kong's first chief executive, Tung Chee-hwa, who passed away on September 8 at the age of 89. At one of the condolence points, Moreton Terrace Activities Centre in Causeway Bay, a photograph of Tung was placed at the centre of an auditorium, framed by white flowers. Residents turned up to sign the condolence book. One man, Poon, came from Chai Wan to pay tribute to Tung, praising the late city leader for his kind character and noting that he had a very hard time in office. Another man, So, said Tung was wholehearted in his dedication to serving Hong Kong and making contributions. "Today is the first day of mourning for chief executive Tung," So said.
