"As a Hong Kong resident, I wanted to express my gratitude to him. "In my condolence message, I wrote: 'Chief Executive Tung, your selfless dedication throughout your life enabled Hong Kong people to transition smoothly. You will always be remembered." A private vigil will take place on Saturday at Hong Kong Funeral Home in North Point, followed by a public memorial service on Sunday. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 周五，全城各地纷纷展开吊唁簿，悼念香港首任特首董建华，他于9月8日去世，享年89岁。在铜锣湾摩顿台活动中心的一个吊唁点，礼堂中央放置了一张董建华的照片，周围镶着白色的花。居民们到场在吊唁簿上签名。一名名叫潘的男子从柴湾赶来悼念董建华，称赞这位已故市领导的仁慈品格，并指出他在任期间过得非常艰难。另一位男子苏表示，董先生一心一意为香港服务，作出贡献。苏说：“今天是为行政长官董建华哀悼的第一天。” “作为一名香港居民，我想向他表示感谢。”在吊唁信中，我写道：‘董行政长官，您一生的无私奉献，让香港人民顺利过渡。人们将永远记住你。”周六，北角香港殡仪馆将举行私人守夜活动，周日将举行公众追悼会。编辑：Tony Sabine

reflection.en: As Hong Kongers remember Tung Chee-hwa, they recall his dedication and the challenges he faced in public service. This echoes the biblical call for leaders to administer justice and righteousness, recognizing the weight and difficulty of serving the public faithfully. May those in public life be sustained by the knowledge that their efforts, especially...
reflection.zh: 香港市民在悼念董建华先生时，回顾了他的奉献精神以及他在公共服务中所面临的挑战。这呼应了圣经中对领导者施行公正和公义的呼召，认识到忠实地为公众服务的重任和艰辛。愿在公共服务领域的人们，因着他们的努力，尤其是在艰难时期所付出的，被看见和铭记，从而获得力量。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Hongkongers pay tribute to late leader Tung Chee-hwa at community halls
title.zh: 香港人向已故领导人董建华致敬

summary.en: Residents visited three community halls across Hong Kong on Friday to pay tribute to the city’s first chief executive, Tung Chee-hwa, bringing flowers and writing messages in condolence books. These events preceded weekend activities, including a vigil and a state funeral, honoring Tung, who passed away on September 8...
summary.zh: 周五，香港市民前往三个社区中心，向香港首任行政长官董建华致敬，献上鲜花并在公众吊唁簿上留言。这些安排在周末的其他活动之前举行，包括周六的守夜和周日的国葬，以纪念于9月8日去世、享年89岁的董建华。“董先生对香港的贡献是显而易见的，他的去世让大家感到悲伤，”前立法会议员林贝聿嘉说。

body.en: Residents visited three community halls across Hong Kong to pay tribute to the city’s first chief executive Tung Chee-hwa on Friday, bringing flowers and writing heartfelt messages in public condolence books. The arrangements came ahead of other weekend events – including a vigil on Saturday and a state funeral on Sunday – to pay tribute to Tung, who died aged 89 on September 8. “Tung’s contribution to Hong Kong is conspicuous and his death made everyone sad,” said Peggy Lam Pei Yu-dja, a former...
body.zh: 周五，居民们前往香港各地的三个社区会堂，悼念香港首任行政长官董建华，并献上鲜花，并在公众吊唁簿上写下衷心的信息。这些安排是在其他周末活动之前进行的，包括周六的守夜活动和周日的国葬，以悼念于 9 月 8 日去世的 89 岁的董建华。“董建华对香港的贡献是显而易见的，他的去世让每个人都感到悲伤。”

reflection.en: The passing of Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong's first chief executive, prompts reflection on the finite nature of life. Hebrews 9:27 reminds us that death is a universal appointment, a solemn reality that awaits all. In moments of remembrance, we acknowledge the end of a chapter and the indelible mark left by a life lived.
reflection.zh: 香港首任行政长官董建华的离世，促使我们反思生命的有限性。希伯来书9章27节提醒我们，死是人人必经的定数，是所有生命终将面对的庄严现实。在追思的时刻，我们承认一个篇章的结束，以及生命所留下的不可磨灭的印记。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Extra carer allowance 'made within strict constraints'
title.zh: 额外护理人员津贴“在严格限制内制定”

summary.en: Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun stated on Friday that increasing the monthly allowance for caregivers from low-income families by HK$300 demonstrates the government's aim to direct resources to those most in need. Chief Executive John Lee's Policy Address on Wednesday included measures to support...
summary.zh: 劳工及福利局局长孙玉菡周五表示，将低收入家庭的护理人员每月津贴增加300港元，表明政府旨在将资源导向最需要的人。行政长官李家超在周三的施政报告中提出了一系列支持护理人员的措施，包括将低收入长者及残疾人士护理人员的每月津贴提高10%，至3300港元。孙玉菡在电台节目后强调，政府必须在严格的财政限制内运作，并指出“每一分钱...

body.en: Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun on Friday said the move to increase the monthly allowance to caregivers from low-income families by HK$300 showed that government aimed to channel resources to those most in need. In announcing his Policy Address on Wednesday, Chief Executive John Lee outlined a series of measures to support caregivers, including raising the monthly allowance for low-income caregivers of the elderly and persons with disabilities by 10 percent to HK$3,300. Speaking after a radio programme, Sun stressed the government had to operate within strict financial constraints. “In fact, every extra dollar helps in some way," he said. "Of course, the government must act within its capabilities. Resources are limited, but under these constraints, we hope to prioritise our help for low-income caregivers.” The Policy Address also outlined plans to launch a mobile version of the JoyYou Card by the end of 2026 to give seniors the option of enjoying the “HK$2 flat rate or 80 percent discount” concession without needing to carry a physical card around. Sun said the rollout would take place in phases, noting that the first step involves replacing existing cards to ensure all 2.7 million eligible residents hold a personalised JoyYou Card with a profile photo under real-name registration. He said cards would remain an available option after the mobile card's launch, noting that some seniors may not feel comfortable using a smartphone. On the use of technology to support an ageing society, Sun noted that his bureau had chosen 300 single-elderly or elderly-only households for a trial scheme to test two types of assistive technology – one designed to detect sudden falls and the other to automatically alert emergency assistance. If the technologies prove suitable for use in Hong Kong, the government will look to expand the scheme to more elderly households, he added. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 劳工及福利局局长孙克里斯周五表示，将低收入家庭照顾者每月津贴增加300港元的举措表明政府旨在将资源分配给最有需要的人。行政长官李家超在周三发表施政报告时概述了一系列支持照顾者的措施，包括将低收入长者和残疾人士照顾者的每月津贴提高10%至3,300港元。孙在广播节目结束后发表讲话强调，政府必须在严格的财政限制下运作。 “事实上，每一块额外的钱都会在某种程度上有所帮助，”他说。 “当然，政府必须量力而行。资源有限，但在这些限制下，我们希望优先帮助低收入护理人员。”施政报告还计划在2026年底前推出手机版JoyYou卡，让长者无需携带实体卡即可享受“2港元统一费率或80％折扣”的优惠。孙表示，推出将分阶段进行，并指出第一步是更换现有卡，以确保所有 270 万符合条件的居民都持有一张个性化的 JoyYou 卡，并实名注册并附有个人资料照片。他表示，在移动卡推出后，卡仍将是一种可用的选择，并指出一些老年人可能不习惯使用智能手机。在利用科技支持老龄化社会方面，孙指出，该局选择了300个独老或独老家庭进行试点计划，测试两种类型的辅助技术——一种旨在检测突然跌倒，另一种旨在自动提醒紧急援助。他补充说，如果这些技术被证明适合在香港使用，政府将寻求将该计划扩大到更多的老年家庭。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: The Hong Kong government's decision to increase caregiver allowances, even by a modest HK$300, acknowledges the vital role these individuals play. While operating within financial constraints, this move reflects a commitment to supporting vulnerable families and demonstrates that even small increases can make a difference in the lives of those providing...
reflection.zh: 香港政府决定增加护理人员津贴，即使幅度不大，也肯定了这些个人所扮演的重要角色。在财政限制下运作，此举体现了支持弱势家庭的承诺，并表明即使是微小的增加也能为提供基本护理的人们带来改变。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Northern Metropolis gives space for HK to grow: CE
title.zh: 北部都会区为香港发展提供空间：行政长官

summary.en: Hong Kong's Chief Executive, John Lee, stated on Friday that the large-scale Northern Metropolis project presents an opportunity for economic diversification and improved living standards. He highlighted that this initiative, covering about one-third of the city's geographical area, will create more space for living,...
summary.zh: 香港行政长官李家超周五表示，大规模的北部都会区项目为经济多元化和改善生活水平提供了机会。他强调，这项占地约三分之一城市地理面积的计划将为居住、工作和娱乐提供更多空间，并促进更广泛的产业和更高薪酬的工作。

body.en: Hong Kong's massive Northern Metropolis project is an opportunity for the city to diversify its economy and upgrade living conditions, Chief Executive John Lee told an RTHK phone-in programme on Friday – saying the initiative will provide more room for people to live, work and play. "Northern Metropolis represents about one-third of our geographical area – so it is a big piece of land that gives us new opportunities,” Lee said. He said while the city has in the past excelled in specific fields such as trade, shipping and finance, the Northern Metropolis will give space for a more diverse range of industries to grow, creating more jobs with higher pay. "Imagine all of a sudden your house becomes one-third bigger. You can put in a lot of things, you can have more activities,” Lee said. “So it's not just living more comfortably, but you can be healthier, happier, and... enjoy life better." The Chief Executive expressed confidence in the project, noting that it is also part of the national Five-Year Plan and will be backed by the central government to ensure its success. Asked by a caller about how to secure the territory’s future workforce, Lee noted that authorities are anticipating a shortfall of 130,000 workers by 2028 – a figure that’s lower than anticipated thanks to government efforts to import talent. He said Hong Kong has already attracted 300,000 workers from across the world since he took office four years ago, but the government won’t let up in the global race for talent. "We have met our targets better than we set. But I don't intend to change the target because the world is competing amongst ourselves," he said. "So this talent... if he doesn't join my side, he joins the competitor's side. You have this competition game, so I have to ensure that Hong Kong has the best people." Lee told another caller concerned about government support for smaller businesses that the government will help empower SMEs by assisting them in adopting new technology. He said a new AI-powered city management system called “AI City Brain” can help by using big data pooled from a variety of sources to identify potential gaps in demand to help the day-to-day running of businesses. “We have 18 districts – what are the specialities and what are the shortcomings? Are we oversupplying in some areas or undersupplying in others? “That will ensure that businesses will be focusing [their attention at the right places] and people will get the best services.” SME operator Jeffrey called in to ask the CE how to get through red tape more easily, saying he had contacted the government about some issues but received no response. Lee pointed to planned improvements in the government’s 1823 hotline outlined in his latest policy address, where problems that require multi-agency...
body.zh: 香港行政长官李家超周五在香港电台的电话节目中表示，香港庞大的北部都会项目是香港实现经济多元化和改善生活条件的机会，并表示该计划将为人们提供更多的生活、工作和娱乐空间。 “北部大都市约占我们地理区域的三分之一，因此这是一大片土地，为我们提供了新的机遇，”李说。他表示，虽然该市过去在贸易、航运和金融等特定领域表现出色，但北方大都市将为更多元化的行业提供发展空间，创造更多高薪就业岗位。 “想象一下，你的房子突然变大了三分之一。你可以放入很多东西，可以进行更多活动，”李说。 “因此，这不仅让您生活得更加舒适，还可以让您变得更健康、更快乐，并且……更好地享受生活。”行政长官对该项目表示信心，并指出该项目也是国家五年计划的一部分，将得到中央政府的支持，以确保其成功。当被问及如何确保香港未来的劳动力时，李指出，当局预计到 2028 年，劳动力缺口将达到 13 万人——由于政府努力引进人才，这一数字低于预期。他表示，自他四年前上任以来，香港已吸引了30万名来自世界各地的工人，但政府不会放松在全球人才争夺战中的步伐。 “我们比我们设定的目标更好地实现了。但我不打算改变目标，因为世界正在相互竞争，”他说。 “所以这个人才......如果他不加入我的阵营，他就会加入竞争对手的阵营。你有这个竞争游戏，所以我必须确保香港拥有最优秀的人才。”李告诉另一位担心政府对小型企业支持的来电者，政府将通过协助中小企业采用新技术来帮助他们增强能力。他表示，一种名为“AI城市大脑”的新型人工智能城市管理系统可以通过使用来自各种来源的大数据来识别潜在的需求缺口，从而帮助企业的日常运营。 “我们有18个区，有什么特色，有什么缺点？我们是否在某些地区供应过剩或在其他地区供应不足？“这将确保企业将注意力集中在正确的地方，人们将获得最好的服务。中小企业经营者杰弗里致电行政长官询问如何更轻松地通过繁文缛节，称他已就一些问题与政府联系，但没有得到回应。李指出，他在最新施政报告中概述了政府 1823 热线的改进计划，其中需要多机构共同解决的问题......

reflection.en: The Northern Metropolis project is presented as a vision for Hong Kong's future, promising growth and better living conditions. This echoes the ancient call for leaders to govern with justice and foresight, ensuring that development serves the well-being of all citizens. May such large-scale endeavors be guided by wisdom and a deep commitment to...
reflection.zh: 北部都会区项目被视为香港未来的愿景，承诺带来增长和更好的生活条件。这呼应了古代对领导者以公正和远见进行治理的呼吁，确保发展能造福所有市民。愿此类大规模的举措都能以智慧和对公义的坚定承诺为指导。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: ‘Forcing a reckoning’: How Asia is preparing for a ‘supersized’ El Niño
title.zh: 亚洲如何为“巨型”厄尔尼诺现象做准备

summary.en: Governments across Asia are urgently preparing for the most severe El Niño event on record, anticipating widespread droughts, wildfires, typhoons, and floods. This extreme weather, exacerbated by human-driven climate change, is expected to bring multiple crises, including heat, heavy rain, and food shortages, to...
summary.zh: 亚洲各国政府正紧急为有记录以来最严重的厄尔尼诺现象做准备，预计将出现大范围的干旱、野火、台风和洪水。这种由人为气候变化加剧的极端天气，预计将从现在到2027年给数亿人带来包括高温、暴雨和粮食短缺在内的多重危机。

body.en: From Sri Lanka to South Korea, governments are preparing for droughts, wildfires, typhoons and floods – with climate plans facing their biggest challenge to date Asian governments are rushing preparations for the most severe El Niño weather event on record, with hundreds of millions of people bracing for multiple crises at once as extreme heat, heavy rain and food shortages hit the region. Fuelled by exceptionally warm ocean conditions across the tropical Pacific – and developing alongside the human-driven climate crisis – El Niño is virtually guaranteed to grow to a very strong intensity towards the end of this year and into 2027. Continue reading...
body.zh: 从斯里兰卡到韩国，各国政府正在为干旱、野火、台风和洪水做准备——气候计划面临迄今为止最大的挑战。亚洲各国政府正在加紧准备，应对有记录以来最严重的厄尔尼诺天气事件，随着极端高温、暴雨和粮食短缺袭击该地区，数亿人同时面临多重危机。在热带太平洋异常温暖的海洋条件的推动下，并与人类造成的气候危机一起发展，厄尔尼诺现象几乎肯定会在今年年底和 2027 年增长到非常强烈的强度。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As Asia braces for the impacts of a 'supersized' El Niño, the scale of potential devastation—droughts, wildfires, floods—underscores humanity's vulnerability to natural forces. In such times, the ancient words of Psalm 46:1 offer a profound reminder: 'God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.' This truth offers solace and a call to...
reflection.zh: 随着亚洲为“巨型”厄尔尼诺现象的影响做准备，潜在破坏的规模——干旱、野火、洪水——凸显了人类在自然力量面前的脆弱性。在这样的时刻，诗篇46:1古老的言语提供了一个深刻的提醒：“雅伟是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是患难中随时的帮助。”这个真理在风暴聚集之时，为人们提供了慰藉，并呼唤人们寻求坚定不移的希望。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Hong Kong to face 130k manpower shortage in 2028 – 50k less than previously projected
title.zh: 香港2028年预计面临13万劳动力短缺——比此前预测少5万

summary.en: New government figures indicate Hong Kong will likely face a manpower shortage of approximately 130,000 by 2028, a reduction from the previous projection of 180,000. This update was released by the Labour and Welfare Bureau following the launch of a talent attraction office.
summary.zh: 新的政府数据显示，香港到2028年预计将面临约13万的劳动力短缺，这比此前预测的18万有所下降。劳工及福利局在推出一个吸引人才的办公室后公布了这一最新预测。

body.en: Hong Kong is expected to face a manpower shortage of around 130,000 by 2028, new government figures have revealed – a significant drop from the last official projection. The opening ceremony of Hong Kong Talent Engage, an office specially for talent attraction and services launched on October 20, 2023. Photo: Kyle Lam/ HKFP. The latest mid-term manpower projection from the Labour and Welfare Bureau came during a press conference on Thursday, one day after leader John Lee unveiled the city’s first Five-Year Plan and his fifth Policy Address. It represents a reduction from the last numbers released in 2023, which estimated that Hong Kong would be short of 180,000 workers in 2028. Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun attributed this reduction to government policies aimed at developing artificial intelligence (AI) and attracting top talent from outside Hong Kong. Without initiatives like the Top Talent Pass Scheme (TTPS), which relaxes visa requirements for top earners and graduates from elite universities, Hong Kong would be around 300,000 workers short in 2028, Sun said. Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The labour chief also said on Thursday that TTPS visa holders will see further relaxations to visa extension requirements. For example, employees of start-ups based in Cyberport, Hong Kong Science Park, or the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park will not need to submit proof of company revenue when applying for visa renewals. Government to create more jobs Chief Executive John Lee announced in his Policy Address on Wednesday that the government and the business sector will launch a two-year “30,000 Youth Employment and Internship Programme” to facilitate youth employment and development, especially for those with limited or no work experience. Sun said on Thursday that, as part of the programme, the Labour and Welfare Bureau will launch a scheme to create around 10,000 new jobs for young people in the coming two years. Only Hong Kong permanent residents aged under 29 will be eligible for the scheme, Sun said, adding that there will be no educational requirements. The University of Hong Kong. File photo: GovHK. Sun also said the Labour and Welfare Bureau will work with six major chambers of commerce, including the Employers’ Federation of Hong Kong and the Chinese General Chamber of Commerce, to encourage major companies to create new jobs. The target is to create 5,000 additional jobs in 2027 and another 5,000 in 2028. The government will cover one-third of the salaries for these positions, which must offer employment terms of at least six months.
body.zh: 新的政府数据显示，到 2028 年，香港预计将面临约 13 万名劳动力短缺，较上次官方预测大幅下降。专门从事人才吸引和服务的办公室 Hong Kong Talent Engage 于 2023 年 10 月 20 日启动。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。劳工及福利局在周四的新闻发布会上公布了最新的中期人力预测，一天前，香港领导人李家超公布了香港的第一个五年计划和第五份施政报告。这比2023年发布的最新数字有所减少，该数字预计到2028年香港将短缺18万名工人。劳工及福利局局长孙克里斯将这一减少归因于政府旨在发展人工智能（AI）和吸引香港以外顶尖人才的政策。孙说，如果没有像顶尖人才通行证计划（TTPS）这样放宽高收入者和精英大学毕业生签证要求的举措，香港到2028年将短缺约30万名工人。劳工及福利局局长孙克里斯。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。劳工部长周四还表示，TTPS 签证持有者的签证延期要求将进一步放宽。例如，位于数码港、香港科学园或港深创新及科技园的初创企业的员工在申请签证续签时无需提交公司收入证明。政府创造更多就业机会 行政长官李家超周三在施政报告中宣布，政府与商界将推出为期两年的“三万名青年就业实习计划”，以促进青年就业和发展，特别是那些工作经验有限或没有工作经验的青年。孙周四表示，作为该计划的一部分，劳工及福利局将推出一项计划，在未来两年内为年轻人创造约1万个新就业机会。孙说，只有29岁以下的香港永久性居民才有资格参加该计划，并补充说没有教育背景要求。香港大学。资料图：香港政府一站通。孙还表示，劳工及福利局将与香港雇主联合会、香港中华总商会等六大商会合作，鼓励大企业创造新就业机会。目标是到 2027 年再创造 5,000 个就业岗位，到 2028 年再创造 5,000 个就业岗位。政府将承担这些职位三分之一的工资，且雇佣期限必须至少为六个月。

reflection.en: Hong Kong's Labour and Welfare Bureau has revised its manpower shortage projections downwards, now anticipating a deficit of 130,000 workers by 2028. This adjustment comes alongside efforts to attract talent, highlighting the city's strategic planning for its future workforce. Proverbs 16:3 reminds us to commit our plans and works to Yahweh, trusting that...
reflection.zh: 香港劳工及福利局已下调了其劳动力短缺预测，目前预计到2028年将缺少13万工人。这一调整伴随着吸引人才的努力，凸显了这座城市对其未来劳动力的战略规划。箴言16:3提醒我们，要将我们的计划和工作交托给雅伟，信靠祂必使我们成就，这一原则适用于任何涉及审慎远见和执行的努力。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: ‘No doubt’ of climate change role in deadly China-Nepal flood: scientists
title.zh: 科学家：气候变化是导致中尼边境洪灾的“核心因素”

summary.en: Scientists have identified climate change as a primary factor in a recent glacial mountain collapse on the China-Nepal border, which resulted in over 1,400 deaths and left 6,600 missing. The disaster was characterized as a 'compound crisis' involving long-term warming, glacier retreat, permafrost thaw, and geological...
summary.zh: 科学家们指出，气候变化是近期中尼边境冰川山体崩塌的主要因素，此次灾难已导致超过1400人死亡，另有6600人失踪。该事件被描述为一场“复合危机”，涉及长期变暖、冰川退缩、永久冻土融化和地质不稳定，而非单一的极端天气事件。

body.en: Climate change was a core factor in last month’s deadly glacial mountain collapse on the China-Nepal border that killed more than 1,400 people and left at least 6,600 missing, scientists said Thursday. A man looks at the remains in the aftermath of flash floods at Trishuli in Nepal’s Nuwakot district on September 7, 2026. Photo: Pedro Pardo/AFP. However, scientists from the World Weather Attribution (WWA) group said, the disaster was not caused by a single extreme weather event, rather a “compound crisis” shaped by long-term warming, glacier retreat, permafrost thaw and geological instability. “Relentless warming has lifted the altitude of the freezing threshold on the high Himalaya, exposing ice and permafrost deep in the bedrock to higher and longer thaw temperatures, weakening mountain slopes,” a WWA report said. A massive section of rock and glacier broke away from Langtang Lirung mountain on August 26, triggering a huge flood of water, ice and debris that swept downstream, destroying communities and infrastructure. ‘Irreversible shifts’ Report co-author Walter Immerzeel, a mountain hydrologist at Utrecht University, said the region was undergoing “fundamental, irreversible shifts”, with glacier retreat and permafrost degradation undermining mountain stability. “We conclude that this was a geologically vulnerable slope, potentially weakened by the 2015 earthquake, but it was destabilised further by glacier retreat and permafrost fall,” Immerzeel told reporters. Nepal, a largely rural nation of 30 million people, contributes a fraction of global greenhouse gas emissions compared to industrialised nations. The study found that July and August 2026 were the warmest months locally recorded, while heavy snowfall in late 2025 contributed to increased meltwater before the collapse. A magnitude 7.8 earthquake in Nepal in 2015 may have further weakened the slope, although its precise role remains uncertain, the report said. Workers repair a section of road leading to Gyirong Port on August 28, 2026, which was damaged after a mudslide two days earlier, in Gyirong County. Photo: CNS/AFP. Last month’s disaster has also raised concerns about the limits of adaptation. Prime Minister Balendra Shah will take his first foreign trip as Nepal’s leader to address the UN General Assembly on the urgent issue next week. Nepal estimates the reconstruction bill after deadly floods sparked by a glacial mountain collapse last month will amount to $4.78 billion. ‘No doubt’ “There is no doubt that climate change is one of the drivers, and therefore obviously it needs to be discussed in the context of loss and damage,” Friederike Otto, a professor of climate science at...
body.zh: 科学家周四表示，气候变化是上个月中尼边境致命冰川山崩塌的核心因素，这场崩塌造成 1,400 多人死亡，至少 6,600 人失踪。 2026 年 9 月 7 日，尼泊尔努瓦科特地区特里苏里，一名男子正在查看山洪暴发后的遗骸。照片：Pedro Pardo/法新社。然而，世界天气归因组织（WWA）的科学家表示，这场灾难并不是单一的极端天气事件造成的，而是由长期变暖、冰川退缩、永久冻土融化和地质不稳定所形成的“复合危机”。世界气象组织的一份报告称：“持续的变暖提高了喜马拉雅山高处的冰冻阈值，使基岩深处的冰和永久冻土暴露在更高和更长时间的解冻温度下，削弱了山坡。” 8 月 26 日，一大片岩石和冰川从 Langtang Lirung 山脱落，引发洪水、冰和碎片席卷下游，摧毁了社区和基础设施。 “不可逆转的变化”报告的合著者、乌得勒支大学山区水文学家沃尔特·伊默泽尔表示，该地区正在经历“根本性的、不可逆转的变化”，冰川退缩和永久冻土退化破坏了山区的稳定性。伊默泽尔告诉记者：“我们的结论是，这是一个地质脆弱的斜坡，可能会因 2015 年地震而变得脆弱，但冰川退缩和永久冻土层塌陷进一步破坏了它的稳定性。”尼泊尔是一个拥有 3000 万人口、以农村为主的国家，与工业化国家相比，其温室气体排放量仅占全球温室气体排放量的一小部分。研究发现，2026年7月和8月是当地有记录以来最温暖的月份，而2025年末的大雪导致崩塌前融水增加。报告称，2015 年尼泊尔发生的 7.8 级地震可能进一步削弱了斜坡，但其确切作用仍不确定。 2026 年 8 月 28 日，工人们正在修复吉隆县通往吉隆口岸的一段道路，该道路因两天前的泥石流而受损。照片：CNS/法新社。上个月的灾难也引发了人们对适应局限性的担忧。巴伦德拉·沙阿总理将于下周作为尼泊尔领导人首次出访，在联合国大会上就这一紧迫问题发表讲话。尼泊尔估计上个月冰川山崩塌引发致命洪水后的重建费用将达到 47.8 亿美元。 “毫无疑问”“毫无疑问，气候变化是驱动因素之一，因此显然需要在损失和损害的背景下进行讨论，”弗里德里克·奥托（Friederike Otto），气候科学教授。

reflection.en: The earth itself groans, bearing the weight of human impact and systemic disruption. As scientists link this devastating flood to climate change, we see a world out of balance, a consequence of long-term warming and environmental instability. May we recognize our interconnectedness with creation and seek wisdom to live as faithful stewards.
reflection.zh: 大地本身也在呻吟，承受着人类活动和系统性破坏的重负。当科学家们将这场毁灭性的洪水与气候变化联系起来时，我们看到了一个失衡的世界，这是长期变暖和环境不稳定的后果。愿我们认识到与受造界的相互联系，并寻求智慧，作为忠实的管家生活。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers jailed for seven years in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港国安法下，支联会前正副主席煽动颠覆罪成判囚七年

summary.en: Hong Kong activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan have been sentenced to seven years in prison after being found guilty of inciting subversion under the city's national security law for their roles in organizing an annual vigil commemorating the Tiananmen Square massacre.
summary.zh: 香港活动人士周庭栋和李卓人因在组织纪念天安门事件的年度集会中煽动颠覆国家政权，根据香港国安法被判处七年监禁。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 民主活动人士周恒东和李卓人在有争议的国家安全案件中被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。两名因在香港组织一年一度的天安门广场大屠杀守夜活动而受审的民主活动人士被判处七年监禁，这是香港最重大的国家安全案件之一。 41 岁的周恒东和 69 岁的李卓人于 8 月被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。法院认为，他们“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The sentencing of Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan highlights a profound tension between civic duty and conscience. Their conviction for organizing a Tiananmen Square vigil raises questions about the limits of free expression and assembly when they are perceived to challenge state power. The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...
reflection.zh: 周庭栋和李卓人的判刑凸显了公民责任与良知之间的深刻张力。他们因组织天安门事件悼念集会被定罪，引发了关于言论和集会自由界限的疑问，尤其是在这些自由被视为挑战国家权力之时。即使面临世俗的惩罚，也要优先顺服雅伟而非人间的命令，这一原则在这样的处境中引起了深刻共鸣。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Wall Street Journal publisher convicted in Hong Kong of deterring reporter from union role
title.zh: 《华尔街日报》出版商在香港被判犯有阻止记者担任工会职务的罪名

summary.en: Dow Jones, the publisher of The Wall Street Journal, has been convicted in a Hong Kong court of one count of deterring reporter Selina Cheng from taking up a role at the Hong Kong Journalist Association. The case raised concerns about press freedom in the city, as Cheng was dismissed weeks after her appointment as...
summary.zh: 《华尔街日报》的出版商道琼斯公司在香港一家法院被判犯有一项阻止记者郑丽莎担任香港记者协会职务的罪名。此案引发了对该市新闻自由的担忧，郑女士在2024年被任命为香港记协主席数周后被公司以重组为由解雇。

body.en: Dow Jones convicted of one count of deterring Selina Cheng from role at Hong Kong Journalist Association but cleared of second charge A Hong Kong court has convicted the publisher of the Wall Street Journal of deterring a reporter from taking up a trade union role, in a case that raised concerns about press freedom in the city. The newspaper dismissed Selina Cheng just weeks after she was appointed chair of the Hong Kong Journalist Association (HKJA) in 2024. She was told at the time her termination was officially due to restructuring. Continue reading...
body.zh: 道琼斯因一项阻止郑秀玲在香港记者协会任职的罪名被定罪，但第二项指控被洗清。香港一家法院判定《华尔街日报》出版商阻止一名记者担任工会职务的罪名成立，此案引起了人们对香港新闻自由的担忧。该报在 2024 年被任命为香港记者协会 (HKJA) 主席几周后解雇了郑嘉颖。当时她被告知，她的解雇正式是由于重组。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of Dow Jones in Hong Kong for deterring a reporter from union activity underscores a troubling trend where corporate actions can stifle worker advocacy. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly and loving mercy, even in the face of corporate restructuring or perceived inconvenience. May we pray for leaders...
reflection.zh: 道琼斯公司在香港被判阻止记者参与工会活动，这凸显了一个令人担忧的趋势：企业行为可能扼杀工人维权。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于秉行公义，喜爱怜悯，即使面对企业重组或所谓的“不便”。愿我们为媒体和商业界的领导者祈祷，愿他们坚守这些原则，确保追求利润不会掩盖员工的基本权利和尊严。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Unidentified Murder review – playful sendup of alien abduction and true crime influencers in Hong Kong
title.zh: 不明谋杀评论——香港外星人绑架和真实犯罪影响者的戏谑模仿

summary.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes the limits of storytelling. Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers,...
summary.zh: 在一部低成本的喜剧冒险片《不明谋杀》中，童年好友声称目睹了一名学童的失踪，该片突破了讲故事的界限。由郭嘉熙和李振杰执导的这部规模不大但结构精巧的喜剧，以一种随心所欲的戏谑方式模仿了真实犯罪爱好者和伪网红，其风格充满爱意而非恶意。影片围绕一个（虚构的）25年前的案件展开，该案件吸引了整个香港的关注。

body.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done with affection rather than malice. It revolves around a (fictional) 25-year-old case that captivates the whole of Hong Kong. Back when they were seven, childhood friends Mark (Ling Man-lung) and Kit (Ronald Lam Tsz-kit) claimed to have witnessed the abduction by aliens of their classmate Ho in the woods of Tung Tau Hill. On the 25th anniversary of this supposed incident, the pair re-enter the internet’s consciousness after an interview on an online chatshow about unsolved mysteries. Cashing in on their viral fame, Mark’s girlfriend Man (Renci Yeung) hires actor Kim (Peter Chan Charm-man) to pretend to be Ho, all in the hope of racking up views on her social channels. Just when the cameras are all set up, Man watches in horror as the staged reunion leads to a real murder … or does it? The film unfolds in a series of increasingly tricksy complications and reversals. All of a sudden, apparent victims are revealed to be scheming masterminds, and vice versa. As most of the actions take place in the forest where the abduction supposedly occurred, the plot derives comic relief from the increasingly blurred line between truth and playacting. Largely shot with handheld cameras, it has a visual style that lends authenticity to representations of online media, though occasionally this distracts from the physical comedy performed by the cast. The constant twists also turn into bit of a competitive sport, meaning the film becomes more of a writing exercise than anything else. Continue reading...
body.zh: 儿时的朋友声称在这部低成本喜剧中目睹了一名小学生的失踪，这部喜剧突破了讲故事的极限。郭家熙和李俊杰的这部喜剧规模适中，结构复杂，是对真正的犯罪爱好者和想要成为影响者的反复无常的讽刺，是出于感情而不是恶意。它围绕着一个（虚构的）25 年前震惊整个香港的案件展开。七岁时，青梅竹马的Mark（凌文龙饰）和Kit（林中基饰）声称在东头山的树林里亲眼目睹了同学何氏被外星人绑架。在这起所谓的事件发生 25 周年之际，两人在一次关于未解之谜的在线访谈节目中接受采访后，重新进入了互联网的视野。马克的女友曼（杨仁慈饰）利用他们的病毒名气，聘请演员金（陈可辛饰）假扮何浩，希望能在她的社交频道上获得更多的关注。就在摄像机全部架好时，曼惊恐地看着这场上演的重聚导致了一场真正的谋杀……真的是这样吗？影片以一系列日益棘手的复杂情况和逆转展开。突然之间，表面上的受害者被揭露为诡计多端的策划者，反之亦然。由于大部分情节都发生在据称发生绑架的森林中，因此事实与表演之间的界限越来越模糊，情节因此而变得喜剧化。它主要是用手持摄像机拍摄的，其视觉风格为在线媒体的表现提供了真实性，尽管有时这会分散演员们表演的肢体喜剧的注意力。不断的曲折也变成了一种竞技运动，这意味着这部电影更像是一种写作练习。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This film playfully satirizes how a single, unverified story can capture the imagination of an entire city for decades. It reminds us of the importance of discernment, especially in the age of influencers and viral narratives, urging us to seek out all sides before forming a conclusion. Proverbs 18:17 speaks to this, noting that the first to speak in a...
reflection.zh: 这部电影以一种戏谑的方式讽刺了一个未经证实的故事如何能长达数十年地吸引整座城市的想象力。它提醒我们在充斥着网红和病毒式传播叙事的时代，辨别真伪尤为重要，并敦促我们在下结论前倾听各方声音。箴言18:17对此深有体会，指出在争论中先开口的人似乎有理，但真相只有在双方都被倾听后才能显现。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: Early heat waves hit wheat yields hardest but boost resilience to subsequent heat waves
title.zh: 早期热浪对小麦产量影响最大，但能增强对后续热浪的抵抗力

summary.en: New research indicates that wheat crops are most vulnerable to yield loss from heat waves occurring before the flowering stage. However, early-season heat exposure can paradoxically 'prime' the plants, making them more resilient to later heat waves, potentially mitigating overall yield reduction.
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，小麦作物在开花期前的热浪中更容易遭受产量损失。然而，生长季节早期的热浪暴露可能会通过一种保护性的“启动”效应，增强其对后续热浪的抵抗力，从而减轻整体产量下降。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

New research published in the Journal of Experimental Botany reveals that wheat crops are more sensitive to grain yield losses from heat waves that occur before reaching their flowering stage than those occurring later. However, exposure to heat waves early in the growing season may reduce yield losses during additional heat waves through a protective "priming" effect.

A team of researchers from the University of Lleida in Catalonia, Spain, investigated the roles of heat wave intensity, frequency and timing relative to crop flowering during the growing season to identify how these factors interacted to affect wheat crop yield.

Heat waves are increasing in frequency and intensity around the world, and their durations are expanding to cover more of the wheat crop growing season, which can include the pivotal flowering stage, when wheat shifts from setting grains to grain growth.

This research demonstrates that heat wave damage in wheat depends not only on the intensity of the heat wave but also on when it occurs and whether the crop has experienced a heat wave earlier in the season.

"Most studies have examined heat stress as a single event, and have done so under controlled conditions rather than under field conditions," says co-author Dr. Gustavo Slafer. "We investigated whether an earlier heat wave could alter how wheat responds to a later one during reproductive development."

Field experiments were carried out across two growing seasons using two modern wheat varieties. Both varieties responded similarly to the heat wave treatments, despite having contrasting yield-building strategies.

Heat wave treatments were created by growing wheat inside transparent tents that produced a daily temperature rise through a greenhouse effect. The pre-flowering and post-flowering conditions were standardized for relative heat load to allow comparisons. Heat load was measured as the additional hourly degrees of temperature accumulated over an average day compared with the control treatment, with greater emphasis on heat load above 32 °C.

The major findings of this study are that wheat grain yield is more sensitive to heat waves that occur before flowering than after flowering and that, while earlier heat waves reduced the overall number of grains produced, later heat waves reduced the weight of those grains.

Surprisingly, the team also found that when exposed to sequential heat waves in one season, wheat appears to be primed by early pre-flowering heat waves to reduce the impact of later post-flowering heat waves, compared with wheat experiencing only post-flowering heat...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 发表在《实验植物学杂志》上的新研究表明，小麦作物对开花期之前发生的热浪造成的粮食产量损失比开花期之后发生的热浪更敏感。然而，在生长季节早期暴露于热浪可能会通过保护性“启动”效应减少额外热浪期间的产量损失。 西班牙加泰罗尼亚莱里达大学的一组研究人员研究了热浪强度、频率和时间相对于生长季节作物开花的作用，以确定这些因素如何相互作用影响小麦作物产量。 世界各地的热浪频率和强度都在增加，其持续时间也在扩大，覆盖了小麦作物生长季节的更多时间，其中可能包括关键的开花阶段，即小麦从结籽转向籽粒生长的阶段。 这项研究表明，热浪对小麦的损害不仅取决于热浪的强度，还取决于热浪发生的时间以及作物是否在季节早些时候经历过热浪。 “大多数研究都将热应激作为一个单一事件进行研究，并且是在受控条件下而不是在现场条件下进行的，”合著者古斯塔沃·斯拉弗博士说。 “我们研究了早期的热浪是否会改变小麦在生殖发育过程中对后来的热浪的反应。” 使用两种现代小麦品种在两个生长季节进行了田间试验。尽管产量建设策略不同，但这两个品种对热浪处理的反应相似。 热浪疗法是通过在透明帐篷内种植小麦来实现的，通过温室效应使气温逐日上升。将开花前和开花后条件标准化为相对热负荷，以便进行比较。热负荷的测量是与对照处理相比，平均一天中每小时累积的额外温度，重点是高于 32°C 的热负荷。 这项研究的主要发现是，小麦籽粒产量对开花前发生的热浪比开花后更敏感，而且早期的热浪减少了谷物的总产量，而后期的热浪则减少了这些谷物的重量。 令人惊讶的是，研究小组还发现，当在一个季节中连续经历热浪时，与仅经历花后热浪的小麦相比，小麦似乎会受到早期开花前热浪的影响，以减少后来开花后热浪的影响......

reflection.en: The resilience of wheat to later heat waves, after enduring an earlier one, offers a picture of how hardship can forge strength. Just as the plant adapts, so too can human beings find that enduring difficult seasons can prepare us for future challenges, fostering a deeper capacity for hope and perseverance.
reflection.zh: 小麦在经历早期热浪后，对后续热浪表现出的韧性，描绘了困境如何锻造力量。正如植物会适应一样，人类也能在经历艰难时期后，为未来的挑战做好准备，培养更深层次的希望和毅力。

verse.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。

title.en: Burst pipe floods wildlife meadow for fourth time
title.zh: 爆管致野生动物草甸四度被淹

summary.en: A wildlife charity is frustrated by the repeated flooding of a vital conservation site in Oxfordshire due to a burst pipe, fearing it could jeopardize a funding grant. This is the fourth time the Long Mead Local Wildlife Site has been flooded by a mains failure, causing damage to the rare habitat at a time of year...
summary.zh: 由于管道破裂，牛津郡一个重要的野生动物保护区被反复淹没，一个慈善机构对此感到沮丧，并担心可能因此失去一项资助。这是斯温福德的朗梅德当地野生动物保护区第四次因主管道故障而发生洪水。洪水对该稀有栖息地造成了损害，尤其是在一年中这个不应有积水的时候。泰晤士水务公司表示已修复了泄漏，并承诺继续保护当地的野生动物保护区。

body.en:
A wildlife charity fears it could lose a funding grant after a burst pipe prevented vital conservation work.

It is the fourth time Long Mead Local Wildlife Site, at Swinford in Oxfordshire, has been flooded because of a mains failure.

Although the meadow by the River Thames naturally floods in the winter, standing water at this time of year can cause damage to the rare habitat.

Thames Water said the latest leak had been fixed and it remained committed to protecting local wildlife sites.

"It's already starting to stagnate, so that's serious," said Catriona Bass, director of the Long Mead Foundation.

"These meadows don't flood typically in summer and when they do it's a disaster because the plants are growing - so it kills off the plants."

The site is central to a restoration programme that aims to boost this type of specialist habitat across the county.

There are only four square miles in total of floodplain meadow in the country - the equivalent in size to Heathrow Airport.

The rare habitat is home to deep-rooting wild flowers and grasses like great burnet and devil's-bit scabious.

Long Mead meadow acts as a donor site where seeds are gathered to help restore other similar habitats around Oxfordshire.

The latest flooding was discovered on the day that restoration works were due to start after the last incident.

Conservationists have said they are worried a grant the charity had secured is at risk if the work is not completed in time.

"We planned on the 1st September to do this massive restoration project to deal with the previous floods and now we're not going to be able to," Bass said.

A Thames Water spokesperson said: "We are sorry for the disruption caused and remain committed to protecting local wildlife sites.

"We have repaired a recent burst in Bettys Meadow and traffic management equipment is due to be removed shortly.

"The repair took longer than anticipated due to heavy rainfall and the volume of water, which meant our engineers were unable to safely access and repair the pipework until conditions improved.

"We will continue to assess the condition of the water main and review any further measures needed to help safeguard the area in the future."
body.zh: 一家野生动物慈善机构担心，由于管道破裂阻碍了重要的保护工作，它可能会失去资助。 这是位于牛津郡斯温福德的朗米德当地野生动物保护区第四次因电源故障而被洪水淹没。 尽管泰晤士河畔的草地在冬季会自然泛滥，但每年这个时候的积水可能会对稀有的栖息地造成损害。 泰晤士水务公司表示，最新的泄漏事件已得到修复，并将继续致力于保护当地野生动物栖息地。 朗米德基金会主任卡特里奥娜·巴斯 (Catriona Bass) 表示：“情况已经开始停滞，所以情况很严重。” “这些草地通常不会在夏季发生洪水，一旦发生洪水就会造成灾难，因为植物正在生长，因此会杀死植物。” 该地点是一项恢复计划的核心，该计划旨在促进全县的此类专业栖息地。 该国的洪泛区草甸总共只有四平方英里——相当于希思罗机场的大小。 这个稀有的栖息地是深根野花和草的家园，例如大地榆和魔鬼草。 朗米德草甸充当捐赠地，在那里收集种子，以帮助恢复牛津郡周围的其他类似栖息地。 最近一次洪水是在上次事故发生后修复工程开始的当天发现的。 环保人士表示，他们担心如果工程不能及时完成，该慈善机构获得的赠款将面临风险。 巴斯说：“我们计划在 9 月 1 日进行大规模的修复工程，以应对之前的洪水，但现在我们无法做到这一点。” 泰晤士水务发言人表示：“我们对造成的破坏表示歉意，并将继续致力于保护当地野生动物栖息地。 “我们已经修复了贝蒂草甸最近发生的爆裂事故，交通管理设备很快就会被拆除。 “由于强降雨和水量，修复时间比预期要长，这意味着我们的工程师无法安全地进入和修复管道，直到情况改善。 “我们将继续评估总水管的状况，并审查未来保护该地区所需的任何进一步措施。”

reflection.en: The repeated flooding of the Long Mead wildlife meadow by a burst pipe is a stark reminder of our interconnectedness with the natural world and the fragility of conservation efforts. It calls us to consider our role as stewards of creation, recognizing that all the Earth and its creatures belong to Yahweh. May we approach such challenges with both practical...
reflection.zh: 朗梅德野生动物草甸因管道破裂而反复被淹，这鲜明地提醒我们与自然世界的相互联系以及保护工作的脆弱性。它促使我们反思作为受造之物的管家所扮演的角色，认识到大地及其万物都属于雅伟。愿我们以实际的解决方案和对生命微妙平衡更深的敬畏之心来应对这些挑战。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Could expanding the U.S. nuclear arsenal make Americans less safe?
title.zh: 扩大美国核武库是否会使美国人更不安全？

summary.en: A report from the Brookings Institution argues that increasing the U.S. nuclear arsenal could heighten the risk of nuclear crises, challenging the notion that the U.S. must expand its stockpile in response to China's growing capabilities. The U.S. has maintained a stockpile of around 5,000 warheads for decades, with...
summary.zh: 布鲁金斯学会的一份报告认为，增加美国核武库可能会增加核危机的风险，这挑战了美国必须增加其核储备以应对中国日益增长的核能力的论点。几十年来，美国一直维持着大约5000枚核弹头的储备，此前专家们普遍认为这足以构成威慑。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A new report from the Brookings Institution presents evidence that increasing the size of the U.S. nuclear arsenal could make nuclear crises more likely. This raises an important challenge to arguments that the U.S. must consider increasing its stockpile in response to China's growing nuclear capabilities.

For decades, the U.S. nuclear stockpile has held steady at around 5,000 warheads. Until recently, most experts agreed that this supply was adequate to persuade adversaries that any nuclear attack would lead to devastating consequences, a calculation that experts agree serves as an effective deterrent. With nuclear adversaries, this is the condition of credible mutually assured destruction, in which the ability to strike first does not eliminate the other side's ability to strike back.

In recent years, however, some experts have begun to worry that the U.S. arsenal cannot credibly deter China and Russia at the same time.

Because there is no way to directly test this claim, the report, by Brookings senior fellow Melanie W. Sisson, uses evidence from historical instances in which the United States made or received nuclear threats.

It found that events—such as the Cuban Missile Crisis, confrontations with North Korea and Russia's threats to deploy nuclear weapons in Ukraine—were more common when one side had a substantial advantage over the other, usually the United States.

Crises were less frequent when the U.S. and its nuclear adversary approached rough parity in nuclear capability. Other factors, including where and how many warheads were deployed and the specific doctrines governing U.S. nuclear policy, showed no consistent association with crisis frequency.

As of now, the U.S. has far more nuclear warheads than China. According to the Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists , the U.S. has around 5,000 warheads, while Russia has a little less than 5,500. China currently has around 600.

In recent years, China has been working to increase its nuclear arsenal, but the report notes that the current U.S. arsenal will remain able to retaliate if attacked, even if China and Russia were to team up against the U.S.

The report's findings have crucial implications for the future of U.S. defense strategy. Sisson argues that rather than spending billions to expand its nuclear arsenal, the U.S. should focus its efforts on enhancing its survivability and resilience. For instance, she says, the U.S. should continue to strengthen the capabilities of its nuclear submarine fleet.

It should also focus more on defending U.S. nuclear command and control systems against possible...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 布鲁金斯学会的一份新报告提供的证据表明，增加美国核武库的规模可能会增加核危机的可能性。这对美国必须考虑增加库存以应对中国不断增长的核能力的论点提出了重要挑战。 几十年来，美国的核库存一直稳定在 5000 枚弹头左右。直到最近，大多数专家都认为，这种供应足以让对手相信任何核攻击都会导致毁灭性后果，专家们一致认为这一计算可以起到有效的威慑作用。对于核对手来说，这是可信的相互确保毁灭的条件，其中先发制人的能力并不消除对方反击的能力。 然而，近年来，一些专家开始担心美国的武库无法同时威慑中国和俄罗斯。 由于无法直接检验这一说法，布鲁金斯学会高级研究员梅兰妮·W·西森 (Melanie W. Sisson) 的报告使用了美国发出或接受核威胁的历史实例的证据。 研究发现，当一方比另一方（通常是美国）拥有实质性优势时，诸如古巴导弹危机、与朝鲜的对抗以及俄罗斯威胁在乌克兰部署核武器等事件就会更为常见。 当美国与其核对手的核能力大致相当时，危机就会减少。其他因素，包括部署弹头的地点和数量以及美国核政策的具体原则，与危机频率没有一致的关联。 截至目前，美国的核弹头数量远远多于中国。据《原子科学家公报》称，美国拥有约 5,000 枚弹头，而俄罗斯拥有略少于 5,500 枚。中国目前约有600家。 近年来，中国一直在努力增加其核武库，但报告指出，即使中国和俄罗斯联手对抗美国，美国现有的核武库仍然能够在受到攻击时进行报复。 该报告的调查结果对美国国防战略的未来具有至关重要的影响。西森认为，美国不应花费数十亿美元扩大其核武库，而应集中精力增强其生存能力和复原力。例如，她说，美国应该继续加强其核潜艇舰队的能力。 它还应该更多地关注保护美国核指挥和控制系统免受可能的……

reflection.en: The pursuit of security through ever-larger arsenals is a path fraught with peril, as this report suggests. The ancient vision of Isaiah offers a counter-narrative: a future where nations beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. May wisdom guide leaders toward de-escalation and lasting peace, rather than a precarious security...
reflection.zh: 正如这份报告所暗示的，通过不断扩充军备来追求安全是一条充满危险的道路。以赛亚的古老异象提供了一个反叙事：一个国家将刀打成犁头，将枪打成镰刀的未来。愿智慧引导领导者走向缓和局势和持久和平，而不是建立在毁灭威胁之上的脆弱安全。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Baby orangutans in India expose 'frightening' scale of trafficking
title.zh: 印度幼年猩猩暴露“惊人”贩运规模

summary.en: The discovery of five abandoned baby orangutans in an Indian forest has revealed a significant illegal trade in exotic wildlife, with smugglers increasingly bringing rare species into the country, according to experts. They are concerned about a growing multi-million dollar market for endangered animals, with apes...
summary.zh: 在印度森林中发现的五只被遗弃的幼年猩猩，揭露了大规模的异国野生动物非法交易，专家称贩运者正越来越多地将稀有物种带入该国。他们担心一个日益增长的、价值数百万美元的濒危动物市场，其中猿类通过像缅甸这样的战乱地区被走私，以满足富裕印度人寻求在社交媒体上炫耀的异国情调象征的需求。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Five baby orangutans abandoned in an Indian forest have exposed a "massive" exotic wildlife trade, with traffickers smuggling increasingly rare species into the country, experts say.

They warn of a growing multimillion-dollar trade in endangered animals, including apes smuggled through war-torn Myanmar to feed demand among wealthy Indians seeking exotic status symbols to flaunt on social media.

"There have been several instances of exotic wild animals being found or seized across the country," said Sumanth Bindumadhav of Humane World for Animals India. "The scale is massive."

Critically endangered orangutans are native only to the Indonesian island of Sumatra and Borneo, which it shares with Malaysia and Brunei.

Yet the five tiny orangutans were found by rangers in Balasore, in India's eastern Odisha state.

About 1½ years old, they are being cared for at a zoo. Indonesia has requested their return.

Bindumadhav's group, in a June 2026 report, detailed what it called a "rising trade in exotic wildlife," demonstrated by a "steep increase in seizures" that reflected a "surge in illegal trade."

Orangutans and gibbons—small apes—were being "increasingly trafficked into India" from Southeast Asia's rainforests, it added.

A senior official at India's Wildlife Crime Control Bureau said "thousands of social media influencers" were promoting exotic species as pets online, fueling demand among followers.

"It is a huge market," said the official, who requested anonymity because they were not authorized to speak to the media. "Rich people keep them in their homes."

Under a government voluntary disclosure scheme, more than 40,000 people had registered exotic animals by February 2021, government data shows.

"This is a figure from only those who registered themselves, so the true volume of it is potentially much larger and remains unknown," said Bindumadhav.

Former India head of the global anti-wildlife-trade group TRAFFIC Shekhar Kumar Niraj said the surge in trafficking was also linked to a "rising number" of animals held in private hands.

"Private zoos have violated laws at a very alarming scale across the country," said Niraj.

"Primates are very popular in zoos because they are very intelligent, like to interact with humans, the kind of thing zoos want."

The World Wide Fund for Nature-India (WWF-India) documented 56 seizures involving about 4,000 exotic animals in 2022 alone.

In October 2025, Mumbai customs officers arrested a passenger carrying two endangered gibbons stuffed inside a checked bag.

Other seizures in Mumbai last year included lizards, tree-climbing...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 专家表示，五只被遗弃在印度森林中的小猩猩暴露了“大规模”的外来野生动物贸易，贩运者将越来越稀有的物种走私到印度。 他们警告说，濒危动物的价值数百万美元的贸易不断增长，其中包括通过饱受战争蹂躏的缅甸走私的猿类，以满足印度富人的需求，这些印度人寻求异国情调的地位象征，在社交媒体上炫耀。 印度动物人道世界的苏曼特·宾杜玛达夫 (Sumanth Bindumadhav) 表示：“全国各地已发现或查获数起外来野生动物。” “规模很大。” 极度濒临灭绝的猩猩仅原产于印度尼西亚的苏门答腊岛和婆罗洲，与马来西亚和文莱共享。 然而，这五只小猩猩是由护林员在印度东部奥里萨邦巴拉索尔发现的。 它们大约 1.5 岁，在动物园里受到照顾。印度尼西亚已要求他们返回。 Bindumadhav 的团队在 2026 年 6 月的一份报告中详细描述了所谓的“外来野生动物贸易不断增加”，“缉获量急剧增加”表明“非法贸易激增”。 报告补充说，猩猩和长臂猿（小型猿类）“越来越多地被从东南亚雨林贩运到印度”。 印度野生动物犯罪控制局的一名高级官员表示，“数千名社交媒体影响者”正在网上宣传外来物种作为宠物，刺激了追随者的需求。 “这是一个巨大的市场，”这位官员表示，由于无权接受媒体采访，该官员要求匿名。 “有钱人把它们养在家里。” 政府数据显示，根据政府自愿披露计划，截至 2021 年 2 月，已有超过 40,000 人登记了外来动物。 宾杜马达夫说：“这个数字仅来自那些自己注册的人，因此真实数量可能要大得多，而且仍然未知。” 全球反野生动物贸易组织TRAFFIC前印度负责人谢卡尔·库马尔·尼拉吉(Shekhar Kumar Niraj)表示，贩运活动的激增也与私人手中的动物“数量不断增加”有关。 尼拉吉说：“全国范围内，私人动物园的违法行为规模非常惊人。” “灵长类动物在动物园里很受欢迎，因为它们非常聪明，喜欢与人类互动，这正是动物园想要的。” 仅 2022 年，世界自然基金会印度分部 (WWF-印度) 就记录了 56 起缉获事件，涉及约 4,000 只外来动物。 2025 年 10 月，孟买海关官员逮捕了一名托运行李中携带两只濒临灭绝的长臂猿的乘客。 去年孟买查获的其他物品包括蜥蜴、爬树……

reflection.en: The plight of these young orangutans, abandoned and trafficked for status, calls to mind the ancient wisdom of speaking for those who have no voice. Their silent suffering exposes a trade that preys on the vulnerable, turning living creatures into commodities. May we be moved to advocate for the voiceless, whether they are animals exploited by greed or...
reflection.zh: 这些幼年猩猩被遗弃并为了炫耀而被贩运的困境，令人想起古老的智慧——为那些没有声音的人发声。它们无声的痛苦揭露了一种剥削弱者的交易，将生物变成商品。愿我们受到感动，为弱势群体发声，无论是被贪婪所利用的动物，还是陷入贩运和虐待循环中的人们。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Bolivia's tilcayo tiger cat becomes first new wildcat species in 100 years
title.zh: 玻利维亚的蒂尔卡约虎猫成为100年来首个新野猫物种

summary.en: Scientists have discovered a new species of wild cat, the tilcayo tiger cat, in Bolivia's Yungas region, marking the first new wildcat species identified in over a century. Locals had mistaken the small, spotted feline for a common house cat.
summary.zh: 科学家在玻利维亚的永加斯地区发现了一个新的野猫物种——蒂尔卡约虎猫，这是100多年来首次发现新的野猫物种。当地居民曾将其误认为普通的家猫。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Scientists have discovered a new species of wild cat for the first time in more than a century, a Bolivian researcher told AFP on Thursday.

The tilcayo tiger cat, a small feline with a spotted, leopard-like coat, was identified in the mountainous Yungas region near the capital, La Paz.

Locals who saw the creature in the Bolivian Andes had mistaken it for an ordinary house cat, said biologist and National Geographic explorer Paola Nogales-Ascarrunz, who was part of the research team that studied them.

The nickname "tilcayo" given to the animal by locals inspired its new scientific designation: Leopardus tilcayo.

Nogales-Ascarrunz lauded the discovery as a "remarkable event, because a new wild cat species hasn't been described in 100 years."

The cat is the first new feline discovered since the Uruguayan pampas cat in 1923.

The tilcayo is slightly smaller than a domestic cat, measuring around 45 centimeters (18 inches), with rounded ears.

A pair of tilcayos—the only such creatures found so far—have undergone whole-genome sequencing, Nogales-Ascarrunz said, referring to a type of in-depth genetic testing.

A male tilcayo is living at an animal shelter in Yungas after it was handed over by a family that had taken in the creature.

Research on the species was published Thursday in the journal Current Biology , culminating research that scientists began in 2021.

"So far, it's only been detected in Bolivia" and not "anywhere else on the planet," Nogales-Ascarrunz said.

She said the creatures were classified as vulnerable to extinction, but their small numbers meant they could soon be considered "at much greater risk" of dying out.

Jonas Lescroart et al, Phylogenomics and museomics reveal five distinct species of tiger cats in South America, Current Biology (2026). DOI: 10.1016/j.cub.2026.08.059

Master's in physics with research experience. Long-time science news enthusiast. Plays key role in Science X's editorial success. Full profile →
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 玻利维亚研究人员周四告诉法新社，科学家们一个多世纪以来首次发现了一种新的野猫物种。 蒂尔卡约虎猫是一种小型猫科动物，皮毛类似豹子，有斑点，在首都拉巴斯附近的永加斯山区被发现。 研究该动物的研究小组成员、生物学家、国家地理探险家保拉·诺加莱斯-阿斯卡伦兹 (Paola Nogales-Ascarrunz) 表示，在玻利维亚安第斯山脉看到这种生物的当地人将其误认为是普通的家猫。 当地人给这种动物起的绰号“tilcayo”启发了它的新科学名称：Leopardus tilcayo。 诺加利斯-阿斯卡伦兹称赞这一发现是“了不起的事件，因为一百年来没有新的野猫物种被描述过”。 这只猫是继1923年乌拉圭潘帕斯猫之后发现的第一只新猫科动物。 蒂尔卡约猫比家猫稍小，长约 45 厘米（18 英寸），耳朵呈圆形。 诺加利斯-阿斯卡伦兹说，一对提卡约鱼——迄今为止发现的唯一此类生物——已经接受了全基因组测序，指的是一种深入的基因测试。 一只雄性蒂尔卡约被收养它的家庭移交给永加斯的一个动物收容所。 周四，有关该物种的研究发表在《当代生物学》杂志上，这是科学家们于 2021 年开始的研究的最终成果。 诺加莱斯-阿斯卡伦兹说：“到目前为止，仅在玻利维亚检测到了这种病毒”，而“地球上其他任何地方都没有检测到”。 她说，这些生物被归类为容易灭绝的物种，但它们的数量很少，意味着它们很快就会被认为“面临更大的灭绝风险”。 Jonas Lescroart 等人，系统基因组学和博物馆组学揭示了南美洲五种不同的虎猫，《当代生物学》（2026 年）。 DOI：10.1016/j.cub.2026.08.059 物理学硕士，具有研究经验。长期科学新闻爱好者。在 Science X 的编辑成功中发挥着关键作用。完整档案 →

reflection.en: The discovery of the tilcayo tiger cat is a reminder of the vast, intricate tapestry of life Yahweh has woven into our world. Even in familiar landscapes, hidden wonders await discovery, showcasing the Creator's boundless creativity and wisdom. This new feline, once overlooked, calls us to appreciate the richness of biodiversity and to be stewards of the...
reflection.zh: 蒂尔卡约虎猫的发现提醒我们，雅伟在我们世界中编织了生命丰富而复杂的织锦。即使在熟悉的土地上，也隐藏着等待发现的奇迹，彰显了创造主无限的创造力和智慧。 这种曾经被忽视的新型猫科动物，呼吁我们珍惜生物多样性的丰富性，并成为我们受托的宏伟创造的管家。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Nebula image wins Royal Observatory competition
title.zh: 星云图像赢得皇家天文台比赛

summary.en: Ali Alobaidly has been named Astronomy Photographer of the Year for his image of the Shark Nebula, a dark nebula composed of interstellar dust located 650 light-years away. The judges praised the image for its flawless presentation, sharp details, and dynamic contrast, noting the ability to see distant galaxies...
summary.zh: 阿里·阿洛拜德利凭借其拍摄的鲨鱼星云图像荣获年度天文摄影师称号。该星云是一个由星际尘埃组成的暗星云，距离地球650光年。评委们称赞该图像的呈现完美无瑕、细节锐利且对比度高，甚至能透过星云看到遥远的星系。

body.en:
The Royal Observatory Greenwich has announced the winner of its Astronomy Photographer of the Year competition for an image of the Shark Nebula.

The dark nebula is made from interstellar dust dense enough to block starlight and is 650 light years away.

Steve Marsh, one of the judges and art editor at BBC Sky at Night Magazine, said the image by Ali Alobaidly showed "flawless presentation, pin-sharp details and dynamic contrast".

He added: "The Shark Nebula is already a striking object, but when it is resolved to the point where even detail-rich distant galaxies can be seen through it, you know you're looking at something very special."

Alobaidly, who won £10,000 for winning the competition overall, said he hoped to use his photographs "to make astronomy more accessible, engaging and meaningful through science communication and education", and described the award as a "tremendous honour".

Alobaidly's entry, taken in Kuwait, was entered in the Stars and Nebulae category.

Nikolaos Strimpoulis, 15, won for ZWO Young Astronomy Photographer of the Year for his image Mineral Moon, taken in Palaio Faliro, Athens, Greece.

The close-up image of the Moon's surface includes dark areas known as maria and bright areas known as the highlands.

The orange and blue colours on the lunar surface are caused by iron and titanium deposits and it was for that reason that the image was given its title.

Marsh said: "Many of us start our astrophotography journey with the Moon – some of us stay there forever! But often we don't delve deep into the subtle colours of its mineral deposits until much later. This amazing young astrophotographer has achieved perfectly developed colouring in this photograph."

Dr Greg Brown, astronomer at the Royal Observatory Greenwich, said the entries from the 18th year of the competition demonstrated "skill and innovation" coupled with improvements in technology.

An exhibition of the winning and highly commended images will be on display at the National Maritime Museum, London from 18 September.

Listen to the best of BBC Radio London on Sounds and follow BBC London on Facebook , external , X , external and Instagram , external . Send your story ideas to hello.bbclondon@bbc.co.uk , external
body.zh: 格林威治皇家天文台宣布了年度天文摄影师鲨鱼星云图像竞赛的获奖者。 暗星云由星际尘埃组成，其密度足以阻挡星光，距离 650 光年。 BBC Sky at Night 杂志的评委之一兼艺术编辑史蒂夫·马什 (Steve Marsh) 表示，阿里·阿洛拜德利 (Ali Alobaidly) 的图像展现了“完美的呈现、锐利的细节和动态对比度”。 他补充道：“鲨鱼星云已经是一个引人注目的天体，但是当它被解析到甚至可以通过它看到细节丰富的遥远星系时，你就知道你正在看到一些非常特别的东西。” 阿洛拜德利赢得了总冠军，赢得了 10,000 英镑，他表示希望利用自己的照片“通过科学传播和教育，让天文学变得更容易理解、更有吸引力、更有意义”，并将该奖项描述为“巨大的荣誉”。 阿洛拜德利的作品在科威特拍摄，被纳入恒星和星云类别。 15 岁的尼古拉斯·斯特林普利斯 (Nikolaos Strimpoulis) 凭借在希腊雅典帕莱奥法利罗拍摄的照片《矿物月亮》赢得了 ZWO 年度青年天文摄影师奖。 月球表面的特写图像包括被称为月海的黑暗区域和被称为高地的明亮区域。 月球表面的橙色和蓝色是由铁和钛沉积物造成的，正是由于这个原因，该图像才被命名为该图像。 马什说：“我们中的许多人都是从月球开始我们的天文摄影之旅的——有些人永远呆在那里！但通常我们直到很久以后才深入研究月球矿藏的微妙颜色。这位令人惊叹的年轻天文摄影师在这张照片中实现了完美的色彩呈现。” 格林威治皇家天文台天文学家格雷格·布朗博士表示，第 18 届竞赛的参赛作品展示了“技巧和创新”以及技术的进步。 获奖和高度赞扬的图像展览将于 9 月 18 日在伦敦国家海事博物馆展出。 通过 Sounds 收听 BBC 伦敦广播电台的精彩节目，并在 Facebook、external、X、external 和 Instagram、external 上关注 BBC London。将您的故事创意发送至外部 hello.bbclondon@bbc.co.uk

reflection.en: The vastness and beauty captured in the Shark Nebula image invite us to contemplate the grandeur of creation. The psalmist declares, 'The heavens declare the glory of Yahweh.' This photograph, a testament to human curiosity and skill, allows us to glimpse that glory, reminding us of the immense and intricate universe Yahweh has made.
reflection.zh: 鲨鱼星云图像中捕捉到的浩瀚与美丽，邀请我们沉思造物的宏伟。诗人宣告：“诸天述说雅伟的荣耀。”这张照片是人类好奇心和技艺的证明，让我们得以瞥见那荣耀，提醒我们雅伟所造的宇宙是何其浩瀚而精妙。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: ‘A map is never neutral’: meet the cartographers who took on centuries of western bias
title.zh: “地图永远不是中立的”：认识那些挑战了几个世纪西方偏见的制图师

summary.en: The Equal Earth projection, adopted by the UN last week, offers an alternative to the 16th-century Mercator map. Three cartographers created it to more accurately represent the sizes of continents like Africa and Europe, countering the Mercator map's tendency to exaggerate the size of northern hemisphere nations and...
summary.zh: 平等地球投影图在上周被联合国采纳，为16世纪的麦卡托投影图提供了一个替代方案。三位制图师创建了该地图，旨在更准确地展示非洲和欧洲等大陆的实际大小，以对抗麦卡托投影图夸大北半球国家面积并以此微妙地强化全球力量认知的倾向。尽管收到了一些外交官的投诉，但联合国近乎普遍地采纳这一新地图被视为一个重大转变。

body.en: Equal Earth projection, adopted by the UN last week, provides an alternative to 16th-century Mercator display Three cartographers have spoken of their astonishment at the UN’s near-universal adoption of a map they created to more accurately show the sizes of Africa and Europe, even though they have received a few complaints from some disgruntled diplomats. The creators of the Equal Earth projection aimed to provide an alternative to the dominant 16th-century Mercator display, which critics have long faulted for giving the impression that northern hemisphere nations are larger than they are – and therefore subtly reinforcing perceptions of where global strength lies. Continue reading...
body.zh: 联合国上周采用的平等地球投影提供了 16 世纪墨卡托显示的替代方案。三位制图师表示，他们对联合国几乎普遍采用他们为更准确地显示非洲和欧洲面积而制作的地图感到惊讶，尽管他们收到了一些心怀不满的外交官的抱怨。平等地球投影的创造者旨在为 16 世纪墨卡托投影提供一种替代方案，批评者长期以来一直批评这种投影给人一种北半球国家比实际面积更大的印象，从而巧妙地强化了人们对全球实力所在的看法。继续阅读...

reflection.en: For centuries, the Mercator projection subtly shaped how the world perceived the relative sizes of nations, often overemphasizing the North and diminishing the South. The adoption of the Equal Earth map by the UN signifies a move towards greater accuracy and a correction of historical bias. This reminds us that how we represent reality, even in seemingly...
reflection.zh: 几个世纪以来，麦卡托投影图在潜移默化中塑造了世界对各国相对大小的认知，常常夸大北方而缩小南方。联合国采纳平等地球地图标志着朝着更准确的方向迈进，并纠正了历史偏见。这提醒我们，即使是我们呈现现实的方式，即使是像地图这样看似中立的工具，也可能带有隐藏的假设，并影响我们对公平和比例的理解。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Improved air quality linked to better mental development in toddlers, study finds
title.zh: 改善空气质量与幼儿心智发展更好相关，研究发现

summary.en: Long-term research in New York indicates that efforts to reduce air pollution are associated with higher cognitive test scores in toddlers. A study by Columbia University, following over 1,100 children for more than two decades, measured pollution exposure of pregnant women and their children's development in...
summary.zh: 纽约一项长期研究表明，减少空气污染的努力与幼儿更高的认知测试分数相关。哥伦比亚大学的一项研究，在二十多年里跟踪了超过1100名儿童，测量了孕妇的空气污染暴露情况及其孩子在曼哈顿北部和南布朗克斯贫困社区的发展情况，发现空气更清洁与三岁时认知能力提高之间存在联系。

body.en: Long-term research in New York shows efforts to reduce air pollution associated with higher cognitive test scores Improvements in air pollution are leading to brighter, smarter toddlers, according to a new study from Columbia University in New York. For more than two decades, Prof Frederica Perera and a team from the Columbia Center for Children’s Environmental Health measured the air pollution exposure of pregnant women and the development of their children in the disadvantaged communities of northern Manhattan and the South Bronx. More than 1,100 children were assessed when they were one, two and three years old. Continue reading...
body.zh: 纽约的长期研究表明，减少空气污染的努力与较高的认知测试成绩有关。纽约哥伦比亚大学的一项新研究表明，空气污染的改善正在使幼儿变得更聪明、更聪明。二十多年来，弗雷德里卡·佩雷拉教授和哥伦比亚儿童环境健康中心的一个团队测量了曼哈顿北部和南布朗克斯贫困社区孕妇的空气污染暴露情况及其孩子的发育情况。超过 1,100 名一岁、两岁和三岁的儿童接受了评估。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This study from New York offers a hopeful glimpse into how environmental stewardship can directly benefit the youngest among us. The finding that cleaner air correlates with better cognitive development in toddlers underscores the intricate connection between the world we shape and the well-being of its inhabitants. It reminds us that caring for creation is...
reflection.zh: 这项来自纽约的研究为我们提供了希望的曙光，展示了环境管理如何能直接造福我们当中最年幼的生命。清洁空气与幼儿认知发展改善之间的相关性，突显了我们所塑造的世界与其居民福祉之间错综复杂的联系。它提醒我们，关爱受造界不仅仅是一个抽象的理念，更是对未来的切实投资。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Grass and clover can provide more than animal feed
title.zh: 草和三叶草可以提供更多动物饲料

summary.en: Growing leys, such as grass and clover, is a traditional practice in Swedish agriculture, but less common in cereal-dominated regions due to the need for a market for the harvest. Researchers are exploring the potential of green biorefineries to process these crops into multiple products.
summary.zh: 种植草地（如草和三叶草）是瑞典农业的传统做法，但在以谷物为主的地区不太常见，因为需要为收获物找到市场。研究人员正在探索绿色生物精炼厂的潜力，将这些作物加工成多种产品。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Growing leys—grass and clover—is nothing new in Swedish agriculture. But in the arable farming regions dominated by cereal production, leys are less common. One reason is that there needs to be a market for what is harvested.

This was one of the starting points when researchers at Chalmers began exploring the potential of green biorefineries, where grass and clover can be processed into several different products.

"From a cultivation and soil perspective, introducing grass and clover leys into a crop rotation dominated by cereals has a range of positive effects on both the soil and the environment. Farmers are well aware that growing grass and clover improves soil quality, but the challenge is finding a market for this biomass resource," says Christel Cederberg, professor of sustainable agricultural systems at Chalmers.

One opportunity became apparent when Danish researchers began extracting protein from fresh grass in pilot facilities.

"When we heard that Danish researchers had begun extracting protein from fresh grass in pilot plants and producing a protein feed that could replace imported feed, we saw another major advantage: by biorefining the protein from leys, we could reduce dependence on soy protein, which is associated with a number of environmental problems," says Göran Berndes, professor of biomass and land use at Chalmers.

"It was quite natural for us to pursue this opportunity, as it is in line with our previous research into ways of developing the production and processing of biomass to provide a wider range of bio-based products while at the same time mitigating the negative environmental impacts of agriculture," he continues.

Cederberg and Berndes work at the Division of Physical Resource Theory, Department of Environmental and Energy Sciences at Chalmers University of Technology.

In a green biorefinery, freshly harvested grass and clover are pressed and the protein is separated. The protein can be used as animal feed, thereby replacing some of the soy imported into Europe.

"If we can replace soy with grass protein, there are a number of environmental benefits. Particularly important are substantially reduced negative impacts from pesticides, more circular nutrient systems, maintained soil fertility and better conditions for biodiversity in agricultural landscapes."

But protein is only one component of the biomass. The refining process also produces large quantities of fiber-rich residual streams that can be used in several ways.

"So far, the byproducts have mainly been used to produce biogas, but we see many additional possibilities, including...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 种植草和三叶草在瑞典农业中并不是什么新鲜事。但在以谷物生产为主的耕地地区，地雷并不常见。原因之一是收获的东西需要有市场。 这是查尔姆斯理工大学的研究人员开始探索绿色生物精炼厂潜力的起点之一，其中草和三叶草可以加工成几种不同的产品。 “从耕种和土壤的角度来看，将草和三叶草引入以谷物为主的轮作中，对土壤和环境都有一系列积极影响。农民们都清楚种植草和三叶草可以改善土壤质量，但挑战在于为这种生物质资源找到市场，”查尔姆斯理工大学可持续农业系统教授克里斯特尔·塞德伯格说。 当丹麦研究人员开始在试点设施中从新鲜草中提取蛋白质时，一个机会就显现出来了。 “当我们听说丹麦研究人员已经开始在试点工厂中从新鲜草中提取蛋白质并生产可以替代进口饲料的蛋白质饲料时，我们看到了另一个主要优势：通过从麦粒中生物精炼蛋白质，我们可以减少对大豆蛋白的依赖，这与许多环境问题有关，”查尔姆斯理工大学生物质和土地利用教授 Göran Berndes 说。 “我们抓住这个机会是很自然的，因为它符合我们之前对开发生物质生产和加工方法的研究，以提供更广泛的生物基产品，同时减轻农业对环境的负面影响，”他继续说道。 Cederberg 和 Berndes 在查尔姆斯理工大学环境与能源科学系物理资源理论部工作。 在绿色生物精炼厂中，对新鲜收获的草和三叶草进行压榨并分离蛋白质。这种蛋白质可以用作动物饲料，从而替代部分进口到欧洲的大豆。 “如果我们能用草蛋白替代大豆，就会带来许多环境效益。特别重要的是大幅减少农药的负面影响、更循环的营养系统、保持土壤肥力以及改善农业景观中的生物多样性条件。” 但蛋白质只是生物质的一种成分。精炼过程还产生大量富含纤维的残余流，可用于多种用途。 “到目前为止，副产品主要用于生产沼气，但我们看到了许多其他可能性，包括......

reflection.en: The Psalmist marvels at the wisdom evident in God's creation, and Job's friends speak of learning from the earth and its creatures. This research into grass and clover, transforming them into valuable biorefinery products, is a testament to the intricate design and potential within the natural world that we are called to steward and understand.
reflection.zh: 诗篇作者惊叹于上帝创造物中显而易见的智慧，约伯的朋友们也谈到要向大地及其生物学习。这项关于草和三叶草的研究，将其转化为有价值的生物精炼产品，证明了自然界中存在着我们被呼召去管理和理解的复杂设计和潜力。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: In hottest summer on record, 2 in 3 Americans say climate change is increasing heat-related illnesses
title.zh: 在创纪录的夏季，三分之二的美国人认为气候变化正在增加与热相关的疾病

summary.en: According to a new survey, nearly two-thirds of Americans believe climate change is exacerbating health issues like respiratory diseases and heat- and insect-related illnesses. This comes as the past summer was recorded as the warmest in the contiguous U.S. since record-keeping began 132 years ago.
summary.zh: 根据一项新调查，近三分之二的美国人认为气候变化正在加剧呼吸道疾病以及与高温和昆虫相关的疾病等健康问题。此前，美国国家海洋和大气管理局宣布，过去一个夏季（6月至8月）是有记录以来美国本土最热的夏季，已有132年历史。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Nearly two-thirds of the American public say climate change is increasing the risk of respiratory diseases and heat- and insect-related illnesses, according to a new survey from the Annenberg Public Policy Center (APPC) of the University of Pennsylvania.

In September 2026, the U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) announced that the past summer, from June through August, had been the warmest in the lower contiguous 48 states in the 132 years records have been kept. The United Nations reported that global sea surface temperatures had "reached an all-time observed high."

The policy center's nationally representative Annenberg Science and Public Health (ASAPH) survey, conducted Aug. 4–17, 2026, among 1,904 empaneled U.S. adults, finds that 76% report that extreme outdoor heat affected their daily activities at least sometimes in the past year and 38% say poor air quality resulting from wildfire smoke did so. The American Lung Association's "State of the Air" 2026 report found that 44% of Americans are living in areas that earn "failing grades for unhealthy levels of ozone or particle pollution."

Extreme heat is affecting the everyday lives of most Americans, the survey finds.

"Extreme heat is no longer just an occasional inconvenience," said Ken Winneg, APPC's managing director of survey research. "It is affecting Americans' household budgets and daily routines, from electricity bills to simply going outside."

Nearly two-thirds of Americans (65%) say that climate change is increasing the risk of heat-related illnesses, respiratory diseases and insect-borne diseases. This is unchanged from August 2025 (65%) and July 2024 (67%) but is significantly higher than 58% in November 2023.

Americans generally recognize that heat waves are on the rise. Nearly two-thirds (62%) say U.S. heat waves are becoming more frequent and intense than in the past, statistically unchanged from 61% in August 2025, 65% in July 2024 and 58% in November 2023.

Of the four extreme weather events measured in the survey, more Americans report that their daily activities were affected at least sometimes by extreme outdoor heat (76%) and poor air quality resulting from wildfire smoke (38%). As one would expect, fewer say they were affected at least sometimes by flooding (20%) and tornadoes or hurricanes (11%), since these events are less frequent.

Experiencing extreme outdoor heat, poor air quality and flooding that affected daily activities in the past year increased the likelihood that respondents believed climate change is increasing the risk of heat-related illnesses,...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 宾夕法尼亚大学安纳伯格公共政策中心 (APPC) 的一项新调查显示，近三分之二的美国公众表示，气候变化正在增加患呼吸道疾病以及与高温和昆虫相关疾病的风险。 2026 年 9 月，美国国家海洋和大气管理局 (NOAA) 宣布，去年 6 月至 8 月的夏季是 132 年来有记录以来，邻近 48 个州的最温暖夏季。联合国报告称，全球海洋表面温度已“达到历史最高水平”。 该政策中心于 2026 年 8 月 4 日至 17 日对 1,904 名美国成年人进行了具有全国代表性的安纳伯格科学与公共卫生 (ASAPH) 调查，结果发现，76% 的人表示，在过去一年中，极端的室外高温至少有时影响了他们的日常活动，38% 的人表示，野火烟雾导致的空气质量不佳也影响了他们的日常活动。美国肺脏协会的《2026 年空气状况》报告发现，44% 的美国人生活在“臭氧或颗粒污染不健康水平不及格”的地区。 调查发现，极端高温正在影响大多数美国人的日常生活。 APPC 调查研究常务董事肯·温尼格 (Ken Winneg) 表示：“酷热不再只是偶尔造成的不便。” “它正在影响美国人的家庭预算和日常生活，从电费到外出。” 近三分之二的美国人 (65%) 表示，气候变化正在增加患与热有关的疾病、呼吸道疾病和虫媒疾病的风险。这与 2025 年 8 月 (65%) 和 2024 年 7 月 (67%) 持平，但明显高于 2023 年 11 月的 58%。 美国人普遍认识到热浪正在加剧。近三分之二 (62%) 的人表示，美国的热浪比过去变得更加频繁和强烈，与 2025 年 8 月的 61%、2024 年 7 月的 65% 和 2023 年 11 月的 58% 相比，统计数据没有变化。 在调查中测量的四种极端天气事件中，更多的美国人表示，他们的日常活动至少有时会受到室外极端高温（76%）和野火烟雾造成的恶劣空气质量（38%）的影响。正如人们所预料的那样，很少有人说他们至少有时会受到洪水（20%）和龙卷风或飓风（11%）的影响，因为这些事件发生的频率较低。 过去一年中经历了极端的室外高温、空气质量差和洪水影响了日常活动，这增加了受访者认为气候变化正在增加与高温相关疾病的风险的可能性，...

reflection.en: As the planet experiences its hottest summer on record, a significant majority of Americans recognize the link between climate change and increasing heat-related illnesses. This widespread concern echoes the ancient truth that the Earth is Yahweh's, and with its fullness, the world and those who dwell in it. Our stewardship of this creation is a profound...
reflection.zh: 随着地球经历创纪录的最热夏季，绝大多数美国人认识到气候变化与日益增长的热相关疾病之间的联系。这种普遍的担忧呼应了一个古老的真理：地和其中所充满的，世界和居住在其间的，都属雅伟。我们对这受造之物的管理，是一项深远的责任，呼吁我们关爱那供养我们所有人的环境。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: See tiny organisms on show in microscopic video competition
title.zh: 显微视频竞赛展示微小生物

summary.en: The winning video of Nikon's Small World In Motion competition showcases cilia, hair-like structures in the airways of a child with a rare genetic disease, magnified 100 times. The competition celebrates microscopic film and time-lapse photography.
summary.zh: 尼康的“显微世界动态”年度竞赛的获奖视频展示了患有罕见遗传病的儿童气道中的纤毛（一种毛发状结构），放大了100倍。该竞赛旨在庆祝显微电影和延时摄影。

body.en:
Nikon's annual Small World In Motion competition is open to anyone around the world with an interest in film or time-lapse photography through a microscope.

This year's winning video was magnified to 100 times in size, and featured tiny hair-like structures, called cilia, in the airways of a child with a rare genetic disease.

It was submitted by Dr Ning Xu, a researcher at Tsinghua University in China, who used a series of complicated light waves to illuminate different parts of the sample in colour.

Runners up in the competition included videos of a roundworm encountering a single-celled organism and microscopic jellyfish larvae suspended in droplets of water. Clips of bioluminescent algae and a tiny sea slug were among the highly commended.
body.zh: 尼康一年一度的“动态小世界”竞赛向世界各地任何对显微镜胶片或延时摄影感兴趣的人开放。 今年的获奖视频尺寸被放大了 100 倍，并以患有罕见遗传病的儿童呼吸道中的微小毛发状结构（称为纤毛）为特色。 该研究由中国清华大学研究员徐宁博士提交，他使用一系列复杂的光波来照亮样本的不同部分。 比赛的亚军包括蛔虫遇到单细胞生物和悬浮在水滴中的微小水母幼虫的视频。生物发光藻类和小海蛞蝓的片段受到高度赞扬。

reflection.en: This competition reveals the intricate beauty hidden within the smallest forms of life, reminding us that even in the unseen, Yahweh's creative hand is evident. Observing these microscopic worlds can inspire awe and a deeper appreciation for the complexity of creation, a source of wisdom for those who seek it.
reflection.zh: 这项竞赛揭示了生命最小形态中隐藏的精妙之美，提醒我们即使在看不见的世界里，雅伟创造的手也显而易见。观察这些微观世界可以激发敬畏之情，并加深对创造复杂性的理解，这是寻求智慧者的智慧之源。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Cognitive resilience helps to predict Alzheimer’s dementia
title.zh: 认知弹性有助于预测阿尔茨海默病

summary.en: Cognitive resilience, a trait that helps explain why symptoms of Alzheimer's dementia vary in severity among individuals with similar brain pathology, could be a key predictor of the disease.
summary.zh: 认知弹性是帮助解释为何在脑病理学相似的个体中，阿尔茨海默病痴呆症的症状严重程度各不相同的特征，它可能成为该疾病的关键预测指标。

body.en:
Researchers have identified a measure of ‘cognitive resilience’ that can account for some of the striking differences in dementia risk seen in people with similar levels of Alzheimer’s pathology 1 .

It reminds us that even in the face of decline, there are remarkable capacities at play, echoing the ancient wisdom that creation itself reveals profound truths about its Maker.
